words.word: Excuse me. My name is Richard Stewart.
words.meaning: 打扰一下。我叫 Richard Stewart。

words.word: May I take a picture of you and your little boy?
words.meaning: 我可以替你和你的小男孩拍一张照吗？

words.word: I call it Family Album, U.S.A.
Well, it's fine if you take our picture.
words.meaning: 你想拍我们的照，就请吧。

words.word: Thank you. I appreciate your help.

words.meaning: 我们住在加利福尼亚州。

decks.section: 第1集 · 拍照、介绍家庭、问路与归还失物

words.meaning: 现在请指着那些建筑物。

words.word: Give Mommy a kiss, Gerald. Nice!
We'll be looking for your book.
words.meaning: 我们会留意你这本书的。

words.word: Hey, let me take your picture!

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第1集 · 04 认识交换生
decks.section: 第1集 · 拍照、介绍家庭、问路与归还失物

words.meaning: 你是什么时候来这里的？
我是在学校里学的英语。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第1集 · 05 邀请与介绍摄影集
decks.section: 第1集 · 拍照、介绍家庭、问路与归还失物

words.word: Oh, it's not finished yet, but I have some of the pictures.
words.meaning: 哦，还没有完成，不过我已经有一些照片了。

words.word: Would you like to see them?
Here they are. Family Album, U.S.A.
It's an album of pictures of the United States: the cities, the special places, and the people.
words.meaning: 这是一本关于美国的影集，记录了城市、特别的地方和那里的人们。

words.word: And these are pictures of people working: steelworkers, bankers, police, street vendors, ambulance drivers, doctors....
words.meaning: 这些是人们工作时的照片：钢铁工人、银行职员、警察、街头小贩、救护车司机、医生……

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第1集 · 06 介绍家庭与居住情况
decks.section: 第1集 · 拍照、介绍家庭、问路与归还失物

words.word: Oh, this is my father. He's a doctor.
words.meaning: 噢，这是我父亲，他是一名医生。

words.word: She works for a toy company.
words.meaning: 她在一家玩具公司工作。

words.word: Here's my grandfather. He lives in Florida.
words.meaning: 这是我的祖父。他住在佛罗里达州。

words.word: And this is my wife Marilyn.
Thanks. And what about your family?
That's a large city in northern Greece.
words.meaning: 那是希腊北部的一座大城市。

words.word: But now I'm living in the Bronx.
words.meaning: 不过现在我住在布朗克斯区。
跟一个希腊裔美国家庭住在一起吗？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第1集 · 07 礼貌告别与遗忘提醒
decks.section: 第1集 · 拍照、介绍家庭、问路与归还失物

words.word: I have to meet my wife.
It was a pleasure meeting you, too.
And good luck! I've got to go.
Bye-bye. Richard! Richard! You left your bag!

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第1集 · 08 问路与地铁换乘信息
decks.section: 第1集 · 拍照、介绍家庭、问路与归还失物

words.word: how to get to Linden Street
Can you tell me how to get to Linden Street, in Riverdale?
words.meaning: 你能告诉我怎么去 Riverdale 的林登街吗？

words.word: "Richard Stewart, 46 Linden Street, Riverdale, New York."
You should take the number 1 subway.
words.meaning: 你应该乘坐 1 号线地铁。

words.word: Is there a station near here?
You should take the number 1 train to Van Cortlandt Park.
words.meaning: 你应该乘坐 1 号线列车前往 Van Cortlandt Park。

words.word: Number 1 train to Van Cortlandt Park. Thank you.
words.meaning: 乘坐 1 号线列车去 Van Cortlandt Park。谢谢。
往市区北部方向的站台

words.word: Remember, the number 1 train. The uptown platform.
words.meaning: 记住，乘坐 1 号线列车，在往市区北部方向的站台上车。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第1集 · 09 挑选衣服与等待家人
decks.section: 第1集 · 拍照、介绍家庭、问路与归还失物

words.word: Is this pink too bright for me?
words.meaning: 我穿粉红色会不会太过鲜艳了？

words.word: Mmm-hmm. It is a very bright pink.
words.meaning: 是的，这种粉红是亮了点。
试试这一件。尺码是八号。

words.word: How about green? It's size ten.
words.meaning: 绿的怎么样？它是十号的。

words.word: taking too much of your time
I'm taking too much of your time.
I was expecting him here at five forty-five.
words.meaning: 我们约好了五点四十五在这里会面的。

words.word: Don't worry. The traffic is very heavy at this hour.
words.meaning: 别担心。这个时间交通很拥挤。

words.word: I know. But we're going to be late for dinner.
words.meaning: 我知道。不过我们晚餐要迟到了。
我就买这件绿色毛衣吧。

words.word: I like the color on me, don't you?
words.meaning: 我觉得我穿这个颜色挺好看，你说呢？

words.word: I think it looks terrific on you.
words.meaning: 我觉得你穿上它好极了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第1集 · 10 迟到与说明遗失经过
decks.section: 第1集 · 拍照、介绍家庭、问路与归还失物

words.meaning: 对不起，我迟到了这么久。

words.word: I had a really bad day.
It's ten after six. We're late.
words.meaning: 现在是六点十分。我们迟了。

words.word: Robbie's cooking tonight, and dinner's at six thirty.
words.meaning: Robbie 今晚做饭，六点半开饭。

words.word: I know. I know. I'm really sorry.
words.meaning: 我知道，我知道。真的很抱歉。

words.word: I left my bag of film on the ferry.
words.meaning: 我把装胶卷的包落在渡船上了。

words.word: I went back for it, but the ferry was gone.
words.meaning: 等我回去找的时候，船已经开走了。

words.word: I lost a whole day's work.
words.meaning: 我一整天拍的东西都丢了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第1集 · 11 电话查询失物
decks.section: 第1集 · 拍照、介绍家庭、问路与归还失物

words.word: I'll call the Staten Island Ferry lost-and-found office.
words.meaning: 我来给 Staten Island 渡轮失物招领处打电话。

words.word: I didn't think of that. Thanks.
words.meaning: 我倒没有想到这个法子。谢了。

words.word: Yes. The number, please, of the Staten Island Ferry lost-and-found office.
words.meaning: 对，请告诉我 Staten Island 渡轮失物招领处的电话号码。

words.word: Five five five...zero eight zero eight.
Did anyone find a camera bag this afternoon, a small canvas bag, on the J. F. Kennedy Ferry?...No?
words.meaning: 今天下午有人在 J. F. Kennedy 号渡船上捡到一个相机包吗？一个小帆布包……没有吗？

words.word: The name is Stewart, Richard Stewart.
And the telephone number is five five five... three oh nine oh. Thank you.
Sorry, Richard. They don't have it.

words.meaning: 不管怎样，我都得谢谢你。

words.word: There was a girl on the ferry.
Tell me about it on the way home.
words.meaning: 在回家的路上告诉我吧。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第1集 · 12 家人回家与晚餐安排
decks.section: 第1集 · 拍照、介绍家庭、问路与归还失物

words.word: And give her a teaspoon of the medicine after every meal.
words.meaning: 每餐之后给她吃一茶匙的药。
Marilyn 和 Richard 来过电话了。

words.word: They'll be here soon, and then we'll eat.
words.meaning: 他们马上就到。他们一到就开饭。

words.word: She has to work late tonight.
words.meaning: 她今晚得工作得晚一些。

words.word: And what's Robbie cooking for dinner?

words.meaning: 先保密，到时候给你个惊喜。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第1集 · 13 晚餐、甜点与担忧
decks.section: 第1集 · 拍照、介绍家庭、问路与归还失物

words.word: We've got lots of ice cream.
Oh, I'd love some ice cream.
Well, there's chocolate and coffee and a little vanilla.
words.meaning: 好的。这里有巧克力冰淇淋、咖啡冰淇淋和一点香草的。

words.word: Is that all right with everyone?
Uh, one scoop of coffee and one scoop of chocolate for me.
words.meaning: 嗯，我要一勺咖啡味的，再来一勺巧克力味的。

words.word: Robbie, will you help me serve?
words.meaning: Robbie，你能帮我把吃的端给大家吗？

words.word: I keep thinking about that bag of film. Eight rolls.
words.meaning: 我还一直想着那包胶卷。八卷啊。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第1集 · 14 来访与归还胶卷
decks.section: 第1集 · 拍照、介绍家庭、问路与归还失物

words.word: Your brother left his bag of film on the ferryboat.
words.meaning: 你哥哥把装胶卷的包落在渡船上了。

words.word: I'm really glad to see you.
I mean...my brother'll be really glad to see you!
words.meaning: 我的意思是我哥哥见到你会非常高兴。

words.word: Hello, Richard. I found your bag!

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第1集 · 15 介绍家人与郑重感谢
decks.section: 第1集 · 拍照、介绍家庭、问路与归还失物

words.meaning: 嗯……Alexandra，让我给你介绍一下大家。

words.word: Richard told us all about you.
words.meaning: Richard 向我们详细介绍过你的情况。

words.word: And this is my mother, Ellen Stewart.
And my father, Dr. Philip Stewart.
Yes. And you must be Susan. Hi.
I'm so glad you found the bag and took the time and trouble to return it.
words.meaning: 很高兴你捡到了包，还特意花时间、不辞麻烦地送回来。

words.word: I just took the wrong train.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第1集 · 16 招待、打电话与暂留
decks.section: 第1集 · 拍照、介绍家庭、问路与归还失物

words.word: Would you like something to eat?
I'm late for dinner at my house.
words.meaning: 我回家吃晚饭要迟到了。

words.word: Would you like to call home?
words.meaning: 你想跟家里通个电话吗？

words.word: Alexandra's a high-school exchange student from Greece.
words.meaning: Alexandra 是一名来自希腊的高中交换生。

words.word: With a family in the Bronx.
words.meaning: 她住在布朗克斯区的一个家庭里。

words.word: Oh, that's not too far from here!

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第1集 · 17 聊学校、课程与职业
decks.section: 第1集 · 拍照、介绍家庭、问路与归还失物

words.word: I can only stay a few minutes.
Where do you go to school?
At the Bronx High School of Science.
Oh, that's a very good school.
Richard tells me you're a doctor.
And what does your father do?

words.meaning: 他是律师，在塞萨洛尼基工作。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第1集 · 18 邀请再访与离开
decks.section: 第1集 · 拍照、介绍家庭、问路与归还失物

words.word: It might be a little cold.
Thanks, no. I do have to go.
words.meaning: 谢谢了，不用。我真的得走了。

words.word: It was nice meeting you all.
thank you for bringing Richard's bag back
words.meaning: 谢谢你把 Richard 的包送回来

words.word: Well, maybe you'll come for lunch some Sunday, so we can really thank you for bringing Richard's bag back.
words.meaning: 那也许哪个星期天你可以过来吃午饭，让我们好好感谢你把 Richard 的包送回来。

words.word: The train is just up the street.
words.meaning: 地铁站就在这条街前面。

words.word: It won't take me long at all.
Well, you really saved the day for me, Alexandra.
She's a smart young lady, and very nice.
words.meaning: 她是个聪明的年轻姑娘，而且很善良。

words.word: Very! Hey, she forgot her bag!
words.meaning: 可不是嘛！嘿，她把包忘在这儿了！

words.word: I guess we'll be seeing Alexandra again.
words.meaning: 看来我们还会再见到 Alexandra。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第2集 · 01 街头问路
decks.section: 第2集 · 问路、约会与临时变故

words.word: Excuse me. Can you help me?
That's easy. Walk to the corner.
Then walk two blocks to the traffic light.
words.meaning: 再走两条街到红绿灯处，

words.word: To the corner and then a left?

words.meaning: 要热狗吗？只要七十五分钱。

words.word: No. Thank you. I have a dinner date.
words.meaning: 不，谢谢。我要去赴晚餐约会。

words.word: Yes. Wooster Street is two blocks, and 83 is to the right, about two houses.
words.meaning: 是的，Wooster 街离这儿还有两个街区，83 号在右边，大约再过两栋房子。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第2集 · 02 见面与迎客
decks.section: 第2集 · 问路、约会与临时变故

words.word: Hello, Harry. It's nice to meet you.
The traffic. The parking. I was lost.
words.meaning: 交通拥挤，又找不到停车的地方。我又迷路了。

words.word: Don't worry about being late. It's fine.
words.meaning: 别为迟到挂心了，没有关系。

words.word: Excuse the mess. I just moved here.
words.meaning: 请不要介意这里乱得很，我刚刚搬来住。

words.word: Oh, I'd like you to meet my sister-in-law Marilyn.
words.meaning: 哦，我想让你认识一下我的嫂子 Marilyn。

words.word: Marilyn Stewart, this is Harry Bennett.
Are we too late for our dinner reservation?
words.meaning: 我们会不会错过晚餐订位时间？

words.word: No, the restaurant will hold our table.
words.meaning: 不会，餐厅会保留我们的席位。

words.word: I know the owner very well.
Do you know the phone number of the restaurant?
words.meaning: 你知道那家餐厅的电话号码吗？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第2集 · 03 留下联系方式
decks.section: 第2集 · 问路、约会与临时变故

words.word: leave the number with the baby-sitter
words.meaning: 把号码留给照看孩子的人

words.word: I'd like to call home and leave the number with the baby-sitter.
words.meaning: 我想打电话回家，把餐厅的电话告诉临时保姆。

words.word: Sure. The number is... five five five...seventeen twenty.
Five five five...one seven two oh. Hello?
I want to leave the phone number of the restaurant....
words.meaning: 我要留餐厅的电话号码给她。

words.word: Hi, Betty. I'll be at five five five...seventeen twenty.
Well, that's done. Shall we go?
words.meaning: 好了，打完了。我们可以走了吗?

words.word: I'm ready. See you later, Marilyn.
Bye, Marilyn. Hope to see you again.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第2集 · 04 餐厅入座与点饮品
decks.section: 第2集 · 问路、约会与临时变故

words.word: This is my friend Harry Bennett.
Any friend of Miss Stewart's is welcome at Somsak's.
words.meaning: Stewart小姐的任何朋友在Somsak餐厅都是受欢迎的。

words.word: I do, too. I come here often.
A special place for special people.
words.meaning: 特别的地方，招待特别的客人。

words.word: Would you like something to  drink?
a glass of ginger ale with ice
Yes, I'd like a glass of ginger ale with ice.
words.meaning: 是的，我要一杯加冰块的姜味汽水。

words.word: Do you have a dry white wine?
words.meaning: 你这里有干白葡萄酒吗？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第2集 · 05 点餐与推荐
decks.section: 第2集 · 问路、约会与临时变故

words.word: What would you like to eat?
Harry, would you like to see a menu?
I'll have the mee krob also.
Crispy fried noodles. I love them.
May I bring you a salad?

words.meaning: 我向你们推荐玫瑰花瓣沙拉。

words.word: What? Oh, yes. Starving. Well, I...
words.meaning: 什么？噢，是，我很饿。好啦，我……

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第2集 · 06 谈职业与孩子
decks.section: 第2集 · 问路、约会与临时变故

words.word: What do you do at Universe Toy Company?
words.meaning: 你在宇宙玩具公司做什么工作？

words.word: the vice-president of new toy development
words.meaning: 负责新玩具开发的副总裁

words.word: I'm the vice-president of new toy development.
words.meaning: 我是负责新玩具开发的副总裁。
我知道你是一位注册会计师。

words.word: That's true. Harry Bennett, certified public accountant.

words.meaning: 你们公司的会计师事务所。

words.word: I know. How old is she?
That's a nice age. What's her name?
words.meaning: 正是很好的年纪。她叫什么名字？

words.word: Do you have a picture of her?

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第2集 · 07 临时离席
decks.section: 第2集 · 问路、约会与临时变故

words.word: And there's a phone call for you, Mr. Bennett.
I'll get the rest of the dinner.
words.meaning: 我去把晚餐的其馀东西端来。

words.word: I have to leave. I feel terrible, but...
words.meaning: 我得走了。真是糟糕透了，但……

words.word: I don't know. The baby-sitter says she has a stomachache, and she's crying.
words.meaning: 我不知道。临时保姆说她肚子疼，她一直哭。

words.word: Of course. I'm so sorry for Michelle.
And you didn't have a chance to eat.
Let me take you home first.

words.meaning: 这是我们的第一次约会。

words.word: I hope your daughter is all right. Good-bye.
words.meaning: 我希望你女儿安然无恙。再见。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第2集 · 08 复述情况与评价
decks.section: 第2集 · 问路、约会与临时变故

words.word: I think she has a stomachache.
what do you think of him
So... what do you think of him?
But I think he was nervous tonight.
words.meaning: 但我想他今晚有点紧张。

words.word: his first date in two years
words.meaning: 他两年来的第一次约会

words.word: It was his first date in two years.
words.meaning: 这是他两年来第一次约会。

words.word: didn't get a thing to eat
He didn't get a thing to eat.
enough for three or four people
You ordered enough for three or four people, but I'm not complaining.
words.meaning: 你叫了够叁、四个人吃的菜，但我毫不在意。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第2集 · 09 返回与再次招待
decks.section: 第2集 · 问路、约会与临时变故

words.word: No. You won't believe it, Marilyn!
I believe it. Even without looking.
words.meaning: 我相信。即使不看也知道。

words.word: Your downstairs neighbor let me in.
words.meaning: 你楼下的邻居让我进来的。

words.word: I did , but everything is OK, so I decided to come back.
words.meaning: 回去了，但一切安好，于是我决定回来。

words.word: To apologize for leaving so early
words.meaning: 为了对这么早离开表示歉意

words.word: To apologize for leaving so early, I brought you a little gift.
words.meaning: 为了表示我对提早走掉的歉意，我给你带了一件小礼物。

words.word: It's a bonsai tree for your new apartment.
words.meaning: 这是一盆送给你新公寓的盆景。

words.word: Hi, Marilyn. I hope it's not too late.
words.meaning: 你好，Marilyn，我希望我来得不算太晚。

words.word: Oh, not at all. We're still eating.
words.meaning: 噢，没关系。我们还在吃着呢。

words.word: It's our meal from the restaurant.
words.meaning: 这是从餐厅带回来的菜肴。

words.word: It was only a tummy ache.
It's good that you went back.
important for me to be there
Yes, I think it's important for me to be there since her mother died.
words.meaning: 是的，我想我在场是非常重要的，因为她妈妈去世了。

words.word: As a matter of fact...  I am hungry.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第2集 · 10 谈家庭与生活
decks.section: 第2集 · 问路、约会与临时变故

words.word: I have a lot of work to do to get ready for tomorrow.
words.meaning: 我得为明天做许多准备工作。

words.word: Good night, Harry. It was nice meeting you.
She's going to a fashion show here in the city tomorrow.
words.meaning: 她将参加明天在本市举行的时装表演。

words.word: She is sleeping here so she won't have to travel from Riverdale in the morning.
words.meaning: 她晚上住在这儿，免得早上从Riverdale赶过来。
你们两个关系一定很好。

words.word: The whole Stewart family is close.
And then, two years ago, my wife died.
words.meaning: 接着，两年前我妻子去世了。

words.word: I do...yes, but I have Michelle...
words.meaning: 是的……没错，不过我还有 Michelle……

words.word: Is there anyone else in your life?
words.meaning: 在你生活中还有其他人吗？

words.word: No, not yet. What about you?
Oh, I date occasionally, but my work keeps me busy.
words.meaning: 哦，我偶尔约约会，但我老是忙于工作。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第2集 · 11 结束晚间拜访
decks.section: 第2集 · 问路、约会与临时变故

words.word: Ooh, speaking of keeping busy- I have an early start tomorrow, and the baby-sitter has to get home.
words.meaning: 哦，说到忙于工作，我明天还得早起，而且临时保姆也该回家了。
让我过了一个愉快的夜晚。

words.word: I'd like to meet your daughter someday.
words.meaning: 我希望有一天能见到你女儿。

words.word: Does that mean that I can see you again?
words.meaning: 是不是说我可以再见到你？

words.word: Wonderful. I'll call you, and we'll go out to dinner.
words.meaning: 那太好了。我打电话给你，然后我们到外面吃晚饭。

words.word: I promise I won't leave early.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第2集 · 12 轻松告别
decks.section: 第2集 · 问路、约会与临时变故

words.word: It was for a good reason.
words.meaning: 你今天提前离开是有正当理由的。

words.word: I think we're going to be good friends.
words.meaning: 我想我们可以成为好朋友。

words.word: Good night, Harry, Have a safe trip home.
I never liked that umbrella stand.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第3集 · 01 期待家人到来
decks.section: 第3集 · 迎接祖父、旅途交谈与家庭团聚

words.word: Marilyn, you want coffee or tea?
sitting in the kitchen with us
words.meaning: 和我们一起坐在厨房里

words.word: At this time tomorrow morning, Grandpa will be sitting in the kitchen with us.
words.meaning: 明早这时候，爷爷就和我们一起坐在厨房里啦。

words.word: picking him up at the station
Are we picking him up at the station?
doesn't want anybody picking him up
He doesn't want anybody picking him up.
Oh, let's go upstairs and prepare Grandpa's room.
words.meaning: 对，我们上去准备一下爷爷的房间。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第3集 · 02 一起生活的期待
decks.section: 第3集 · 迎接祖父、旅途交谈与家庭团聚

words.word: We are going upstairs to set up Grandpa's room.
words.meaning: 我们要上楼收拾一下爷爷的房间。

words.word: I'm really excited about seeing Grandpa.
words.meaning: 一想到要见到爷爷，我就觉得兴奋。
我也一样。请递给我牛奶。

words.word: I hope Grandpa's going to like living with us.
words.meaning: 我希望爷爷喜欢和我们住在一起。

words.word: feel comfortable in a new place
It just takes time to feel comfortable in a new place.
words.meaning: 总是需要一段时间才能适应一个新的环境。

words.word: Won't he miss being in Florida?
words.meaning: 他不会想念佛罗里达吗？

words.word: But I think he'll like being here with the family.
words.meaning: 但我想他也会喜欢和全家人住在这儿。

words.word: It's crazy here most of the time.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第3集 · 03 准备欢迎礼物
decks.section: 第3集 · 迎接祖父、旅途交谈与家庭团聚

words.word: You know, maybe I'll put together some photos of Grandpa as a "welcome" present.
words.meaning: 我说，或许我把爷爷的一些照片组合起来，作为欢迎他的一份礼物。

words.word: I have a picture of Grandpa and Dad and me in my wallet.
words.meaning: 我皮夹里有一张照片，是爷爷、爸爸和我在一起照的。

words.word: It's from the Fathers and Sons' Breakfast at my junior high school graduation.
words.meaning: 那是在父子早餐会上拍的，在我初中毕业的时候。

words.word: I'd really like to pick up Grandpa at the railroad station.
words.meaning: 我真想去火车站接爷爷。

words.word: Railroad stations or airports-- Grandpa always tells us he'll get here by himself.
words.meaning: 无论是火车站还是机场，爷爷总是说他会自个儿设法到这里。
这里面都是爷爷的东西吗？

words.word: But I'm sure he has a few bags with him on the train.
words.meaning: 不过我相信他在火车上还有几件行李的。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第3集 · 04 整理房间与行程变动
decks.section: 第3集 · 迎接祖父、旅途交谈与家庭团聚

words.word: I want to put some of my good hangers in Grandpa's closet.
words.meaning: 我想在爷爷的衣橱里放几个好的衣架。

words.word: You know I'm very excited about his arrival.
words.meaning: 你知道我对他的到来是多么兴奋。

words.word: She's unhappy because she's had to go to Chicago on a business trip and can't leave till tonight.
words.meaning: 她不开心，因为必须去芝加哥出差，直到今晚才能离开。

words.word: She wants to be here for Grandpa.
Well, Grandpa will be disappointed, too.
She always reminds him of Grandma.
Fine. We were just wondering about this trunk.
words.meaning: 好啦。我们正纳闷这只大衣箱呢。

words.word: Oh. I have the key. Grandpa sent it to me.
words.meaning: 啊。钥匙在这里。爷爷寄来给我的。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第3集 · 05 列车上认识同乡
decks.section: 第3集 · 迎接祖父、旅途交谈与家庭团聚

words.word: Excuse me. Is this seat taken?
words.meaning: 对不起，请问这个座位有人吗？

words.word: Oh, let me help you with this.
Do you want to sit by the window?
No, no, no. I like the aisle seat better.
words.meaning: 不，不，不。我喜欢坐在靠过道的地方。

words.word: Please, you sit by the window.
My name is Stewart... Malcolm Stewart.
I'm Elsa Tobin. How do you do?
Do you live in New York?
I am, too. But didn't you just get on?
words.meaning: 我也是。可是你不是刚上车的吗？

words.word: No, no. I just changed my seat.
words.meaning: 不，不。我刚才换了一下座位。

words.word: A man next to me was smoking, and smoke really bothers me.
words.meaning: 我旁边的那个人抽烟，我受不了。

words.word: Where are you from in Florida?
words.meaning: 你从佛罗里达的什么地方来？

words.word: Small world. I'm from Titusville, too.
words.meaning: 世界真小。我也是从Titusville来的。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第3集 · 06 聊家庭、工作与退休
decks.section: 第3集 · 迎接祖父、旅途交谈与家庭团聚

words.word: My husband and I live near Spaceport.
My house is only a few miles from Spaceport.
Oh yes, yes. My husband's there now.
words.meaning: 啊，对，对。我丈夫现在就在那儿。

words.word: He couldn't take time off to come to New York with me.
words.meaning: 他走不开，没办法和我一起来纽约。

words.word: No. I sold the house and the furniture, put a few personal things in an old trunk, and shipped it to my children in New York.
words.meaning: 不。我把房子和家俱都卖了，剩下一些东西放进一个旧衣箱，运到我孩子那儿去了，他们住在纽约。

words.word: My wife died four years ago.
She was a wonderful woman. A real friend.
words.meaning: 她是个很好的女人，一个真正的朋友。
我为你难过，真的为你难过。
留下的是许多美好的回忆。

words.word: We were married almost fifty years.

words.meaning: 我们结婚四十周年纪念日

words.word: John and I celebrate our fortieth anniversary next month.
words.meaning: 下个月John和我将庆祝我们的结婚四十周年纪念。

words.word: He's an aerospace engineer and works for Orlando Aircraft Corporation.
words.meaning: 他是航空航天工程师，在 Orlando 飞机公司工作。

words.word: He started with them almost forty years ago.
words.meaning: 他在那里做了快四十年了。

words.word: I just retired. Had my own company.
words.meaning: 我刚退休，以前自己开公司。

words.word: A construction company. Roads, bridges, big stuff.
words.meaning: 一家建筑公司，修路、建桥，都是大工程。

words.word: But I just sold it and retired.
words.meaning: 我前不久把它卖了，然后退休。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第3集 · 07 查票与介绍家人
decks.section: 第3集 · 迎接祖父、旅途交谈与家庭团聚

words.meaning: 对不起，太太，车票请拿出来看一下。

words.word: Would you kindly hold these keys, please?
I have a ticket, I know.
I was in the smoking section.
words.meaning: 我原本坐在吸烟车厢的。

words.word: It's OK, lady. Take your time.
I'm sure it's in your purse, Mrs. Tobin.
words.meaning: 我相信是在你的皮包里，Tobin太太。

words.word: Do you have family in New York?
No, no. But I do have very close friends in New York City.
words.meaning: 没有。我在纽约有很要好的朋友。

words.word: We like to go to the theater together.
You said you have family in New York.
A son and his wife and their three children-- my grandchildren.
words.meaning: 有个儿子，还有儿媳妇以及他们的叁个孩子—我的孙儿女们。

words.word: I can't wait, to see them!
words.meaning: 我恨不得马上见到他们。

words.word: Are you going to live with them?
words.meaning: 您打算和他们一起住吗？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第3集 · 08 独立生活与抵站
decks.section: 第3集 · 迎接祖父、旅途交谈与家庭团聚

words.word: too early to know for sure
Well... they want me to, but it's too early to know for sure.
words.meaning: 这……他们希望这样。但我现在还不能决定。

words.word: I tried to teach my kids the importance of independence, but I'm not sure I want to be alone.
words.meaning: 我总是告诫孩子们独立的重要。但我不知道我是否想一个人生活。

words.word: Some people don't mind being alone. I do.
words.meaning: 有些人不在乎独自生活，我在乎。

words.word: I retired because... I wanted to be with my family.
words.meaning: 我退休是因为……我想和全家人在一起。

words.word: didn't want to be alone anymore
I didn't want to be alone anymore!
words.meaning: 我不想再一个人独自生活了。

words.word: Ladies and gentlemen, Amtrak is happy to announce our arrival in New York City.
words.meaning: 各位女士，各位先生，我们很高兴报告诸位，Amtrak火车就要到达纽约了。

words.word: The train will be stopping in five minutes.
words.meaning: 火车将在五分钟后靠站，

words.word: check to be sure you have your belongings
words.meaning: 检查确认带齐随身物品

words.word: Please check to be sure you have your belongings.
And have a good stay in the Big Apple.
It was so nice meeting you, Mr. Stewart.
And nice meeting you, too, Mrs. Tobin.
words.meaning: 我也很高兴见到你，Tobin太太。
我们家的电话号码你可以在电话簿上查到。

words.word: That's right. And have a good time in New York.
words.meaning: 对。祝你在纽约玩得愉快。
也别太坚持凡事都自己来。

words.word: You're very lucky to have a caring family.
words.meaning: 你很幸运有一个温馨的家庭。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第3集 · 09 欢迎与赠礼
decks.section: 第3集 · 迎接祖父、旅途交谈与家庭团聚

words.word: Robbie, we'll go fishing soon, and we'll take your dad with us.
words.meaning: Robbie啊，我们很快就会去。带你爸爸也一起去。

words.word: I'm ready, Grandpa. You name the day.
words.meaning: 我准备好啦，爷爷。哪一天随你挑吧。
现在把我们的礼物送给爷爷吧。

words.word: I looked all over the house to find it.
words.meaning: 我找遍了整间屋子才找到它。

words.word: This one really brings back memories.
words.meaning: 这一张的确唤起了许多的回忆。

words.word: I sure do. It was fun.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第3集 · 10 旅途疲劳与安顿
decks.section: 第3集 · 迎接祖父、旅途交谈与家庭团聚

words.word: Oh, I'm sorry Susan isn't here.
She called to say the plane was delayed.
words.meaning: 她打电话回来，告诉我们飞机误点。

words.word: I can't wait to see her.
She looks just like Grandma at that age.
words.meaning: 她和她奶奶年轻时候长得一模一样。
我还是先把行李打开吧。

words.word: I started traveling twenty-four hours ago.
words.meaning: 从出门到现在已经二十四小时了。

words.word: Don't you want something to eat?
After a good night's sleep, I'll enjoy breakfast even more.
words.meaning: 好好睡一觉，明早吃早餐会更香。

words.word: Ellen and I'll take you to your room.
I'm sure glad you're here, Grandpa.
words.meaning: 您来这里我真高兴，爷爷。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第3集 · 11 打开箱子与赠送家谱
decks.section: 第3集 · 迎接祖父、旅途交谈与家庭团聚

words.word: Philip, do you have the key to the trunk?
words.meaning: Philip ，衣箱的钥匙在你那里吗？

words.word: I have the key, but it doesn't work.
words.meaning: 我有钥匙，但是开不开箱子。

words.word: I have something for you. I made it myself.
words.meaning: 我有件东西给你们，是我亲手做的。

words.word: I researched it for over a year.
Why, I didn't know that your grandfather was born in Germany.
words.meaning: 你看，我竟然不知道您的爷爷出生在德国。

words.word: Lots of interesting information about our family.
words.meaning: 里面很多我们家有趣的东西呢，

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第3集 · 12 团聚与归属感
decks.section: 第3集 · 迎接祖父、旅途交谈与家庭团聚

words.word: Oh, Grandpa, I'm so happy to see you!
words.meaning: 啊，爷爷，见到您我真高兴。

words.word: Oh, you look so beautiful, Susan. My granddaughter.
words.meaning: 啊，你真漂亮，Susan， 我的好孙女。

words.word: Like I always said, you look just like Grandma.
words.meaning: 我老是说，你真像你奶奶。

words.word: I think you're going to be very happy here with us.
words.meaning: 我想你和我们住在一起会很愉快的。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第4集 · 01 比较两种运动
decks.section: 第4集 · 健身挑战、预约与承认失误

words.word: I am exhausted. My new exercise class is so hard.
words.meaning: 我太累了。我那新的健身班太难了。

words.word: Yeah. My new advanced exercise class.
My instructor thought that the beginner's class was too easy for me.
words.meaning: 老师认为初级课程对我来说太容易了。

words.word: Don't laugh. In the beginner's class, they give you a chance to rest between exercises.
words.meaning: 别笑。初级班里，动作与动作之间有机会休息。
高级课程里是没有休息的。

words.word: I lift weights every morning for sixty minutes without stopping.
words.meaning: 我每天早上举重六十分钟，一刻不停。

words.word: Listen, Richard, doing aerobics for an hour is a lot different than lifting weights.
words.meaning: 听着，Richard，一小时的有氧运动可与举重大不相同。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第4集 · 02 提出挑战
decks.section: 第4集 · 健身挑战、预约与承认失误

words.meaning: 我觉得有氧运动很容易。

words.word: I could work out in your class with no problem.
words.meaning: 如果我去你的班上做运动，一定不会觉得有问题。

words.word: Tomorrow morning at ten o'clock. Try it.
words.meaning: 明早上午十点。来试一试吧。

words.word: Tomorrow morning after lifting weights, I'll try aerobics.
words.meaning: 明早举完重，我去试试有氧运动。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第4集 · 03 约定赌注与打电话
decks.section: 第4集 · 健身挑战、预约与承认失误

words.word: Aren't you going to the aerobics class this morning?
words.meaning: 今天上午你不是去上有氧运动课吗？

words.word: not going to be able to move
You are not going to be able to move after this and the aerobics class.
words.meaning: 你会动都动不了的，在你做完这个，又去上有氧运动课之后。

words.word: It's going to be a piece of cake.
I bet I can go one hour in your class this morning and not feel a thing!
words.meaning: 我打赌我今天上午到你的健身班运动一小时之后，丝毫不累。

words.word: The bet is -- I win, and you cook dinner for the entire family.
words.meaning: 这样赌好了——要是我赢了，全家晚餐你来煮。

words.word: Or you win, and I cook dinner for the entire family.
words.meaning: 要是你赢了，我替全家做晚餐。

words.word: Ok. Call my instructor, Jack Davis, right now.
words.meaning: 好，给我的老师Jack Davis打个电话，现在就打。

words.word: The advanced class starts at ten o'clock.
words.meaning: 高级健身课十点钟开始。

words.word: It only takes eight minutes by bicycle to the aerobics class.
words.meaning: 骑自行车去上有氧运动课只需要八分钟。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第4集 · 04 预约课程
decks.section: 第4集 · 健身挑战、预约与承认失误

words.word: Davis Aerobics Center for Good Health.
My wife, Marilyn Stewart, is a member of your program.
words.meaning: 我太太 Marilyn Stewart 是你们课程的学员。

words.word: I'd like to come to the ten o'clock advanced class this morning.
words.meaning: 我想今早十点来上你的高级健身班。

words.word: Oh, fine, fine. Be here a few minutes early.
words.meaning: 啊，好，好。请早几分钟到这。

words.word: You need to complete some forms before the class.
words.meaning: 上课之前你得填一些表格。

words.word: Thanks. I'm on my way over.
Bye-bye. It's all set. I'm going.
words.meaning: 再见。都安排好了。我现在就去。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第4集 · 05 课前沟通
decks.section: 第4集 · 健身挑战、预约与承认失误

words.word: Your pressure is 120 over 75, and that's fine.
When was your last complete physical?
words.meaning: 上一次全身检查是什么时候？

words.word: Good. Do you have any back or knee problems?
words.meaning: 好。你的背部和膝关节有什么毛病吗？

words.word: Nope. I am in perfect health.
What do you do for a living
What do you do for a living, Mr. Stewart?

words.meaning: 很有意思。你拍些什么样的照片呢？

words.word: Everything. The American scene. People, places, events.
words.meaning: 什么都拍。美国风光。人物、地方、事件。

words.word: Did you ever think of photographing an aerobics class?
words.meaning: 你想过拍摄有氧运动课吗？

words.word: No...I can't remember taking pictures of people exercising.
words.meaning: 没有，……我好像没有拍过人们练健身操的照片。

words.word: But don't you think it'd be a good subject?
words.meaning: 你不觉得这是个好题材吗？

words.word: I need some good photos for my advertising, Mr. Stewart.
words.meaning: 我做广告需要一些好照片，Stewart先生。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第4集 · 06 合作提议与课堂口令
decks.section: 第4集 · 健身挑战、预约与承认失误

words.word: Maybe you can photograph a class, and I can give you and Mrs. Stewart a month of classes--free.
words.meaning: 也许你来拍一次上课的情形，我让你和你太太免费上一个月的课。

words.word: When can I photograph a class?
Yeah. Yeah. Let's get in our lines.
We're going to take it slow first.
Stretch up...and we're going to go left first ...
Sunrises. Stretch it out.  Flat back.
words.meaning: 双手捧日。尽量伸展。平背拉回。

words.word: Bring it up ... and twists ... and side ... 2, 3 ...
and left ... push ... push ... turn ... hit the floor.
Take it side again .... OK, and switch. Stretch it out.
words.meaning: 再侧身……好，左右交替。尽量伸展。
逐渐放缓运动，做放松整理

words.word: And we're going to warm down with a tango.
words.meaning: 我们用探戈舞步来舒缓，

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第4集 · 07 询问身体感受
decks.section: 第4集 · 健身挑战、预约与承认失误

words.word: Richard, did you go to the Davis Aerobics class today?
words.meaning: Richard，你去上Davis有氧运动健身课了吗？

words.word: Yes, I went to the aerobics class today.
words.meaning: 去了啦，我上了有氧运动课了。

words.word: Nothing. I am in excellent health.
I have ideal blood pressure. A perfect heart.
words.meaning: 我血压正常得很，心脏也很好。

words.word: In other words, I'm in wonderful condition.
Richard, did you go to the aerobics class, really?
words.meaning: Richard，你真的上了有氧运动课吗？

words.word: And don't forget to invite Susan for dinner.
What about your arms? Lift your arms up like this.
words.meaning: 你胳膊怎么样?手抬起来，像这样。

words.word: And they don't hurt--not even a little?
You are in great condition. I can't believe it!
words.meaning: 你的身体太好啦。我简直不敢相信。

words.word: Grandpa, Ellen, Philip, Robbie, you and me.

words.word: She said if I come by, she'll help me find another dog.
words.meaning: 她说，如果我去一趟，她会帮我另外找一只狗。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第8集 · 01 协调时间安排
decks.section: 第8集 · 住院沟通、安慰与兑现惊喜

words.word: Molly, I need your special talent for handling special matters.
words.meaning: Molly，我需要你处理特殊状况的特殊才能。

words.word: Well, I have a scheduling problem.
words.meaning: 嗯，我在排工作方面遇到困难。

words.word: I have three tonsillectomies set for Friday with Dr. Earl.
words.meaning: 我和 Earl 医生已经安排好星期五做三台扁桃体切除手术。

words.word: fit a fourth operation into his schedule
words.meaning: 在他的日程中再安排第四台手术

words.word: I need to fit a fourth operation into his schedule.
words.meaning: 我得在他的工作表上再加第四个手术，

words.word: And ... I know you can do it.
The boy has infected tonsils, and we should remove them as soon as possible.
words.meaning: 这孩子的扁桃腺受到感染了，我们要尽快把它切除。

words.word: Well, I'll try to arrange the schedule, Dr. Stewart.
words.meaning: 好吧，我尽力去安排，Stewart大夫。

words.word: But it's not going to be easy.
I know you'll be able to take care of it.
words.meaning: 我知道你能够处理好这件事。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第8集 · 02 表达担心与解释安排
decks.section: 第8集 · 住院沟通、安慰与兑现惊喜

words.word: Well, Mrs. Herrera, Carl will be perfectly fine after we remove his tonsils.
words.meaning: 好，Herrera太太，切除扁桃腺之后， Carl会完全恢复健康的。

words.word: Thank you for your reassurance, Dr. Stewart.
words.meaning: 谢谢你消除了我疑虑， Stewart大夫。

words.word: He's had so many colds and sore throats recently.
words.meaning: 他最近常常感冒喉咙痛。

words.word: Well, it's a very easy operation, Carl.
But when do they do it?
Well, we could reschedule the operation, Mrs. Herrera, but I don't want to put it off too long.
words.meaning: 这样吧，我们可以重新安排手术，Herrera太太。但我希望不要拖得太久。

words.word: No, I think it's important to do it now.
words.meaning: 不，我觉得还是应该现在动手术。

words.word: have a birthday party for you
We can have a birthday party for you, Carl, When you come out of the hospital.
words.meaning: 我们可以给你举行生日派对， Carl。在你病好出院后。

words.word: But it won't be on my birthday.
words.meaning: 但是那就不是在我生日那天了。

words.word: But your health is more important, Carl. Believe me.
words.meaning: 可是你的身体更重要，Carl，相信我的话。

words.word: I don't want my tonsils out.
Nurse Baker, would you come in, please?
words.meaning: Baker护士， 请你来一下， 好吗？

words.word: Hello, Mrs. Herrera. Hi, Carl, how you doing?
words.meaning: 你好， Herrera太太，嗨，Carl， 你怎么样啦？

words.word: I don't want my tonsils out.
You and I will talk this over.

words.meaning: 与孩子相处的一套特别方法

words.word: She has a special way with kids.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第8集 · 03 安慰与设法解决
decks.section: 第8集 · 住院沟通、安慰与兑现惊喜

words.word: OK. Do you want to get better?
OK. We want you to get better, too.
words.meaning: 我们也希望你能恢复健康。

words.word: You'll have your tonsils out tomorrow, and you won't get so many colds anymore.
words.meaning: 明天， 你的扁桃腺一切除，你就不会老患感冒了。

words.word: But if I have my tonsils out tomorrow, I'll miss my birthday party on Saturday.
words.meaning: 但是，我如果明天切除扁桃腺，就会错过星期六我的生日派对。
这确实是个问题，不是吗？

words.word: Let me try to work something out.
I have to think about it.
a chance to think about it
Give me a chance to think about it, and I'll come up with something.
words.meaning: 给我一个机会想一想，我会想出个办法的。

words.word: put on your pajamas and robe
But you just put on your pajamas and robe, and I'll think of a surprise.
words.meaning: 不过你先穿上睡衣和晨袍，我来想个惊喜。

words.word: There are other boys and girls here, and they're having their tonsils out.
words.meaning: 还有其他男孩女孩在这里，他们也将切除扁桃腺，

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第8集 · 04 学习比手画脚游戏
decks.section: 第8集 · 住院沟通、安慰与兑现惊喜

words.word: Do you know how to play charades?
Carl, you're sure you've never played?
words.meaning: Carl，你肯定你从来没玩过吗？

words.word: Frank, you can learn as we go.
And, Carl, you join in at any time.
words.meaning: 还有Carl，你随时都可以加入。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第8集 · 05 猜词与回应
decks.section: 第8集 · 住院沟通、安慰与兑现惊喜

words.word: The first word sounds like no.
words.meaning: 第一个词的发音像 no。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第8集 · 06 拼出完整答案
decks.section: 第8集 · 住院沟通、安慰与兑现惊喜

words.word: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
words.meaning: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs［白雪公主和七矮人］

words.word: Betty, you had it, but you didn't say it.
words.meaning: Betty，你知道答案，但是你没有说出来。
Carl，现在你知道什么是哑谜了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第8集 · 07 处理不满与冲突
decks.section: 第8集 · 住院沟通、安慰与兑现惊喜

words.meaning: 你为什么不加入我们的游戏呢？

words.word: Between now and tomorrow you're all going to have your tonsils out.
words.meaning: 从现在起到明天，你们都要切除扁桃腺。

words.word: And you won't be able to speak for a while.
words.meaning: 有一段时间，你们没有办法讲话。

words.word: So save your voices till then.

words.meaning: 这群孩子可不太好应付。

words.word: I didn't want to play charades, so they're angry at me.
words.meaning: 我不想玩哑谜，所以他们生我的气。

words.word: Why don't you want to play?
Because I don't want to be here.
I don't want my tonsils out.
a birthday party with a clown
words.meaning: 有小丑表演的生日聚会

words.word: My mother promised me a birthday party with a clown.
words.meaning: 我妈妈答应给我办一个有小丑的生日派对。

words.word: But you can have one when you go home, Carl.
words.meaning: 但你回去以后还可以办一个呀，Carl。
但是我的生日就在明天。

words.word: Carl, you'll have your party when you go home,
words.meaning: Carl，你回去以后就可以开个生日派对了。

words.word: But it won't be on my birthday!
words.meaning: 但那就不是在我生日那天了！

words.word: And you promised me a surprise.
words.meaning: 而且你答应给我一个惊喜。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第8集 · 08 关心与提供晚餐
decks.section: 第8集 · 住院沟通、安慰与兑现惊喜

words.word: You'll feel better tomorrow, Betty, believe me.
words.meaning: 明天你就会好些， Betty， 相信我。

words.word: Only one day, and it won't hurt as much.
words.meaning: 只要再一天，就不会像现在这样痛了。
噢，别显得那么无精打采。

words.word: Let me tell you about your dinner.
I see you're feeling better already, Betty.
words.meaning: 我看得出来，你已经感觉好些了，Betty。

words.word: OK, honey, we'll see to it that you have strawberry and vanilla ice cream.
words.meaning: 好，亲爱的，我们一定设法让你吃到草莓和香草的冰淇淋。

words.word: You need some rest to help you get better quickly.
words.meaning: 你需要多休息， 好让你很快恢复。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第8集 · 09 沟通口味与数量
decks.section: 第8集 · 住院沟通、安慰与兑现惊喜

words.word: It doesn't hurt that much, does it?
Oh, I'm sorry it hurts so much, and you won't be able to have dinner.
words.meaning: 啊，我很抱歉， 你那么痛，你没有办法吃晚饭了。

words.word: You're just going to have to have ice cream.
Well, I see you're feeling better.
words.meaning: 嗯，我看得出你感觉好些了。

words.word: Well, at least you're acting like you feel better.
words.meaning: 不过，至少你表现得好像你感觉好多了。

words.word: Three scoops of chocolate ice cream for Tim coming up.
words.meaning: 给 Tim 的三球巧克力冰淇淋马上来。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第8集 · 10 承诺惊喜与约定
decks.section: 第8集 · 住院沟通、安慰与兑现惊喜

words.word: In the meantime, what would you like?
words.meaning: 在这期间，你想要点什么？
我答应过给你一个惊喜

words.word: I promised you a surprise, didn't I?
words.meaning: 我答应过要给你一件惊喜，不是吗？

words.word: And it wasn't just ice cream, was it?
words.meaning: 这惊喜还不仅是冰淇淋，对吗?

words.word: Your birthday is tomorrow, isn't it?
Well, maybe, just maybe, there will be a surprise.
words.meaning: 嗯， 或许，只是或许，会有一项让你惊喜的事。

words.word: But first you have to smile.
I just want to see one smile from you.
If you want a surprise, then you've got to smile first.
words.meaning: 如果你想要一项惊喜的事，你就得先笑一笑。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第8集 · 11 生日惊喜
decks.section: 第8集 · 住院沟通、安慰与兑现惊喜

words.word: Well, I'm glad you're feeling better because we have a little surprise for you today.
words.meaning: 我很高兴各位感觉好些，因为今天我们要给各位一项惊喜。
来给你们表演，让你们开心

words.word: we have Popo the Clown to entertain you
words.meaning: 我们请了小丑 Popo 来给你们表演

words.word: It's Carl's birthday, and we have Popo the Clown to entertain you.
words.meaning: 今天是Carl的生日，我们请了小丑Popo来给大家表演助兴。

words.word: And here he is--Popo the Clown.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第9集 · 01 写作与毕业心情
decks.section: 第9集 · 毕业、面试与自主选择

words.word: I thought you might be hungry.
a chicken sandwich and a glass of milk
words.meaning: 一个鸡肉三明治和一杯牛奶

words.word: I brought you a chicken sandwich and a glass of milk.
words.meaning: 我给你带了一个鸡肉三明治和一杯牛奶。

words.word: writing a story for the high-school paper
I'm writing a story for the high-school paper.
words.meaning: 我正在为高中校刊写一篇东西。

words.word: No, I have to turn it in in the morning.
words.meaning: 不行，明天上午我得交出去。

words.word: I'm writing an article on the feelings about graduation.
words.meaning: 我在写一篇关于毕业感想的文章。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第9集 · 02 成长与职业想法
decks.section: 第9集 · 毕业、面试与自主选择

words.word: The scary part's leaving home and moving to college.
words.meaning: 害怕的是要离开家搬到学校去。

words.word: Oh, leaving home is part of growing up.
words.meaning: 呵，离开家是成熟过程的一部分。

words.word: Well, maybe you should think about becoming a writer.
words.meaning: 那么，也许你应考虑成为一名作家。

words.word: You have lots of time to decide.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第9集 · 03 得知面试机会
decks.section: 第9集 · 毕业、面试与自主选择

words.word: "Hail to the victors valiant, Hail to the conquering heroes, Hail, Hail to Michigan, The champions of the West!"
words.meaning: “向勇敢的胜利者致敬，向进取的英雄们致敬，致敬，向Michigan致敬，西部的优胜者！”

words.word: Did the University of Michigan win another football game?
words.meaning: Michigan 大学又赢了一场橄榄球赛吗？

words.word: I just spoke with Charley Rafer.
He's the Dean of Admissions for the University of Michigan.
words.meaning: 他是 Michigan 大学的招生主任。

words.word: And it turns out he's a classmate of Philip's.
words.meaning: 有意思的是，他和Philip是同班同学。

words.word: We were both on the tennis team.
words.meaning: 我们都是网球队的队员。

words.word: He's going to be in New York tomorrow to interview applicants for admission.
words.meaning: 明天，他要在纽约与申请入学者面谈。
在他的日程里安排与你见面

words.word: And he's agreed to fit you into his schedule.
words.meaning: 他同意明天把你安排进他的面谈名单里。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第9集 · 04 表达保留意见
decks.section: 第9集 · 毕业、面试与自主选择

words.word: But I may not want to go to Michigan.
It's one of the best schools in the country, Robbie.
words.meaning: 这是全国最好的大学之一，Robbie。

words.word: Your grandfather went to the Engineering School there.
words.meaning: 你爷爷进那里的工学院。

words.word: You said you wanted to be a doctor like your father.
words.meaning: 你说过你希望像爸爸一样成为一名医生。

words.word: You couldn't pick a finer medical school than Michigan.
words.meaning: 你再也找不到一所比Michigan大学更好的医学院了。

words.word: Let's meet with Charley at the university club.
words.meaning: 我们就去大学俱乐部见见Charley吧。

words.word: It doesn't mean you're going to Michigan.
words.meaning: 这并不是说你就要去Michigan大学。

words.word: It doesn't mean you have to be a doctor.
words.meaning: 这并不意味着你一定要当医生。

words.word: But the interview will be good experience for you.
words.meaning: 但这次面谈对你来说是一次很好的经验。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第9集 · 05 争取自主决定
decks.section: 第9集 · 毕业、面试与自主选择

words.word: Dad, growing up means making my own decisions, doesn't it?
words.meaning: 爸爸，长大了意味着我自己能做决定，对吗？

words.word: But, like your Grandpa suggested, have the interview.
words.meaning: 但是，照你爷爷所建议的，去参加这次面谈。

words.word: And then make your own decision.
I know it's sudden, Robbie, but this is an important opportunity.
words.meaning: 我知道这件事很突然，Robbie。但这是一次很重要的机会。

words.word: We'll head down there first thing tomorrow morning.
words.meaning: 明早第一件事就是去那里，

words.word: I want you to know something, Son.
words.meaning: 我希望你知道一件事，孩子。

words.word: Well, I've got an appointment at the hospital.
I'll see you all at dinnertime.

words.meaning: 还有什么不对的地方吗，Robbie？

words.word: Going away to college for the first time always makes one a little nervous.
words.meaning: 第一次离家上大学总是让人有些紧张。

words.word: I'll be OK. I just need time to think.
words.meaning: 我会适应的，我只是需要时间思考。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第9集 · 06 面试前沟通
decks.section: 第9集 · 毕业、面试与自主选择

words.word: time for a cup of coffee
Sorry, Robbie. Sorry to be late this morning, but, well, we've still got some time for a cup of coffee.
words.meaning: 对不起，Robbie，对不起，今天早上迟了点，不过，我们还有喝杯咖啡的时间。

words.word: I can't wait to see my old pal Charley Rafer.
words.meaning: 我真想早点见到老朋友Charley  Rafer。

words.word: So you thought about it, huh?
I knew you'd realize that this interview could be an important experience for you.
words.meaning: 我知道你会体会到这次面谈是一次很好的经验。

words.word: Now let's head off for the city and the university club.
words.meaning: 现在，我们进城去，到大学俱乐部。

words.word: Thanks for hearing me out. And ...
words.meaning: 谢谢你听我把话说完。还有……

words.word: And thanks for being such an understanding father.
words.meaning: 而且谢谢你是这样一位善于了解我的父亲。

words.word: Well, thank you, Robbie. Thank you.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第9集 · 07 见面与寒暄
decks.section: 第9集 · 毕业、面试与自主选择

words.word: Charley Rafer--you look as young as ever.
words.meaning: Charley Rafer——你还像当年那样年轻。

words.word: Yes, this is my youngest son Robbie.
one of the best tennis players
Robbie, I want you to meet one of the best tennis players on the Michigan team-- Charley Rafer.
words.meaning: Robbie，我要你见过当年Michigan球队最好的网球选手—Charley Rafer。

words.word: Nice to meet you, Dean Rafer.
as good a tennis player as your dad
words.meaning: 网球打得和你父亲一样好

words.word: Well, are you as good a tennis player as your dad?
words.meaning: 嗯，你是否像爸爸那样是一名优秀的网球选手呢？

words.word: No, I'm not very good at it.

words.meaning: 坦白说，我当年也不怎么擅长。

words.word: Charley was the star of the team.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第9集 · 08 安排面试时间
decks.section: 第9集 · 毕业、面试与自主选择

words.word: She's still giving the toughest English history exams in the school and loving every minute of it.
words.meaning: 她仍用最艰深的英国史试题考学生，在学校里，且乐此不疲，时时如此。

words.word: And speaking of minutes, I have interviews until noon, so why don't we get right to work?
words.meaning: 谈到时间，我从现在到中午，有一系列的面谈，我们现在就开始工作，好吗？

words.word: Can you have lunch with us later?
words.meaning: 你能与我们一起共进午餐吗？

words.word: I'd love to, Philip, but I'm afraid I can't.

words.meaning: 与二十六名申请者的面试

words.word: I'm only here two days, and I have interviews with twenty-six applicants.
words.meaning: 我只有两天时间，而要面谈的申请人有二十六位。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第9集 · 09 正式面试
decks.section: 第9集 · 毕业、面试与自主选择

words.word: Did you bring your transcript from high school?
words.meaning: 你把高中的成绩单带来了吗？

words.word: I see under "activities" that you've been writing for the school paper.
words.meaning: 我注意到在「活动」项目中提到你为校刊写文章。

words.word: What kinds of articles have you written?
words.meaning: 你写过一些什么样的文章？
各种各样的—体育，社论，剧评。

words.word: You name it, I've written it.
Well, have you ever thought of becoming a journalist?
words.meaning: 好，你是否想过成为一名新闻从业人员？

words.word: Michigan has a fine School of Journalism.
words.meaning: Michigan大学有一个很好的新闻学院。

words.word: You seem to have some reservations.
It's been very nice talking to you.

words.meaning: 我也很高兴与您交谈，先生。

words.word: The most important thing is for you to decide your own future.
words.meaning: 最重要的是你要自己决定自己的未来。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第9集 · 10 与朋友比较选择
decks.section: 第9集 · 毕业、面试与自主选择

words.word: I had an interview today, too.
words.meaning: 我今天也参加了一次面谈。

words.word: I had a great interview with Admissions at Columbia University.
words.meaning: 我参加了一次很精彩的面谈与Columbia大学的招生人员。

words.word: Will you get into the school?
Well, they didn't say anything for sure.
words.meaning: 嗯，他们没有任何确切的答覆。

words.word: with my grades and with my personality
But I figure that with my grades and with my personality, I'll have no problem.
words.meaning: 不过我觉得，凭我的成绩和个性，应该没问题。

words.word: What are you going to do?

words.meaning: 听起来你对Columbia大学跃跃欲试？
下不了决心，下不了决心。

words.word: an important decision we have to make
words.meaning: 我们必须作出的重要决定

words.word: It's not easy, and this is an important decision we have to make.
words.meaning: 实在不容易，这又是我们必须做的一个重大决定。

words.word: How was your interview with Michigan?
words.meaning: 你跟Michigan大学的人面谈得如何？

words.word: My father would like me to go there.
He and my Grandpa both went there.
words.meaning: 他和我爷爷都曾在那里读书。

words.word: You can follow in your father's footsteps.
words.meaning: 你可以跟随你父亲的足迹。

words.word: Ah! I'd like to follow in my own footsteps, Mike.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第9集 · 11 表达真正兴趣
decks.section: 第9集 · 毕业、面试与自主选择

words.word: What do you want to study?
I think I want to study journalism to be a reporter--a newspaperman.
words.meaning: 我想学新闻学，将来当一名记者，一个新闻从业人员。

words.word: You do a pretty good job on the Riverdale High School paper.
words.meaning: 你在Riverdale高中校刊做得有声有色。

words.word: And I've been thinking about it a lot lately.
words.meaning: 最近我一直就此事想了很多。
和你父母讨论过这件事

words.word: Have you discussed it with your parents?
Hi, Son. Is everything all right?
I was just waiting for you to get home so we could talk.
words.meaning: 我正等你回来，好跟你谈谈。

words.word: Anything special you want to talk about?
words.meaning: 有什么特殊的事要谈吗？

words.word: save money for my college tuition
Well, I know you and Mom have given up a lot to save money for my college tuition.
words.meaning: 嗯，我知道你和妈妈省吃俭用，存钱准备我的大学学费。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第9集 · 12 解释选校理由
decks.section: 第9集 · 毕业、面试与自主选择

words.word: We want you to go to college, Robbie.
thought a lot about which college
words.meaning: 为选哪所大学考虑了很多
其中一所是哥伦比亚大学

words.word: Well, I've thought a lot about which college, and one of them is Columbia.
words.meaning: 嗯，我为了上哪一所大学想了很多，其中一所是Columbia大学。

words.word: First, they have an excellent School of Journalism.
words.meaning: 首先，他们有一所很优秀的新闻学院。

words.word: And your friends are planning to go to Columbia?
words.meaning: 而且你的朋友们也准备上Columbia大学，对吗？

words.word: Mike and I had a hamburger this afternoon, and we talked.
words.meaning: 今天下午，Mike和我一起吃汉堡，一起讨论。

words.word: Well, we talked about a lot of things.
He applied to Columbia, and his interview was very successful.
words.meaning: 他申请了Columbia大学，他的面谈很成功。

words.word: He thinks he'll be accepted, and he really wants to go there.
words.meaning: 他觉得他会被录取，他确实很想去那里。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第9集 · 13 坦诚表达疑虑
decks.section: 第9集 · 毕业、面试与自主选择

words.word: He told me he was very impressed with you.
words.meaning: 他告诉我他对你印象很好。

words.word: He told me you had some doubts about wanting to go to Michigan.
words.meaning: 他告诉我你对上Michigan大学有些疑虑。

words.word: not sure about what I want to do
I'm just not sure about what I want to do.
words.meaning: 我只是还不确定自己想做什么。

words.word: Let me tell you something, Robbie.
Something that might be surprising to you.
words.meaning: 一件也许会让你吃惊的事。

words.word: Well, Grandpa wanted me to study engineering, like him.
words.meaning: 嗯，爷爷希望我像他一样学工程，

words.word: Well, I wasn't clear about my future, but I knew engineering was not for me.
words.meaning: 我对自己的未来当时也不清楚，但我知道工程对我不合适。
那你是如何对爷爷说的呢？

words.word: not wanting to go into medicine
Then you're not upset about my not wanting to go into medicine?
words.meaning: 那你不会因为我不想学医而不高兴吧？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第9集 · 14 互相理解与保留选择
decks.section: 第9集 · 毕业、面试与自主选择

words.word: I'm just happy that we're able to talk about it.
words.meaning: 我很高兴我们能够一起商讨这件事。

words.word: I suppose you want to apply to Columbia.
Yes, but I also want to apply to several other colleges.
words.meaning: 是的，但我还想申请几所其他的大学。

words.word: I thought you wanted to go to Columbia.
words.meaning: 我还以为你只想上Columbia大学。

words.word: Well, I might want to go to Columbia.
I just want to be able to make my own decision.
And if I think about it long enough, you never know ...
words.meaning: 如果我一直考虑下去的话，说不定……

words.word: If I make my own decision, I might choose Michigan.
words.meaning: 如果我自己作决定的话，我说不定选择Michigan大学。

words.word: You know, when I was your age, I said exactly the same thing to Grandpa.
words.meaning: 要知道，当我像你这么大的时候，我跟你爷爷说了同样的话。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第10集 · 01 确认当天任务
decks.section: 第10集 · 工作日程、重新安排与亲密沟通

words.meaning: 今天的工作是怎么安排的？
给 FAO Schwarz 打电话

words.word: Ten o'clock, telephone FAO Schwarz about the new twin baby dolls.
words.meaning: 十点钟，打电话给FAO Schwarz谈关于双胞娃娃玩具的事。

words.word: Telephone Mrs. Zaskey at the advertising agency.
words.meaning: 打电话给广告公司的 Zaskey 太太。
我已经打了。 继续说。

words.word: Eleven o'clock, approve the sketches for the toy spaceship.
words.meaning: 十一点钟， 批示玩具太空船的草图。

words.word: What do you think of the spaceship?
words.meaning: 你觉得那个太空船怎么样？

words.word: I think the kids'll love it.
Would you show me the drawings, please?
words.meaning: 请把草图给我看看好吗？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第10集 · 02 安排会面与会议
decks.section: 第10集 · 工作日程、重新安排与亲密沟通

words.word: Now, what else is on the schedule today?
words.meaning: 那么， 今天的工作表上还有些什么?

words.word: a lunch appointment with Mr. Levine
words.meaning: 和 Levine 先生的午餐约会

words.word: Well, at one o'clock you have a lunch appointment with Mr. Levine, the client from the Toytown Stores.
words.meaning: 嗯， 一点钟，你跟Levine先生约好吃午餐，这个客户来自Toytown Stores。

words.word: a meeting with the production staff
At four o'clock, you have a meeting with the production staff in the conference room.
words.meaning: 四点钟，你要在会议室和生产部门的员工开会。
每个人都参加那个会议

words.word: Make sure everybody is at that meeting.
words.meaning: 要确定每一位都出席这次会议。

words.word: At six you're meeting, Mr. Ozawa.
Oh, yes. Are his models here?
words.meaning: 噢， 对啦。 他的模型在这里吗？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第10集 · 03 反思忙碌与查漏
decks.section: 第10集 · 工作日程、重新安排与亲密沟通

words.word: When was your last day off?
words.meaning: 你上次休假是在什么时候？

words.word: ought to take some time off
You really ought to take some time off.
To enjoy the simple things in life ...

words.meaning: 闻闻花香，放慢脚步享受生活。

words.word: Oh, wait a minute. What's today's date?
words.meaning: 噢， 等一等， 今天几号？

words.word: It seems to me I scheduled something else.
words.meaning: 好像我还安排了什么别的事情。

words.word: There's nothing else in the appointment book.
words.meaning: 在工作日志里没有别的事了。
我确信我安排了什么事。

words.word: Oh, well, I'll probably remember it later.
words.meaning: 噢， 也许过一会我会记起来。
好吧， 我们开始工作。
给 Priscilla Smith 打电话

words.word: Would you call Priscilla Smith at FAO Schwarz, please?
words.meaning: 请拨电话给FAO Schwarz的Priscilla Smith， 好吗？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第10集 · 04 准备资料与提醒时间
decks.section: 第10集 · 工作日程、重新安排与亲密沟通

words.word: These are the models from the Japanese film maker.
words.meaning: 这些是那位日本电影制片家那里的模型。

words.word: Thank you. Just put them on my desk.
words.meaning: 谢谢。 把它们放在我桌上。

words.word: And the new drawings for the toy spaceship.
words.meaning: 还有玩具太空船的新草图。
我们找来了一位新的美工人员。

words.word: What time is my lunch date with Bill Levine?
words.meaning: 我与Bill Levine 约好的中饭时间是几点？

words.word: Remind me to leave at twelve forty-five.
words.meaning: 提醒我十二点四十五分走。

words.word: Did you remember your other appointment for today?
words.meaning: 你还记得今天的另一个约会吗？

words.word: too late when I do remember
words.meaning: 等我真想起来时已经太晚

words.word: No, but I have a feeling it's going to be too late when I do remember.
words.meaning: 记不起来了。但我觉得等我想起来时已经太晚了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第10集 · 05 发现午餐撞期
decks.section: 第10集 · 工作日程、重新安排与亲密沟通

words.meaning: 我刚刚把那个谜底解开了。

words.word: You have some guests in the reception room.
words.meaning: 你有几位客人在接待室等你。

words.word: Mr. Harry Bennett and his daughter.
words.meaning: Harry Bennett 先生和他女儿。

words.word: I made a lunch date with him and his daughter weeks ago.
words.meaning: 几星期前我约好和他以及他女儿共进午餐。

words.word: Well, he's here with his daughter to have lunch.
words.meaning: 嗯，他和他女儿已到这里等吃午餐了。

words.word: I met her at Thanksgiving, and I promised to have lunch with both of them today.
words.meaning: 我在感恩节与她见面，我答应今天和他们共进午餐。
你与 Levine 先生的约定

words.word: What are you going to do about your appointment with Mr. Levine?
words.meaning: 那你打算怎么处理与 Levine 先生的约会？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第10集 · 06 迎接朋友与照顾情绪
decks.section: 第10集 · 工作日程、重新安排与亲密沟通

words.word: It's nice to see you again.
We have both been excited about seeing you and having lunch with you today.
words.meaning: 我们两个很高兴见到你，并与你一起吃中餐，

words.word: picked these flowers out for you
Michelle picked these flowers out for you.
We're going to go to lunch in a few minutes, honey.
words.meaning: 我们一下子就去吃中餐， 亲爱的。

words.word: OK. You go out and get a drink of water at the fountain.
words.meaning: 好。你出去在饮水机那儿喝点水吧。

words.word: The fountain is over there, Michelle.
I used to be that way when I was her age.
words.meaning: 我像她这般年纪也是这样。

words.word: Harry, if Michelle doesn't want to go, we don't have to.
words.meaning: Harry，如果Michelle不想去，我们不必勉强。

words.word: Remember, I haven't dated any one else since her mother died.
words.meaning: 别忘了，自从她母亲去世之后，我从没有和别人约会过。

words.word: This is a little difficult for her.
words.meaning: 这对她来说有点不习惯。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第10集 · 07 电话改约
decks.section: 第10集 · 工作日程、重新安排与亲密沟通

words.word: Yes. But could you wait one minute?
words.meaning: 是的。不过，你能等一下吗？

words.word: I have a call to make.
Sam, get Mr. Levine at Toytown Stores on the telephone for me, please.
words.meaning: Sam，请帮我接通 Toytown Stores 的 Levine 先生。

words.word: Hello. Susan Stewart calling Mr. Levine, please.
I find myself in an embarrassing situation.
words.meaning: 我现在有一件很糗的事。

words.word: enter it in my appointment book
I made another lunch date for today and forgot to enter it in my appointment book.
words.meaning: 我和别人约好共进午餐，但忘了写到工作日志里。

words.word: Can you and I meet for drinks tomorrow?
words.meaning: 我们可以改在明天见面喝点东西吗？

words.word: I'd really appreciate it.... Yes.... Thank you....
words.meaning: 我非常感激……好的……谢谢你……

words.word: Tomorrow at five o'clock at the Biltmore.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第10集 · 08 点餐与家庭回忆
decks.section: 第10集 · 工作日程、重新安排与亲密沟通

words.word: Welcome to the South Street restaurant, folks.
words.meaning: 欢迎光临南街餐馆，各位。

words.word: Well, the crab salad's always a big hit.
words.meaning: 嗯， 蟹肉沙拉一向是广受欢迎的。

words.word: Susan, would you like the crab salad?
Michelle, would you like to try the crab salad, too?
words.meaning: Michelle，你要不要也试试蟹肉沙拉？

words.word: We'll have three crab salads and a pitcher of lemonade.
words.meaning: 我们要三份蟹肉沙拉和一壶柠檬水。

words.word: Help yourself to celery and carrots and other vegetables.
words.meaning: 请你们自己盛芹菜、胡萝卜和其他蔬菜。

words.word: We had a summer house on Fire Island.
words.meaning: 我们在火岛有一所避暑别墅，

words.word: You and Mommy used to take me on the ferryboat.
words.meaning: 你和妈妈常带我坐渡船。

words.word: Sometimes, at night, we would go down to the beach and catch crabs, remember?
words.meaning: 有时候，在夜里，我们走到海边抓螃蟹，记得吗？

words.word: a piece of meat on a string
words.meaning: 一根绳子上拴着的一块肉

words.word: With a piece of meat on a string!
words.meaning: 用一根绳子拴着一点肉！

words.word: Well, I think I'm going to go get us all some vegetables.
words.meaning: 好啦，我想我去给大家盛点蔬菜来。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第10集 · 09 与孩子坦诚交谈
decks.section: 第10集 · 工作日程、重新安排与亲密沟通

words.word: Michelle, can I help you with the lemonade?
Michelle, can we have a talk?
I know you miss your mother.
Yes. And I'm not trying to take her place.
Then why are you and Daddy spending so much time together?
words.meaning: 那为什么你和爸爸老是在一起呢？

words.word: And right now, he needs a friend.
words.meaning: 而且现在，他需要一个朋友

words.word: And so are you, I think.
I'd like to be your friend, too.
Will you let me be your friend, Michelle?
words.meaning: 你愿意让我成为你的朋友吗，Michelle？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第10集 · 10 面对工作与休闲的取舍
decks.section: 第10集 · 工作日程、重新安排与亲密沟通
decks.shortName: 10 面对工作与休闲的取舍

words.word: So, what were you two talking about?

words.meaning: 只是女孩子之间的悄悄话
只是女孩子之间的谈话，爸爸。
差一刻四点，即三点四十五分

words.word: Oh, it's a quarter to four, and I have a production meeting at four.
words.meaning: 噢，差十五分就四点了，我四点钟有个生产会议。

words.word: I planned to take you for a ride in Central Park in a horse and carriage.
words.meaning: 我原打算带你去中央公园坐马车。

words.word: Harry, I'd love to, but I have work to do.
words.meaning: Harry，我确实想去，但我有工作要做。

words.word: OK. We'll walk back to your office with you.
words.meaning: 好吧，我们陪你走回你的办公室去。
暂且忘掉我的会计工作烦恼

words.word: I decided to forget about my accounting problems and just enjoy this beautiful spring day.
words.meaning: 我已决定不再去想那些会计上的问题，尽情享受这美好的春天。

words.word: I know I should, but ... well, there are too many things to do.
words.meaning: 我知道应该这样，但是……我要做的事情太多了。

words.word: I'll go for a ride with Michelle.
Well, I had a really nice time.
I'm sorry you can't come with us, Susan.
words.meaning: 很遗憾你不能同我们一起去，Susan。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第10集 · 11 委托同事与调整安排
decks.section: 第10集 · 工作日程、重新安排与亲密沟通

words.word: wait till I make a phone call
Harry! Michelle! Can you wait till I make a phone call?
words.meaning: Harry！ Michelle！ 你们等一下让我打个电话好吗？

words.word: The production department's waiting in the conference room.
words.meaning: 生产部门的人正在会议室等你。

words.word: Ask Paul Smith to fill in for me.
He knows everything about the production schedule, and he can answer any questions.
words.meaning: 他知道生产进度的一切情况，他也可以回答任何问题。

words.word: taking a little time to smell the flowers
words.meaning: 抽点时间放慢脚步享受生活

words.word: Don't tell any one, but I'm taking a little time to smell the flowers.
words.meaning: 别告诉别人，我正利用一点时间轻松一下。
这只是你我之间的秘密。

words.word: But schedule another production meeting for tomorrow.
words.meaning: 务必安排在明天举行另一次生产会议。

words.word: I'll be back for my six o'clock appointment with Mr. Ozawa.
words.meaning: 我会回来参加六点钟与Ozawa先生的约见。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第10集 · 12 轻松收尾
decks.section: 第10集 · 工作日程、重新安排与亲密沟通

words.word: That's a secret ... between us women.
words.meaning: 这是个秘密……我们女人的秘密。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第11集 · 01 征求独立居住的意见
decks.section: 第11集 · 独立居住、看房与贷款沟通

words.word: Well, Richard and I feel that with a baby coming we need to have our own place to live.
words.meaning: 嗯，Richard和我觉得孩子快要出生了，我们应该有自己的房子。

words.word: at this point in our lives
looking for a small house or an apartment
words.meaning: 寻找一栋小房子或一套公寓

words.word: Well, what do you think about Richard and me looking for a small house or an apartment at this point in our lives?
words.meaning: 那么，在人生这个阶段，你觉得 Richard 和我找一栋小房子或一套公寓怎么样？

words.word: We love having you here, and there is room, and ... and when the baby comes, the baby can stay in your room for a while.
words.meaning: 我们喜欢你们住这里，这里有地方，而且……而且婴儿出生以后，可以住在你们房间一段时间。

words.word: Richard feels we need to find a small house.
words.meaning: Richard觉得我们需要一个小住宅。

words.word: I remember when I was pregnant with Richard.
Philip and I were living with Grandma and Grandpa.
words.meaning: Philip与我和爷爷、奶奶住在一起。
一栋属于我们自己的房子

words.word: Philip was a young doctor, and he kept talking about having a house of our own.
words.meaning: Philip当时是个年轻的大夫，他老说要有自己的家。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第11集 · 02 回忆第一次买房
decks.section: 第11集 · 独立居住、看房与贷款沟通

words.word: We looked at a lot of houses.
lend us the money to buy one
words.meaning: 借钱给我们买一栋房子

words.word: Grandpa wanted to lend us the money to buy one, but Philip is too independent.
words.meaning: 爷爷要借给我们钱去买房子，但是Philip的独立性太强了。

words.word: He didn't want to borrow any money.
He's independent, and sometimes just stubborn.
words.meaning: 他的独立性强，有时候甚至近乎顽固。

words.word: When did you buy a house?
words.meaning: 那你们在什么时候买房子呢？

words.word: I was teaching music, and Philip was opening his first medical office.
words.meaning: 我当时教音乐，而Philip则第一次开诊所。

words.word: Of course, it was a small house, but just right for us.
words.meaning: 当然，那是一栋小房子，但正好够我们住。
马上负担得起一栋房子

words.word: Now Richard and I are having a baby, and we probably won't be able to afford a house right away, either.
words.meaning: 现在 Richard 和我也快有宝宝了，而我们可能同样无法马上买得起房子。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第11集 · 03 寻找信息与求助
decks.section: 第11集 · 独立居住、看房与贷款沟通

words.word: Why don't you look at some houses, Marilyn?
words.meaning: 你何不去看一看房子呢，Marilyn？

words.word: Look in the real-estate section of Sunday's Times.
words.meaning: 查一查星期天的《纽约时报》房地产版，

words.word: Maybe we should speak to a real-estate agent about a house.
words.meaning: 也许我们应该和房地产仲介商谈一谈关于房子的事。

words.word: And a bank about a mortgage.
I'll talk to Richard about it.
I think it's a good idea, Ellen.
We can learn a lot by asking.
words.meaning: 我们到处问问会学到不少东西。

words.word: And if I can be of any help, let me know.
words.meaning: 如果我能有所帮忙的话，告诉我。

words.word: As a matter of fact, my friend Virginia Martinelli is a real-estate agent.
words.meaning: 事实上，我的朋友Virginia Martinelli就是个房地产仲介。
把我们的第一栋房子卖给我们

words.word: You won't believe this, but she sold us our first house and this one.
words.meaning: 你简直不会相信，我们的第一栋房子和这一栋都是她卖的。

words.word: Well, I'll tell Richard, and we'll go to see her.
words.meaning: 嗯，我会告诉Richard，我们会去找她。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第11集 · 04 设计服装与不必着急
decks.section: 第11集 · 独立居住、看房与贷款沟通

words.word: Do you think the skirt length is right, Ellen?
words.meaning: 你觉得这裙子长度合适吗？

words.word: Do you think it's too long?
I think the skirt is just right.
Are you planning to attach a train to it?
No. No train. Just the dress.
words.meaning: 不，不加拖尾。只做这条连衣裙。

words.word: But I am going to make a headpiece of lace.
words.meaning: 但我准备做一个蕾丝头饰。

words.word: And thanks for the advice about the house.
words.meaning: 也谢谢你关于房子的建议。

words.word: I'll talk to Richard about it the minute he comes home.
words.meaning: 他一回家，我就跟他商量这件事。

words.word: And remember, we love having you here.
words.meaning: 记住，我们喜欢你们住这里。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第11集 · 05 与中介交流背景
decks.section: 第11集 · 独立居住、看房与贷款沟通

words.word: I remember your parents' first house very well.
words.meaning: 我还清楚记得你父母的第一栋房子。

words.word: It was on Spring Avenue, near the park.
words.meaning: 那房子是在Spring Avenue，公园附近。

words.word: I grew up in that house.
words.meaning: 我就在那栋房子长大的。

words.word: Yes, and you were such a cute baby.
words.meaning: 对，你当时是个很逗人喜爱的婴儿。

words.word: I've been friendly with the Stewart family for a long time, so it's my pleasure to help you find a house now.
words.meaning: 我和Stewart家有交情很久了，所以现在我很乐意帮助你们找房子。

words.word: Well, we're not sure we can afford one.
words.meaning: 嗯，我们还不知道是不是负担得起。

words.word: But we'd like to find out about the possibilities.
words.meaning: 但我们想知道有多大的可能性。

words.word: I love your house on Linden Street.
words.meaning: 我喜欢你们家在Linden街的房子。

words.word: I sold your father that house seventeen years ago.
words.meaning: 十七年前我把那栋房子卖给你父亲的。

words.word: Yes, Mom was pregnant with Robbie then, and they needed the extra room.
words.meaning: 是的，那时妈妈怀着Robbie，他们需要多一些空间。

words.word: I hear you're expecting a baby, Mrs. Stewart.
words.meaning: 我听说你们快有小孩了，Stewart太太。

words.word: So we will be needing more room.
words.meaning: 所以我们也将需要更大的空间。

words.word: Oh, so you don't need something immediately?
words.meaning: 呵，所以你们并不是急着马上就要。

words.word: No. But in five or six months ...
words.meaning: 不急。但是在五、六个月后……

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第11集 · 06 预算、地点与偏好
decks.section: 第11集 · 独立居住、看房与贷款沟通

words.word: information about your salaries and your savings
words.meaning: 有关你们工资和储蓄的信息

words.word: Well, when you called, you gave me enough information about your salaries and your savings.
words.meaning: 嗯，你们打电话来时，已经给了我充分的资料关于薪资和储蓄。

words.word: So I have a good idea about your financial situation.
words.meaning: 所以，我对你们的财务状况很了解。

words.word: Let me show you some pictures of houses.
words.meaning: 我来给你们看看一些房子的照片。

words.word: Yes, I think I can show you some.
words.meaning: 是的，我有 一些可以给你们看。

words.word: Of course, they won't be in Riverdale.
The cost of housing's too high for you here.
words.meaning: 这里的房子对你们来说太贵了。

words.word: I haven't thought about living anywhere else.
words.meaning: 我还没有考虑要住到别的地方去。

words.word: We've always lived in this area.
words.meaning: 我们一直住在这个地区。

words.word: Where should we look for a house, Mrs. Martinelli?
words.meaning: 我们应该到什么地方找房子，Martinelli太太？

words.word: Well, we have an office in Mount Kisco.
words.meaning: 好，我们在Mount Kisco有个办事处。

words.word: It's a lovely area, and it's only about an hour's drive from here.
words.meaning: 那里是个可爱的地方，而且从此地到那里只有大约一小时的车程。

words.word: I have a book with photos of some homes in that area.
words.meaning: 我有一本那个地区房子的照片。
在你们能承受的价格范围内
一栋漂亮的两卧室房子

words.word: This is a lovely two-bedroom house in your price range.
words.meaning: 这是一栋漂亮的两卧住宅，价格在你们的预算范围内。

words.word: It's pretty, but I prefer a two-story home.
words.meaning: 是漂亮，但我喜欢两层楼的房子。

words.word: I don't care for a ranch type.
words.meaning: 我不太喜欢牧场式的平层住宅。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第11集 · 07 比较房屋条件
decks.section: 第11集 · 独立居住、看房与贷款沟通

words.word: Oh, this is a wonderful house.
words.meaning: 啊，这是一栋很好的房子。

words.word: I sold it to the present owners.
words.meaning: 是我把它卖给了现在的主人。

words.word: This is a two-bedroom, two-bath house.
words.meaning: 这栋房子有两间卧室和两间浴室。
坐落在半英亩的地块上

words.word: It has a full basement, and it is on a half-acre lot.
words.meaning: 它有一个完整的地下室，坐落在半英亩的地块上。

words.word: You can probably afford this one.
words.meaning: 你可能负担得起这栋房子。

words.word: Would you like to go see it?
talk to someone at the bank
words.meaning: 和银行的工作人员谈谈

words.word: Yes. We're planning to talk to someone at the bank next week.
words.meaning: 是的。我们计划下星期与银行的人谈一谈。

words.word: Perhaps we could see the house this weekend.
words.meaning: 也许这周末我们会去看看这栋房子。

words.word: If someone doesn't buy it before then,
words.meaning: 如果在此之前没有人买走的话。

words.word: Just to get an idea of some other possibilities.
This is very helpful, Mrs. Martinelli.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第11集 · 08 继续比较选择
decks.section: 第11集 · 独立居住、看房与贷款沟通

words.word: This is a wonderful example of Spanish-style architecture.
words.meaning: 这是栋很棒的典型西班牙式建筑。

words.word: Oh, I love the roof tiles on a Spanish-style house.
words.meaning: 噢，我喜欢西班牙式房屋的屋顶瓦。

words.word: It looks like the houses in Hollywood.
words.meaning: 看起来好像是好莱坞的房子。

words.word: A house like this in Riverdale costs double the price.
words.meaning: 在Riverdale像这样的房子价格要贵一倍。

words.word: This house just came on the market.
words.meaning: 这栋房子刚刚推出要卖。

words.word: No. It has three bedrooms and three baths.
words.meaning: 不，它有三间卧室和三间浴室。

words.word: It has a brand new kitchen.
And a living room with a twelve-foot ceiling.
words.meaning: 还有一间天花板高十二英尺的客厅。
还有一个可放两辆车的车库。

words.word: Then why don't we go look at this house, too?
words.meaning: 那我们何不也去看看这栋房子？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第11集 · 09 感谢与带走资料
decks.section: 第11集 · 独立居住、看房与贷款沟通

words.word: Give my best to your parents.
Your father's a wonderful doctor, Richard.
words.meaning: 你父亲是个了不起的医生，Richard。

words.word: He took care of my daughter when she was a child.
words.meaning: 我女儿小时候曾由他照顾。

words.word: He's the best pediatrician in Westchester.
words.meaning: 他是全Westchester最好的小儿科医师。
我会向他们转达你的问候。
我们非常感谢你的建议。

words.word: I do think you should go see the houses and talk to the bank.
words.meaning: 我确实感到你们应该去看看这些房子并且和银行谈一谈。

words.word: Let me give you some information sheets about the houses.
words.meaning: 我给你们一些关于这些房子的简介。
这两栋都是价格便宜的。

words.word: Well, thanks so much for your help and your time, Mrs. Martinelli.
words.meaning: 好的，感谢你的帮助，占用了你的时间。Martinelli太太。

words.word: We've got a lot to talk about.
words.meaning: 我们有很多可商量的了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第11集 · 10 到银行说明来意
decks.section: 第11集 · 独立居住、看房与贷款沟通

words.word: I'm Richard Stewart, and this is my wife, Marilyn.
Please, sit down. What can I do for you?
words.meaning: 请坐下。我能为你们做什么呢？

words.word: We'd like to discuss a mortgage.
words.meaning: 我们想咨询一下住房抵押贷款。

words.word: Fine. Are you buying a house or are you refinancing your present home?
words.meaning: 好的。你们是要买房子呢，还是原有的房子重新申请贷款？

words.word: We're planning to buy a house.
And we'd like to find out about a mortgage.
words.meaning: 我们想了解一下住房抵押贷款。

words.word: We are customers of the bank.

words.meaning: 我们全家都在这里办理银行业务

words.word: As a matter of fact, my whole family banks here.
words.meaning: 事实上，我们全家都是贵行的顾客。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第11集 · 11 回答背景问题
decks.section: 第11集 · 独立居住、看房与贷款沟通

words.word: I have some questions to ask.
Do you own your house or do you rent?
words.meaning: 你们自己有房子还是租房子？

words.word: We live with my parents, Dr. and Mrs. Philip Stewart.
words.meaning: 我们和父母住在一起，我父母是Philip Stewart夫妇。

words.word: And, Mr. Stewart, what is your occupation?
And, Mrs. Stewart, are you working?
Yes. I'm a designer, and I work in a boutique.
words.meaning: 是的，我是位设计师，我在一家服装店工作。

words.word: Did you bring any savings or salary information?
words.meaning: 你是否带来储蓄和薪资的相关资料？
譬如去年的纳税申报表格？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第11集 · 12 询问贷款条件
decks.section: 第11集 · 独立居住、看房与贷款沟通

words.word: OK. What ... what kind of house did you have in mind?
words.meaning: 好的，你们打算买什么样的房子？

words.word: We're talking about buying a two-bedroom house in Mount Kisco.
words.meaning: 我们在商量购买一栋有两间卧室的房子，在Mount Kisco。

words.word: Here are the financial details on the house.
words.meaning: 这是这房子的财务细节。
支付百分之十的首付款

words.word: Are you prepared to make a ten-percent down payment?
words.meaning: 你们准备支付百分之十的首付款吗？

words.word: Do you think we can get a loan?
words.meaning: 你觉得我们能得到贷款吗？

words.word: Well, it depends. Do you own any other property?
words.meaning: 嗯，这还要看情况。你们拥有其他什么财产吗？

words.word: I see. Then you don't have any collateral.
words.meaning: 我明白了。那么你们没有任何担保物。

words.word: sign for the loan for you
words.meaning: 为你们的贷款作担保签字

words.word: Perhaps you could get a guarantor-- someone to sign for the loan for you.
words.meaning: 也许你们可以找一个担保人——为你们的贷款签字作保的人。

words.word: Since you don't have enough income, and you don't already own any property, the bank needs to be sure you can pay the mortgage every month.
words.meaning: 由于你们的收入不够，而你们又没有拥有其他财产，银行需要确定你们能每月按时付款。

words.word: A guarantor is responsible for the loan if you can't make the payments.
words.meaning: 如果你们无力按期还款，担保人就要对这笔贷款负责。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第11集 · 13 理解困难与复述问题
decks.section: 第11集 · 独立居住、看房与贷款沟通

words.word: I see. Well, the idea of buying a house is exciting.
words.meaning: 明白了。买房子的想法确实让人兴奋。

words.word: Thank you, Mr. Riley. We'll read this over carefully.
words.meaning: 谢谢你，Riley先生。我们会仔细阅读这些。

words.word: Good-bye. And hope to see you soon.
words.meaning: 再见。希望很快再见到你们。

words.word: It all sounded so easy until they mentioned needing collateral or a guarantor.
words.meaning: 本来一切听起来都很容易，直到他们提到需要抵押物或担保人。

words.word: ask Dad to sign as a guarantor
And I don't think it's a good idea to ask Dad to sign as a guarantor.
words.meaning: 而且我觉得请爸爸签字为我们担保不太合适。

words.word: I don't feel right about it.
I understand your feelings about it, Richard.
words.meaning: 我了解你对这种事的心情，Richard。

words.word: Now, tell me, what's the problem?
We can get a loan from the bank if we can put up some collateral.
words.meaning: 如果能提供一些抵押物，我们就能从银行获得贷款。

words.word: And we don't own anything to use as collateral.
words.meaning: 可是我们没有任何可以做担保物的东西。

words.word: Or someone can sign with us as a guarantor.
words.meaning: 或者有人能当担保人帮我们签字。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第11集 · 14 自主承担与接受支持
decks.section: 第11集 · 独立居住、看房与贷款沟通

words.word: Why don't you speak to Dad?
words.meaning: 你们为什么不跟爸爸说说看？

words.word: want to be able to handle it alone
words.meaning: 希望能独自承担这件事

words.word: No. If we buy a house, I want to be able to handle it alone.
words.meaning: 不，如果我们买房子，我希望能够自行负责。
每个人都有需要帮助的时候，Richard。

words.word: I understand Richard's feelings about it, Ellen.
In two or three months, I'll have an advance on my book and be able to put more money down.
words.meaning: 再过两三个月，我就能拿到书的预付款，付更多首付。

words.word: What about the house in Mount Kisco?
Somebody else'll buy it by then.
words.meaning: 到那时，别人会把它买走的。

words.word: Then there'll be other houses, Marilyn.
Richard has a point. You're just beginning to look.
words.meaning: Richard说得对。你们只是开始看房子而已。

words.word: We're in no great rush. It's true.
words.meaning: 我们并不很急，这是真的。

words.word: This has been a great learning experience for us, Marilyn.
words.meaning: 这对我们是一次很好的学习经验，Marilyn。

words.word: Talking to the loan officer at the bank.
words.meaning: 与银行的贷款负责人谈。

words.word: It has been a learning experience. That's true.
words.meaning: 这真是一次学习经验，真的。

words.word: I think you're doing the right thing. Taking your time.
words.meaning: 我觉得你们做得对。慢慢来，

words.word: Looking around. Especially with a purchase of this kind.
words.meaning: 到处看看，特别是这一类买卖。

words.word: You're talking about a lot of money.
words.meaning: 你们谈的可是一大笔钱。

words.word: We'll call Mrs. Martinelli and tell her to keep looking for us.
words.meaning: 我们会打电话给Martinelli太太告诉她继续帮我们物色房子。

words.word: And I'll call Mr. Riley at the bank and tell him we'll see him in a couple of months.
words.meaning: 我还会给银行的 Riley 先生打电话，告诉他我们过两个月再去见他。

words.word: And if you ever need Dad or me to help you ...
words.meaning: 如果你们的确需要我和爸爸的帮助的话，……

words.word: You know we'll be there for you.
words.meaning: 你们知道我们是会伸出援手的。

words.word: It's a Stewart tradition. We're a family.
words.meaning: 这是Stewart家的传统。我们是一家人。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第12集 · 01 近况与单独相处
decks.section: 第12集 · 退休后的生活、求职与经验分享

words.word: Am I glad to see you!
And am I glad to see you!
I am also glad to be here.
talking to a group of salesmen
I have been talking to a group of salesmen since ten this morning, and I'm real exhausted.
words.meaning: 我一直在与一群推销人员谈话，从今天上午十点起，我实在是精疲力竭了。

words.word: He and Michelle are visiting relatives in New Jersey today.
words.meaning: 他和 Michelle今天去 New Jersey拜访亲戚去了。

words.word: The rest of our family went to the movies.
words.meaning: 我们家里其馀的人都去看电影了。

words.word: So it's just you and me, Susan.
words.meaning: 所以，这里只有你和我， Susan。

words.word: It's nice to be alone with you, Grandpa.
words.meaning: 很高兴单独与你在一起，爷爷。

words.word: get to see enough of each other
words.meaning: 有足够的机会彼此见面

words.word: We don't get to see enough of each other.
words.meaning: 我们见面的时间不够多。

words.word: Oh, I feel the same way, Susan.
words.meaning: 噢，我也有同样的感受， Susan。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第12集 · 02 退休后的空闲与不安
decks.section: 第12集 · 退休后的生活、求职与经验分享

words.word: But to tell the truth, next time I'd like to go into the city and meet you there, instead of you coming here.
words.meaning: 但是，老实说，下一次我想到城里看你，而不是你到这里来，

words.word: You don't need to do that, Grandpa.
I need to get out more.
a lot to do around the house
Well, I mean there's a lot to do around the house, and I love being here with the family, you know, but I'm restless.
words.meaning: 我的意思是这屋里有很多事可做，而我也喜欢和家人在一起。你知道的，但我闲不住。

words.word: Since I retired, I've got extra time on my hands.
words.meaning: 自从我退休以后，我有过多空闲时间。

words.word: use my brain a little more
Frankly, I'd like to use my brain a little more.
words.meaning: 坦白地说，我想多用用我的脑子。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第12集 · 03 提出帮忙与寻找办法
decks.section: 第12集 · 退休后的生活、求职与经验分享

words.word: Grandpa, you have so much energy and so many years of experience.
words.meaning: 爷爷，你精力这么好，又有这么多年的经验。

words.word: There are probably a lot of places for you to work Particularly in the construction field.
words.meaning: 可能有不少地方适合你工作，特别是在建筑行业。

words.word: But at my age, I'm not looking for a full-time job.
words.meaning: 但是，像我这般年纪，我不会去找一个上全天班的工作。

words.word: Let's go into the kitchen, and maybe you can help me set the table.
words.meaning: 我们到厨房去，也许你能帮我摆桌子。

words.word: I prepared lamb chops, mashed potatoes, and a tossed green salad to begin with.
words.meaning: 我准备了羊排、土豆泥，先吃一份拌蔬菜沙拉。

words.word: Grandpa, you are a terrific guy!
You're still thinking about something to do, aren't you?
words.meaning: 你还在想要找点事做，是吗？

words.word: I've been thinking about it for weeks now.
words.meaning: 为这事我想了几个星期。

words.word: put my mind to good use
There must be some way to put my mind to good use.
words.meaning: 总会有办法让我发挥才智。
我们会找到解决的办法。

words.word: A positive solution to your finding a way to use that wonderful mind of yours.
words.meaning: 一个积极的解决办法，让你找到发挥才智的途径。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第12集 · 04 为家人寻求建议
decks.section: 第12集 · 退休后的生活、求职与经验分享

words.word: Sam, would you come in, please?
You sound like something's bothering you, Susan.
words.meaning: 听起来好像你有什么心事， Susan？

words.word: The sketches for the cover of the new doll book?
words.meaning: 是新玩偶图册封面的草图吗？

words.word: your advice on a personal matter
I need your advice on a personal matter, but it's not about me.
words.meaning: 我有件私事想听听你的建议，不过不是关于我自己的。

words.word: You need my advice on a personal matter, and it's not about you. OK.
words.meaning: 你有私事需要听我的意见，而且不是关于你自己的。好吧。

words.word: It won't sound like a big deal, but it is.
words.meaning: 这事听起来没啥严重，但实际上很要紧。

words.word: I had dinner with him Saturday, and he's very unhappy about not working.
words.meaning: 星期六我与他一起吃晚餐，他对没有工作感到怏怏不乐。

words.word: I thought he was retired and pleased to be living with the family.
words.meaning: 我原以为他退休了，乐于跟家人住在一起。

words.word: He is, but there's so much energy and talent in the man, and he doesn't get to use it.
words.meaning: 没有错。但是他有那么多的精力和才能，却又用不上。

words.word: What kind of advice are you looking for?
words.meaning: 你希望能得到什么建议？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第12集 · 05 想起可以请教的人
decks.section: 第12集 · 退休后的生活、求职与经验分享

words.meaning: John Marchetta 经营这家公司。

words.word: John Marchetta gave me my start here six years ago, When I first graduated from college.
words.meaning: 六年前我刚大学毕业时，John Marchetta 给了我在这里起步的机会。

words.word: He gave me the chance to use my talents and made me feel more confident.
words.meaning: 他提供给我施展才能的机会，使我对自己更加有信心。

words.word: do the same thing for your grandfather
Maybe he can do the same thing for your grandfather.
words.meaning: 也许他能为你爷爷做同样的事。

words.word: at least give him some advice
Or at least give him some advice.
words.meaning: 再不然至少可以给他一些忠告。
说来我替你解决问题了。

words.word: I can always depend on you, Sam.
words.meaning: 我知道我可以依靠你， Sam。
替你给 Marchetta 先生打电话

words.word: Shall I call Mr. Marchetta for you?
words.meaning: 要我替你打电话给 Marchetta先生吗？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第12集 · 06 提出会面请求
decks.section: 第12集 · 退休后的生活、求职与经验分享

words.meaning: 那么， Stewart全家人都好吗？
都很好，谢谢您，Marchetta 先生。

words.word: In fact, that is the reason why I'm here to see you.
words.meaning: 事实上，这是我来见你的原因。

words.word: I know you're building a new factory, and I thought ... maybe ... my grandfather is so experienced in the construction trade, he could be so valuable.
words.meaning: 我知道你在兴建一座新工厂，我觉得……也许……我爷爷在营造这一行业经验丰富，他或许能够有所用。

words.word: Tell him to come and see me at ten o'clock tomorrow morning.
words.meaning: 告诉他明天上午十点到这里来见我。

words.word: help a lot of other people
I have an idea that may solve the problem for him and help a lot of other people.
words.meaning: 我有个主意，也许能解决这个问题，并且对其他很多人有益。
我可以把这消息告诉他吗？

words.word: Ten o'clock in the morning. Here.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第12集 · 07 介绍工作背景
decks.section: 第12集 · 退休后的生活、求职与经验分享

words.word: told me a great deal about you
words.meaning: 跟我讲了很多你的情况

words.word: Susan has told me a great deal about you.
words.meaning: Susan告诉我许多关于你的事。

words.word: She says you're quite a man.
words.meaning: 她说你是个了不起的人。
