words.word: She says a lot of wonderful things about you too, Mr. Stewart.
words.meaning: 她也谈起不少你的非凡作为， Stewart先生。

words.word: That's always nice to hear, Mr. Marchetta.
words.meaning: 听到这事总是好的， Marchetta先生。

words.word: used to be in the construction business
I understand you used to be in the construction business.
words.meaning: 听说你过去在营造界工作。
在工作中积累的训练经验

words.word: Here's a brief description of forty-three years of on-the-job training.
words.meaning: 这是我四十三年来在工作中积累经验的一份简要介绍。

words.word: Half that time in my own construction company.
words.meaning: 一半时间是在我自己的营造公司。
大的工程——工厂、大型购物中心

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第12集 · 08 解释退休与重新工作
decks.section: 第12集 · 退休后的生活、求职与经验分享

words.meaning: 和我的孩子及孙辈在一起

words.word: spend more time with my children and grandchildren
words.meaning: 多花时间陪伴子女和孙辈

words.word: After my wife died, and I felt I should spend more time with my children and grandchildren.
words.meaning: 妻子去世后，我觉得应该多陪陪我的子女和孙辈。

words.word: I lived in Florida, and they lived in New York.
words.meaning: 我住在 Florida，而他们住在纽约。

words.word: My daughter Cami lives in New York.
When I came here, I planned to take a few months off.
words.meaning: 当我初到这里，我计划休息几个月。

words.word: Relax with the family and then look for some work.
words.meaning: 与家人轻松一段时间，然后找个工作。

words.word: work for a retired person my age
words.meaning: 适合我这个年纪退休者的工作

words.word: Put my experience on the line ... but, unfortunately, there isn't any work for a retired person my age.
words.meaning: 把我的经验真正用起来……可惜没有适合我这个年纪的退休者的工作。

words.word: Sometimes there is, and sometimes there isn't.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第12集 · 09 了解组织与填写资料
decks.section: 第12集 · 退休后的生活、求职与经验分享

words.word: Well, I'm involved with an organization, and we're trying to resolve that problem.
words.meaning: 嗯，我参加一个组织，试图解决这类问题。
T-O-P-S 全名是优秀老人协会。

words.word: I'd like to be a member.
The organization serves major companies in this city.
words.meaning: 这个组织为本市各大公司服务。

words.word: Because our members are men and women like you.
words.meaning: 因为，这个组织的会员都是像你这样的人。

words.word: go out there and use their talents
But our members want to go out there and use their talents.
words.meaning: 但会员们希望在社会上贡献他们的才能。

words.word: I've got an idea for you, Malcolm.
words.meaning: 我倒替你想出了一个主意， Malcolm。

words.word: Just fill out this form for me.
It'll only take a few minutes.
while I talk to my secretary
Sit right here, and do it while I talk to my secretary.
words.meaning: 就坐在这里填，我去和秘书说个话。

words.word: When I get back, we'll talk about my new factory.
words.meaning: 我回来后，我们谈一谈我的新工厂。

words.word: My company is a member of TOPS.
words.meaning: 我的公司也是优秀老人协会的会员，

words.word: So I try hard to find opportunities for people like you. Malcolm.
words.meaning: 所以我努力为像你这样的人寻找机会，Malcolm。
抓住这个机会采取行动

words.word: And when I see an opportunity, I can act on it.
words.meaning: 而一旦发现机会，我就能采取行动。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第12集 · 10 参观工地与加入团队
decks.section: 第12集 · 退休后的生活、求职与经验分享

words.word: Well, I can use your brainpower on the job right now.
words.meaning: 嗯，我马上可以将你的才智用在这项工程上

words.word: Have you got time this morning to go over to the construction site with me?
words.meaning: 今天上午你有时间去看一看建筑工地吗？

words.word: get some background on the job
words.meaning: 了解这项工程的一些背景

words.word: I'd like to have you meet my foreman-- get some background on the job.
words.meaning: 我希望带你去认识工头——了解这项工程的一些背景。

words.word: We'll go over to the job site together.
words.meaning: 我们等一会儿一起去工地。

words.word: Malcolm, you worked on the Spaceport project?

words.meaning: 我的公司承包了这项工程。

words.word: I built the theater there with my own two hands, practically.
words.meaning: 那里的剧院，几乎是我亲手建起来的。

words.word: Well, I'm glad to see you two guys getting along so well because, Danny, Malcolm is on the TOPS team.
words.meaning: 好的，看到你们两位相处得这么好我很高兴，因为Danny，Malcolm是 TOPS的一员。

words.word: working with you for a while
words.meaning: 和你一起工作一段时间

words.word: He's going to be working with you for a while.
words.meaning: 他将与你一起工作一段时间。

words.word: His experience will be valuable to both of us.
words.meaning: 他的经验对你我都很有用。

words.word: I'm going back to my office.
Give me a call later, Malcolm.
words.meaning: 请稍后打电话给我， Malcolm。

words.word: I'll tell you the time and date of the next TOPS meeting.
words.meaning: 我会告诉你下次 TOPS 聚会的时间和日期。

words.word: I'd like you to meet the group.
words.meaning: 我希望你能与协会的成员见面。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第12集 · 11 分享经验与解决问题
decks.section: 第12集 · 退休后的生活、求职与经验分享

words.word: be of some help to you
I know you didn't expect to have me around, but I think I can be of some help to you.
words.meaning: 我知道你没有预期我出现在你身边，但我觉得我可以对你略有帮助。

words.word: Let me tell you something, Malcolm.
some advice on a difficult problem
words.meaning: 关于一个难题的一些建议

words.word: With your background and experience, I can learn something ... and I do need some advice on a difficult problem.
words.meaning: 依你的背景和经验，我能学到一些东西。……我的确有一个难题要请教你。

words.word: studying these building plans more carefully
words.meaning: 更仔细地研究这些建筑图纸

words.word: I don't want to give you a final opinion without studying these building plans more carefully.
words.meaning: 没有更仔细地研究这些建筑图纸之前，我不想贸然下定论。

words.word: instead of redesigning the entire system
words.meaning: 而不是重新设计整套系统

words.word: But a simple solution might be to move the air-conditioning units instead of redesigning the entire system.
words.meaning: 但是，一个简单的解决办法可能是移动空调设备而不必重新设计整套系统。

words.word: It might be simpler and less expensive .
words.meaning: 这样可能比较简单而且省钱。

words.word: You just earned your weight in gold, Malcolm.
words.meaning: Malcolm，你可真是价值连城，帮了大忙。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第12集 · 12 分享喜悦与约晚餐
decks.section: 第12集 · 退休后的生活、求职与经验分享

words.word: I'm glad Mr. Marchetta was so helpful.
words.meaning: 我真高兴， Marchetta先生如此帮忙。

words.word: He actually took me to meet his foreman.
words.meaning: 事实上他带着我去见他的工头。

words.word: I don't know how to thank you, Susan.
words.meaning: 我不知道如何谢你， Susan。

words.word: good to see you so happy
It's good to see you so happy.
words.meaning: 能看见你如此高兴，太好了。

words.word: I'll be at the construction site tomorrow.
What are you doing tomorrow night?
How about a date with your grandfather?
I owe you a good steak dinner.
pick you up here at seven
I'll pick you up here at seven .
words.meaning: 我七点钟到这里来接你。

words.word: your first full day back on the job
words.meaning: 你重返工作岗位的第一个完整工作日

words.word: And you can tell me all about your first full day back on the job.
words.meaning: 到时候你可以把重返工作岗位的第一个完整工作日的经历都告诉我。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第13集 · 01 迎接新生命
decks.section: 第13集 · 迎接新生儿、家族记录与亲情

words.word: the arrival of a new baby

words.meaning: 没有什么比……更令人喜悦

words.word: There's nothing more joyous than the arrival of a new baby.
words.meaning: 没有任何事能比新生儿的到来更令人喜悦的了。

words.word: Just imagine--Marilyn and Richard must be thrilled!
words.meaning: 想像得出——Marilyn和Richard一定乐坏了！

words.word: Oh, it's a sweet-sounding name for a sweet little boy.
words.meaning: 噢，好一个甜美悦耳的名字，配个甜美的小孩。

words.word: He looks a lot like you, Mom. He does.
Well, I guess. He does look a lot like Richard, and I guess he looks a lot like me.
words.meaning: 嗯，有点像。他确实很像Richard，我看也蛮像我。

words.word: Oh, he's got Richard's eyes, though.
words.meaning: 噢，他的眼睛跟Richard的像极了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第13集 · 02 谈亲友与回家时间
decks.section: 第13集 · 迎接新生儿、家族记录与亲情

words.word: I really want Harry and Michelle to see Max.

words.meaning: 一项需要处理的客户账务

words.word: Tomorrow. Harry has an account to work on today.
words.meaning: 明天。Harry今天有项会计工作要做。

words.word: Yes, he does have Richard's eyes. Big blue eyes.
words.meaning: 是的，他的眼睛很像Richard。蓝色大眼睛。

words.word: The baby even looks at you like Richard does.
words.meaning: 这婴儿看你的时候也像Richard那样。

words.word: Well, children usually resemble their parents.
words.meaning: 嗯，孩子通常长得像父母。

words.word: Michelle is a lot like Harry in so many ways.
And she's shy with new people, just like he is.
words.meaning: 她见了生人就害羞，与他一样。

words.word: You really like Michelle, don't you?
Yes. I'm very fond of her.

words.meaning: 啊，已经四点半了。啊，天啦！

words.word: Marilyn and Richard will be home from the hospital any minute, and we must prepare this room.
words.meaning: Marilyn和Richard随时都会从医院回来，我们得收拾好房间。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第13集 · 03 布置房间与家庭归属
decks.section: 第13集 · 迎接新生儿、家族记录与亲情

words.word: Where will we put all the presents?
words.meaning: 我们把这些礼物放在哪里？

words.word: take everything to the living room
Well, let's take everything to the living room.
words.meaning: 嗯，我们把东西都放到客厅去。

words.word: Marilyn and Richard and the baby need the space.
The welcome sign is up: "Welcome home, Max."
words.meaning: 欢迎的标语已经弄好了：『欢迎你回家来，Max』。
延续 Stewart 家族的姓氏

words.word: Another generation to carry on the Stewart name.
words.meaning: 又一代人将延续 Stewart 家的姓氏。

words.word: proud to be part of our family
words.meaning: 为身为我们家的一员而自豪

words.word: You make me feel so proud to be part of our family.
words.meaning: 你让我以成为我们家庭的一员而自豪。

words.word: One day, you'll have your own family, and I'll be proud to be part of it.
words.meaning: 总有一天，你会有你自己的家，那时我会以成为你家的一份子而自豪。

words.word: Now you understand my feelings, Susan.
words.meaning: 现在你能理解我的感受了，Susan。

words.word: I'm Grandpa's daughter-in-law, but I feel like a Stewart.
words.meaning: 我是你爷爷的儿媳妇，但我觉得我是Stewart家的一员。
觉得自己就像他的亲生女儿

words.word: He's always made me feel like his own daughter.
words.meaning: 他总是让我觉得我是他的亲生女儿。

words.word: Well, that's because you're so much like us--wonderful!
words.meaning: 嗯，那是因为你太像我们了——你太好了！

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第13集 · 04 记录姓名与出生体重
decks.section: 第13集 · 迎接新生儿、家族记录与亲情

words.word: This will make a nice gift for Marilyn and Richard.
words.meaning: 这是给Richard和Marilyn的一件好礼物。
关于 Max 生活的资料

words.word: They can keep a record of all of the important dates and information about Max's life here.
words.meaning: 他们可以在这里记录 Max 一生中所有重要的日期和资料。

words.word: Does he have a middle name?
No, just Max. I like that.
No middle name. No middle initial.
words.meaning: 没有中间名，也就没有中间名的首字母。
与你姓名的首字母相同

words.word: And Max has your initials, Grandpa: M.S.
words.meaning: Max的名字开头字母与你的一样，爷爷，都是M.S.。
哦，这一定有什么特别的意义。

words.word: All the Stewart men were big.
words.meaning: Stewart 家的男人出生时个头都大。

words.word: Well, Robbie was eight pounds two ounces, and Richard was eight pounds three.
words.meaning: 嗯，Robbie 出生时八磅二盎司，Richard 是八磅三盎司。

words.word: You were big, just like Max.
Eight pounds six, just like me.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第13集 · 05 记录身长与准备迎接
decks.section: 第13集 · 迎接新生儿、家族记录与亲情

words.word: Richard says Max is twenty-one inches long.
Is that tall or average or what?
words.meaning: 这样尺寸是高呢，还是普通？或者算怎样？

words.word: Tall. All the Stewart men are tall.
Well, Grandpa, you're about five-nine or five-ten.
words.meaning: 嗯，爷爷，你大概五英尺九英寸或五英尺十英寸高。

words.word: I take after my mother's family.
words.meaning: 我像我母亲那边的家人。

words.word: They were ... they were ... they were average.
words.meaning: 他们……他们……他们是普通身材。

words.word: And lots of pages for Richard's photos of Max.
words.meaning: 有好多页可用来贴Richard给Max拍的照片。

words.word: Speaking of mother and of father
words.meaning: 说到孩子的母亲和父亲

words.word: Speaking of mother and of father --and speaking of Max--I hear the car.
words.meaning: 谈到孩子的爸，孩子的妈，——谈到小孩——我听见汽车声了。

words.word: Oh! Oh, quickly! Go, go, go!

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第13集 · 06 欢迎回家与离开安排
decks.section: 第13集 · 迎接新生儿、家族记录与亲情

words.meaning: 让我看看。噢，欢迎回家来。

words.word: Wait with your pictures for a second.
Oh, he's so cute! Oh, Marilyn!
happy to be home with my family
words.meaning: 高兴能回家和家人在一起

words.word: I'm so happy to be home with my family--and with Max.
words.meaning: 我真高兴回到家里和大家在一起——还有和Max在一起。

words.word: I've got to go. Tomorrow is Monday, and work begins at eight in the morning for me.
words.meaning: 我得走了。明天是星期一。早晨八点我就得开始工作。

words.word: Oh, I'm so happy that Max is home.
I'll drive you to the station, dear.

words.meaning: 赶上十点二十分的火车

words.word: You can catch the ten-twenty train to Grand Central Station.
words.meaning: 你能赶上开往Grand Central Station的十点二十分班车。

words.word: Then Grandpa, Robbie, and I can finish wrapping all these gifts.
words.meaning: 那么爷爷，Robbie和我可以把这些礼物包装完。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第13集 · 07 感受照顾与查看礼物
decks.section: 第13集 · 迎接新生儿、家族记录与亲情

words.word: It's so good to have you home again ... and to see Max asleep in his bassinet at home with us.
words.meaning: 真高兴你又回家了……真高兴看到Max和我们一起，睡在家里的摇篮。

words.word: To be with our family and all that Stewart TLC.
words.meaning: 真高兴和全家人在一起，受到Stewart家族无微不至的照顾。

words.word: with the teddy bears on them
Did you see the washcloth and the towels with the teddy bears on them?
words.meaning: 你看见上面有泰迪熊图案的小方巾和毛巾了吗？

words.word: Alexandra and the Molinas sent them for Max.
words.meaning: 那是Alexandra和 Molina全家送给Max的。

words.word: It was so kind of them.
Now Max has come into everyone's life.
words.meaning: 现在Max走进了每个人的生活里。
因为有他在而充满生气

words.word: The house is so alive with him here.
words.meaning: 有他在，整间房子都充满了生气。

words.word: The welcome sign over the door.
So cuddly. The beautiful crib from Mom and Dad.
words.meaning: 抱起来真舒服。爸爸、妈妈送的漂亮婴儿床。
噢，还有爷爷的棒球手套。

words.word: You know, it hung over my crib, too.
words.meaning: 要知道，我的小床上也曾挂过它。

words.word: And it hung over Robbie's crib.

words.meaning: 这是爷爷『魔法』的一部分吗？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第13集 · 08 谈手套的家庭故事
decks.section: 第13集 · 迎接新生儿、家族记录与亲情

words.meaning: 同 一个棒球手套吗？

words.word: That's right. Grandpa hangs it there for good luck.
words.meaning: 是的。爷爷把它挂在那里以求好运。

words.word: He says it always brought him good luck on the baseball team.
words.meaning: 他说，当年他在棒球队时这手套总是带给他好运。

words.word: He believes it'll bring good luck to all the Stewart babies.
words.meaning: 他相信这手套会给Stewart家所有的婴儿带来好运。

words.word: And then he takes it back when Max is ready to use it?
words.meaning: 那等 Max 长大能用这只手套时，他会把它收回去吗？

words.word: replaces it with a new glove
a new member of the Stewart family
Yes, and replaces it with a new glove so the old one will be ready for a new member of the Stewart family.
words.meaning: 对，然后用一只新手套换给 Max，旧的就能留给 Stewart 家下一位新成员。

words.word: Grandpa really loves his family, doesn't he?
words.meaning: 爷爷确实很爱这个家，是吗？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第13集 · 09 感谢礼物与邀请探望
decks.section: 第13集 · 迎接新生儿、家族记录与亲情

words.meaning: 这套婴儿装不是很可爱吗？

words.word: Thanks so much, Harry and Michelle.
Yes, I told Daddy to pick blue ones.
words.meaning: 是的。我告诉爸爸选蓝色的。

words.word: Blue is for boys, and pink is for girls.
words.meaning: 蓝色是男孩子的，粉红色是女孩子的。
而 Max 可真是个了不起的小男孩。

words.word: That was so thoughtful of you, Michelle. Especially to pick it out in blue.
words.meaning: 你想得真周到，Michelle，还特地选了一件蓝色的。

words.word: Would you like to see baby Max
words.meaning: 你想看看小宝宝 Max 吗

words.word: Would you like to see baby Max, Michelle?

words.meaning: 她能看看吗？我们能看看吗？

words.word: Harry and Michelle can watch Max sleeping.
Will you please take this upstairs, Susan?
words.meaning: 麻烦你把这个带上去好吗，Susan？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第13集 · 10 谈成长与家人相处
decks.section: 第13集 · 迎接新生儿、家族记录与亲情

words.meaning: 对一个十岁孩子来说很成熟

words.word: Michelle is very grown up for a ten-year-old, huh?
words.meaning: 以一个十岁的孩子来说，Michelle很成熟，是吗？

words.word: She's smart and sensitive for her age.
words.meaning: 以她的年龄来说，她很聪明，也很能体察别人。

words.word: Growing up without a mother is difficult.
words.meaning: 在没有母亲的情况下长大不简单。

words.word: Susan's like a mother to Michelle.
Do you think Susan and Harry will get married?
Yeah. You can count on it.
I think so. Yes. They get along so well.
words.meaning: 我也觉得是这样。是的，他们相处得很好。

words.word: I like him. He's good for Susan.
It's hard to do anything but listen in this family.
words.meaning: 在这个家庭里，除了听别人之外还能怎样。

words.word: How can anybody get a word in around here?
words.meaning: 在这里，谁能插得上话呢？

words.word: It's the way it should be.
They always were, and they always will be.
words.meaning: 他们过去如此，将来也永远会如此。

words.word: and if he talks as loudly as he cries, we're all in for trouble.
words.meaning: 要是他说话和哭起来一样响，我们可就有得受了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第13集 · 11 说话、睡眠与照顾
decks.section: 第13集 · 迎接新生儿、家族记录与亲情

words.word: It's not necessary to whisper, Harry.
words.meaning: 没有必要压低声音说话，Harry。

words.word: A baby gets used to voices.
words.meaning: 婴儿会逐渐习惯人们说话的声音。

words.word: We always whispered when Michelle was born.
words.meaning: 当Michelle出生的时候，我们总是压低嗓门说话。

words.word: And I didn't sleep well, Daddy told me.
words.meaning: 而我总是睡不好。爸爸告诉我的。

words.word: woke up when I heard someone speak
And when I did, I woke up when I heard someone speak.
words.meaning: 就算我睡着了，一听到有人说话我就醒了。
我打赌你当时很逗人喜爱。

words.word: Now I can help diaper him.
words.meaning: 我现在可以帮他换尿布了。

words.word: What do you do when he cries like that?
words.meaning: 像他哭得这个样子该怎么办？

words.word: Time for a feeding and time for a diapering.
words.meaning: 该喂奶、换尿布的时候了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第14集 · 01 比较城市和郊区
decks.section: 第14集 · 城市生活、游戏体验与求婚

words.word: You like living in New York, don't you?
I can take the bus to work ... or the subway ... or a taxi.
words.meaning: 我可以坐公共汽车上班……或者搭地铁……或者坐计程车。

words.word: And there's so much to do.
words.meaning: 而且这里总是有许多事可做。

words.word: Lots of movie houses, and the theater.
living in New Jersey and the suburbs
I'd like to live in the city, but living in New Jersey and the suburbs is better for Michelle.
words.meaning: 我也喜欢住在城里，但住在 New Jersey的郊区对 Michelle要好些。

words.word: There's a lot of good things about suburban living.
words.meaning: 郊区生活是有许多优点。

words.word: I grew up in Riverdale, remember?
words.meaning: 你记得吗？我就是在 Riverdale长大的，

words.word: But, as a working woman, I think New York has all the conveniences-- including the best tomatoes.
words.meaning: 但是就职业妇女来说，我觉得纽约具备了一切便利的条件——包括上好的蕃茄。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第14集 · 02 安排城市活动
decks.section: 第14集 · 城市生活、游戏体验与求婚

words.word: The truth is, I'd like to live in the city.
words.meaning: 老实说我也想住到城里来。

words.word: There are lots of things for her here.
words.meaning: 这里有许多适合她的东西。
今天就是一个很好的例子。

words.word: Michelle and her friends are at the aquarium in Brooklyn.
words.meaning: Michelle和她的朋友们在参观 Brooklyn的水族馆。

words.word: They come back here for lunch, then go uptown to the Museum of Natural History.
words.meaning: 他们回到这儿来吃午餐，然后再往北去自然历史博物馆。

words.word: There's so much for young people to see and do.
words.meaning: 这里有很多可供年轻人看和做的事情。
不仅仅对年轻人来说是这样。

words.word: I've never been to the aquarium or the Museum of Natural History.
words.meaning: 我从来没有去过水族馆或自然历史博物馆。

words.word: My mother and father often took us somewhere in the city on the weekends.
words.meaning: 我父母经常在周末带我们去城里的一些地方。

words.word: managed to squeeze a Sunday in
words.meaning: 设法挤出一个星期天的时间

words.word: Dad was a busy doctor, but he usually managed to squeeze a Sunday in with Richard, Robbie, and me.
words.meaning: 爸爸是个忙碌的医生，但他通常会设法挤出一个星期天，陪 Richard、Robbie 和我。

words.word: I used to love to go to the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
words.meaning: 我过去很喜欢去大都会美术馆。
其中两次是和 Michelle去的。

words.word: You ought to think about spending more time with Michelle at all the great places in the city.
words.meaning: 你应当考虑多花点时间陪 Michelle去城里所有的好地方看看。

words.word: Well, perhaps, you'll help me select some of the great places.
words.meaning: 好的，也许，你能帮我挑一些好地方。
也许你能跟我们一起去？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第14集 · 03 准备午餐与表达感谢
decks.section: 第14集 · 城市生活、游戏体验与求婚

words.meaning: 午餐的一切都准备好了， Harry。

words.word: I wish Michelle and her friends would get here.
words.meaning: 我希望 Michelle和她的朋友很快就到这里。

words.word: I can't wait to take a bite of the pumpernickel.
words.meaning: 我简直迫不及待想吃一口黑面包。

words.word: Come in, Michelle, and bring your friends along.
words.meaning: 请进， Michelle，请带你的朋友们进来。

words.word: your doing this for Michelle and her friends
words.meaning: 你为 Michelle 和她朋友做这件事

words.word: I really appreciate your doing this
words.meaning: 我非常感谢你做这件事

words.word: Susan, I really appreciate your doing this for Michelle and her friends.
words.meaning: Susan，我非常感谢你为 Michelle 和她朋友准备这一切。

words.word: I'm not just doing it for Michelle.
words.meaning: 我不仅是为 Michelle做这些，

words.word: I'm doing it for us, Harry.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第14集 · 04 表达关系中的在意
decks.section: 第14集 · 城市生活、游戏体验与求婚

words.word: Well, it's ... it's important for Michelle to see us together more often.
words.meaning: 是的，让 Michelle看到我们更常在一起是……是很重要的。

words.word: get to know each other better
It's important for Michelle and me to get to know each other better.
words.meaning: 这是很重要的，让Michelle和我彼此更了解。

words.word: Well, that you care about Michelle, that you care about me, and that you care about us.
words.meaning: 嗯，你关心 Michelle，关心我，也在意我们俩的关系。

words.word: Well, Harry, that's because I do.
words.meaning: 哦， Harry，那是因为我关心。

words.word: Susan, I'd like to continue this conversation later.
words.meaning: Susan， 我希望等一下能继续我们的谈话。

words.word: when they go to the museum
We'll finish the conversation when they go to the museum.
words.meaning: 他们去博物馆之后我们再聊。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第14集 · 05 迎接朋友和分享参观经历
decks.section: 第14集 · 城市生活、游戏体验与求婚
decks.shortName: 05 迎接朋友和分享参观经历

words.word: We had such a good time at the aquarium.
words.meaning: 我们在水族馆玩得真开心。
我看到一条真正的鲨鱼。

words.word: Hi. Michelle, why don't you introduce everybody to Susan?
words.meaning: 嗨， Michelle，何不将她们每一位介绍给 Susan？

words.word: I'd like you to meet Audrey
I'd like you to meet Audrey and her mother, Mrs. Cooper.
words.meaning: 我来向你介绍 Audrey和她母亲 Cooper太太。

words.word: Nice to meet you, Mrs. Cooper.
words.meaning: 很高兴见到你， Cooper太太。

words.word: And this is Shirley and Nicole.
I had never been there before.
words.meaning: 我以前从来没有去过那里。

words.word: The girls learned a great deal.
words.meaning: 女孩们学到了许多东西。

words.word: Well, please sit down and tell us all about it during lunch.
words.meaning: 嗯，请坐下来，一面吃午餐，一面告诉我们一切。

words.word: We prepared some tuna fish and cheese sandwiches for lunch.
words.meaning: 我们准备了金枪鱼和奶酪三明治作午餐。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第14集 · 06 介绍工作与测试游戏
decks.section: 第14集 · 城市生活、游戏体验与求婚

words.word: used to be a Girl Scout
I remember when I used to be a Girl Scout.
words.meaning: 我记得我还是一名女童子军的时候。

words.word: My mother would take us everywhere, too.
words.meaning: 我妈妈也是带我们各处走。

words.word: Susan, I understand you're in the toy business.
words.meaning: Susan，听说你是在玩具业工作。

words.word: My company manufactures toys and games for children.
words.meaning: 我们公司专为孩子们生产玩具和游戏器具。

words.word: in charge of new toys and games
words.meaning: 负责新玩具和游戏产品

words.word: Susan's vice-president in charge of new toys and games.
words.meaning: Susan是主管新玩具和新游戏器具的副总裁。

words.word: the marketing of new toys and games
words.meaning: 新玩具和游戏产品的营销

words.word: And the marketing of new toys and games.
words.meaning: 还有新玩具和新游戏器具的行销。

words.word: test a new game for you
Can we test a new game for you, Susan?
words.meaning: 我们可以帮你试验你的新游戏吗， Susan？

words.word: I happen to have a game which I brought home to study.
words.meaning: 我这儿碰巧有一项我带回来研究的游戏。

words.word: We tested it last week on twelve- to fifteen-year-olds, and they found it to be too easy-- in other words ... boring.
words.meaning: 我们上周让十二到十五岁的孩子试玩，他们觉得太简单，换句话说，就是无聊。

words.word: just right for ten- to twelve-year-olds
words.meaning: 正适合十到十二岁的孩子

words.word: We think it might be just right for ten- to twelve-year-olds.
words.meaning: 我们想它或许对十岁到十二岁大的孩子正合适。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第14集 · 07 说明游戏规则
decks.section: 第14集 · 城市生活、游戏体验与求婚

words.word: First, you shuffle the deck and lay them face down.
words.meaning: 首先，你得洗一下牌并将牌盖住。

words.word: The leader takes the first ten cards and lays them face up on this stand.
words.meaning: 领头的人拿最上面的十张牌，正面朝上放在这个架子上。

words.word: Everyone gets a turn, going counterclockwise, left to right.
words.meaning: 每个人依次轮流，按逆时针方向，从左到右。

words.word: You have thirty seconds to make a word, using as many letters as possible.
words.meaning: 你们有三十秒拼出一个单词，要用上尽可能多的字母。

words.word: You get one point for each letter, plus the person with the longest word gets ten extra points.
words.meaning: 每个字母得一分，单词最长的人还可额外得十分。

words.word: The first one to get one hundred points
words.meaning: 第一个得到一百分的人

words.word: The first one to get one hundred points wins.
words.meaning: 首先达到一百分的人赢。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第14集 · 08 轮流作答与计分
decks.section: 第14集 · 城市生活、游戏体验与求婚

words.word: OK, let's go around the table.

words.meaning: 到目前为止，你们都打成平手。
Sheet 是五个字母的单字。

words.word: for a total of sixteen points
Michelle wins with a six-letter word, plus she gets an additional ten points for a total of sixteen points.
words.meaning: Michelle 用一个六字母单词获胜，再加上额外十分，一共十六分。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第14集 · 09 坦率反馈与道别
decks.section: 第14集 · 城市生活、游戏体验与求婚

words.word: How are you enjoying the game so far?
words.meaning: 到现在为止，你们喜欢这个游戏吗？

words.word: She just said it's too easy.

words.meaning: 童子军队伍中的其他人

words.word: meet the rest of the troop
words.meaning: 与队伍里的其他人会合

words.word: Thank you so much, but we have to get going to meet the rest of the troop at two o'clock at the museum.
words.meaning: 非常感谢你。但我们必须走了，我们得在两点钟到博物馆与其他童子军会合。

words.word: Oh, it was nice meeting all of you.
words.meaning: 哦，很高兴会见你们各位。

words.word: I hope you have a wonderful time at the Museum of Natural History.
words.meaning: 希望你们在自然历史博物馆玩得开心。

words.word: See you in front of the museum at five o'clock.
And thanks again for the lunch and for the game.
words.meaning: 再次谢谢你们提供了午餐和游戏。

words.word: save our company a lot of money
words.meaning: 帮我们公司省下很多钱

words.word: You helped save our company a lot of money.
words.meaning: 你帮我们公司节约了许多钱。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第14集 · 10 重新谈共同关系
decks.section: 第14集 · 城市生活、游戏体验与求婚

words.word: Isn't there a conversation that we have to finish?
words.meaning: 我们不是有话还没说完吗？

words.word: There's a conversation we have to finish.
words.meaning: 我们有一段话还没有谈完呢。

words.word: I said that it makes me feel good that you care about Michelle.
words.meaning: 我是说我感到很高兴你关心 Michelle。

words.word: Well, I do care about Michelle.
And it makes me feel good that you care about me.
words.meaning: 而且你关心我，也让我感到很高兴。

words.word: And it makes me feel good that you care about us.
words.meaning: 你在意我们俩的关系，也让我感到高兴。

words.word: It's only natural that if I care about Michelle and I care about you, then I care about us.
words.meaning: 嗯，如果我关心 Michelle，也关心你，那我自然也在意我们俩的关系。

words.word: before Michelle and her friends arrived
words.meaning: 在 Michelle 和她朋友到来之前

words.word: We had this part of the conversation before Michelle and her friends arrived.
words.meaning: Michelle 和她的朋友们来之前，我们已经谈过这部分了。
现在最精彩的部分来了。

words.word: Well, assume that if you care about Michelle and you care about me and you care about us, that we can talk about us.
words.meaning: 嗯，既然你关心 Michelle、关心我，也在意我们的关系，那我们应该可以谈谈我们俩的事。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第14集 · 11 借游戏表达感情
decks.section: 第14集 · 城市生活、游戏体验与求婚

words.word: What are you trying to say
What are you trying to say, Harry?
What I'm trying to say ... since this is so easy ....
Here are ten letters that express my feelings for you.
words.meaning: 这里有十个字母可以表达我对你的感情。

words.word: the feelings that I feel for you
Seven letters ... two words ... that express the feelings that I feel for you in my heart.
words.meaning: 七个字母……两个词……表达了我心里对你的感情。

words.word: Well? Does that mean you'll marry me?
words.meaning: 噢？你的意思是你答应嫁给我了？

words.word: Is that a proposal, or are we just playing a game?
words.meaning: 这是求婚呢，还是仅仅在玩游戏？

words.word: There's something I have to ask you.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第14集 · 12 决定共同生活的下一步
decks.section: 第14集 · 城市生活、游戏体验与求婚
decks.shortName: 12 决定共同生活的下一步

words.meaning: 这是一个如此重要的决定。

words.word: There's so many things to talk about.
There are three things that have to be done first, Harry.
First, we have to decide where to live.
words.meaning: 首先，我们得决定住在哪里。
我们先前谈过这个问题。

words.word: Second, we have to talk to Michelle together about being married.
words.meaning: 第二，我们必须一起跟 Michelle谈谈我们结婚的事。

words.word: You have to ask for my father's permission.
words.meaning: 你必须徵得我父亲的同意。

words.word: We have to go pick up Michelle.
Not as happy as I am.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第15集 · 01 纪念日惊喜
decks.section: 第15集 · 结婚纪念、订房与调整旅行计划

words.meaning: 没赶上看他醒着的时候

words.word: I'm sorry I missed him. I had to work late.
words.meaning: 很抱歉我错过了他醒着的时候。我必须工作到很晚。

words.word: What are the flowers for, Richard?
Five years of happiness. Happy anniversary.
words.meaning: 为了五年的幸福。祝你结婚周年快乐！

words.word: But our anniversary isn't until Saturday.
words.meaning: 但是要到星期六才是我们结婚周年呀。

words.word: Besides, we are not going to be here Saturday.
words.meaning: 另外，我们星期六将不在这里了。

words.word: Where are we going to be?

words.meaning: 度过我们的结婚纪念日

words.word: all the places in the world
If you had your choice of all the places in the world. where would you choose to spend our anniversary?
words.meaning: 假如你可以选择世界上的任何地方。你会选哪里去度我们的结婚周年纪念日？

words.word: I loved that place when we went on our honeymoon.
words.meaning: 当初我们度蜜月时我便很喜欢那个地方。

words.word: Perfect! You picked the right place.
You and I, Mrs. Stewart, are going to spend a second honeymoon at the Watermill Inn.
words.meaning: Stewart太太，你和我。将到Watermill Inn去度第二次蜜月。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第15集 · 02 安排照顾孩子
decks.section: 第15集 · 结婚纪念、订房与调整旅行计划

words.word: taking the baby on our honeymoon
Aren't we taking the baby on our honeymoon?
words.meaning: 我们岂不是要带小宝宝一起去度蜜月？

words.word: take care of him for the weekend
has agreed to take care of him
The world's greatest grandmother, Mrs. Ellen Stewart, has agreed to take care of him for the weekend.
words.meaning: 世界上最伟大的祖母，Ellen Stewart太太，同意在周末照顾他。

words.word: too much to ask of your mother
words.meaning: 对你母亲提出的要求太多

words.word: Richard, isn't that too much to ask of your mother?
words.meaning: Richard，那是不是太麻烦你母亲啦？

words.word: Too much? She loves taking care of Max.
Well, we'll phone every hour, and you can listen to him over the phone.
words.meaning: 好了，我们每个小时都打电话，而且你可以在电话中听到他的声音。
只有两个人相处的浪漫周末

words.word: It's time you and I had a romantic weekend alone together.
words.meaning: 是我们俩单独在一起过一个浪漫周末的时候了。
这是我们努力后应得的享受

words.word: We've earned it. What do you say?
words.meaning: 这是我们应该享受的。你说呢？
你说得对，我们应该好好享受。

words.word: Great! I'll make a reservation right now.
words.meaning: 太好了！我现在就订房间。

words.word: with a view of the Hudson River
words.meaning: 可以看见哈得孙河的景色

words.word: Remember that wonderful little balcony where we had our meals ... with a view of the Hudson River?
words.meaning: 还记得那个美妙小阳台？我们用餐的地方……可以看到Hudson河？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第15集 · 03 电话订房与另找选择
decks.section: 第15集 · 结婚纪念、订房与调整旅行计划

words.word: My wife and I spent our honeymoon at the inn.
words.meaning: 我太太和我在你们旅馆度的蜜月。

words.word: No, we didn't leave anything in the room.
words.meaning: 不，我们没在房间里落下什么东西。

words.word: make a reservation for this weekend
We'd like to make a reservation for this weekend.
words.meaning: 我们想预订一个这个周末的房间。

words.word: Yes, a double room, please. What?
words.meaning: 对，双人房间，麻烦你。什么？

words.word: Can you recommend someplace nice--someplace nearby?
words.meaning: 你能给我们介绍一个好地方吗？——一个附近的地方？

words.word: half a mile down the road
He says there's another inn just half a mile down the road from the Watermill.
words.meaning: 他说还有另一家旅馆从Watermill往下走只要半英哩。

words.word: It won't be the same, but what do you say?
words.meaning: 那就不一样了，但你说呢？
这个周末有空照看孩子

words.word: My mom is available to baby-sit this weekend.
words.meaning: 我妈妈在这个周末可以照顾小宝宝。

words.word: Well, OK. See if they have a room.
words.meaning: 那，好吧，看看他们是否还有房间。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第15集 · 04 确认订房细节
decks.section: 第15集 · 结婚纪念、订房与调整旅行计划

words.word: Hello. Is this the Old Country Inn?
The desk clerk at the Watermill suggested your inn.
words.meaning: Watermill 旅馆的前台接待员向我们推荐了你们。

words.word: Would you happen to have a room for two available this weekend?
words.meaning: 你们可有一个双人房间这个周末？

words.word: My wife and I are celebrating our fifth anniversary.
words.meaning: 我太太和我要庆祝一下我们的结婚五周年。

words.word: Yes. I'll hold. He's checking. You do?
words.meaning: 好，我会等。他正在查。真的有了？

words.word: Great! What is the daily rate?
words.meaning: 太好了！每天的房价是多少？

words.word: Yes, we'll be arriving by car about ten o'clock Friday night.
words.meaning: 是的，我们将于星期五晚上十点钟左右开车抵达。

words.word: Done! You and I, Mrs. Stewart. are going to have a wonderful, romantic weekend!
words.meaning: 办到了！Stewart太太，你和我将度过一个美妙、浪漫的周末！

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第15集 · 05 面对不理想的房间
decks.section: 第15集 · 结婚纪念、订房与调整旅行计划

words.word: Right this way, Mr. and Mrs. Stewart.

words.meaning: 噢，它是小了点，但是乾净。

words.word: Thank you. I don't believe this.
get a look at the view
Well, it isn't the Watermill Inn, but let's get a look at the view.
words.meaning: 算了，这不是Watermill Inn，但让我们来瞧一瞧景色。

words.word: if you enjoy looking at a parking lot
words.meaning: 如果你喜欢看停车场的话

words.word: Great, if you enjoy looking at a parking lot.
words.meaning: 好得很，假如你喜欢看一个停车场的话。

words.word: Well, maybe we'll see the view in the morning.
words.meaning: 好了，也许我们可以在早晨看风景。

words.word: Right now, we should clean up this room.
words.meaning: 现在，我们应当清理一下房间。

words.word: Well, the rain, the room, the view of the parking lot.
words.meaning: 唉，这雨，这房间，这停车场的景色。

words.word: the way I hoped it would be
It isn't the way I hoped it would be.
After all, we're here, we're alone, we're together.
words.meaning: 毕竟，我们来到这儿了，我们又单独在一起了。

words.word: And I love you. Isn't that enough?
words.meaning: 我爱你。难道这还不够吗？

words.word: It is for me, but I wanted this weekend to be special for you.
words.meaning: 对我来说当然足够，但我希望这个周末对你来说很特别。
确实很特别。结婚周年快乐！

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第15集 · 06 没有客房服务怎么办
decks.section: 第15集 · 结婚纪念、订房与调整旅行计划

words.word: It's still raining. I want to play tennis.
words.meaning: 仍然在下雨。我想打网球。

words.word: figure out what to do today
Let's call room service and order a nice breakfast, and then we'll figure out what to do today.
words.meaning: 让我们打电话给房间服务部订一份可口的早餐。然后我们再决定今天做些什么。

words.word: Right. Would you give me room service, please?
words.meaning: 好。请接房间服务部好吗？

words.word: I beg your pardon? Oh, I see.
They don't have room service at Old Country Inn.
words.meaning: Old Country Inn没有房间服务部。

words.word: Well, let's go down to the coffee shop.
words.meaning: 哦，那我们下去咖啡厅吧。

words.word: They don't have a coffee shop.
We can get our meals at Mrs. Montefiore's down the road.
words.meaning: 我们可以沿大路走到Montefiore太太的旅馆去吃。

words.word: I love walking in the rain.
a really good sport about this
words.meaning: 面对这件事还这么豁达

words.word: Oh, you're being a really good sport about this, Marilyn, but I think we should face the truth.
words.meaning: Marilyn，你对这些事真豁达，不过我觉得我们应该面对事实。

words.word: This is not the way to spend our fifth anniversary.
words.meaning: 这不是我们过五周年纪念日的方式。

words.word: Well, what do you want to do?
Why don't we get in the car and drive home?
Oh, Richard, it really isn't that bad.
Do you want to stick it out for the whole weekend?
words.meaning: 你想整个周末都在这里坚持下去吗？

words.word: Well, I'll admit the room is uncomfortable.
words.meaning: 嗯，我承认这个房间很不舒服。

words.word: take care of the baby all weekend
And I do feel bad about your mother having to take care of the baby all weekend.
words.meaning: 而且我觉得很过意不去让你母亲整个周末照顾孩子。

words.word: Why don't we just check out?
words.meaning: 那何不立即结帐离开呢？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第15集 · 07 收到新的住宿机会
decks.section: 第15集 · 结婚纪念、订房与调整旅行计划

words.word: Hello? Yes. Yes, this is she.
How nice of you to remember us
words.meaning: 您还记得我们，真是太好了

words.word: Oh, hello! How nice of you to remember us!
words.meaning: 噢，你好！你真好，还记得我们！

words.word: You do? Really? It won't be any trouble?
words.meaning: 你有？真的？不会有任何麻烦？

words.word: Oh, yes, I think we'd like that very much.
words.meaning: 噢，好的，我想我们非常乐意。

words.word: Mrs. Montefiore from the Watermill Inn.
words.meaning: 是Watermill Inn的Montefiore太太打来的电话。

words.word: Someone just checked out. and Mrs. Montefiore has reserved the honeymoon suite for us.
words.meaning: 有一个人刚刚结帐走了。Montefiore太太为我们保留了蜜月套房。

words.word: Oh. Now all it has to do is stop raining.
words.meaning: 噢。现在唯一希望的就是停止下雨。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第15集 · 08 回到熟悉的旅馆
decks.section: 第15集 · 结婚纪念、订房与调整旅行计划

words.word: Oh, Richard, it's exactly as it was when we were married!
words.meaning: 噢，Richard。它跟我们结婚的时候一模一样！

words.word: Even the old patchwork quilt is the same!
words.meaning: 连那条旧的拼布被都还是原来的！

words.word: My great-grandmother made that quilt when Teddy Roosevelt was President.
words.meaning: 那条被子是我曾祖母在 Teddy Roosevelt 当总统时缝的。

words.word: cut patches from the old clothing
In those days, when they made quilts. they cut patches from the old clothing of every member in the family so that each one would be a part of it.
words.meaning: 那时候做拼布被，人们会从家中每个人的旧衣服上剪下布块，让每个人都成为被子的一部分。

words.word: the first time you stayed with us
words.meaning: 你们第一次住在我们这里时

words.word: I remember you and your wife from the first time you stayed with us.
words.meaning: 从你和太太第一次住在这里时起，我就记得你们了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第15集 · 09 分享家庭近况
decks.section: 第15集 · 结婚纪念、订房与调整旅行计划

words.meaning: 我们现在有一个小宝宝了。

words.word: How wonderful! A boy or a girl?
Would a professional photographer be without a picture?
words.meaning: 一位专业摄影师会没有照片吗？

words.word: Like his father. A real Stewart.
words.meaning: 像他爸爸一样。一个真正的Stewart家成员。

words.word: And very good-looking, like his mother.
nice to have you with us again
words.meaning: 很高兴你们再次来我们这里住

words.word: Well, it's nice to have you with us again.
words.meaning: 噢，非常高兴你们又来了。
下次把小宝宝一起带来。

words.word: You see, Richard? Max is welcome here.
words.meaning: 你看到了吧，Richard？他们这儿欢迎Max呢。
可不能在我们的结婚纪念日。

words.word: This vacation is for you and me.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第15集 · 10 接受招待与享用早餐
decks.section: 第15集 · 结婚纪念、订房与调整旅行计划

words.word: If there's anything you need, please call me.
words.meaning: 假如你们需要什么，请打电话给我。

words.word: I'll be in the front office all day.
words.meaning: 我整天都会在前台办公室。

words.word: Oh, I took the liberty of ordering some breakfast for you.
words.meaning: 噢，我冒昧给你们订了早餐。

words.word: Just put it over there, Charles.
Now, this is my idea of a good time.
Let's see ... hotcakes and maple syrup, with scrambled eggs.
words.meaning: 来看看……松饼和枫糖浆，还有炒蛋。

words.word: Umm ... smell that coffee ... cinnamon and cloves.
words.meaning: 呀……你闻一闻咖啡……一股肉桂和丁香的香味。

words.word: Slices of orange with burnt honey.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第15集 · 11 联系家人与安排散步
decks.section: 第15集 · 结婚纪念、订房与调整旅行计划

words.word: check on your mother and the baby
words.meaning: 问问你母亲和孩子的情况

words.word: First I want to call home and check on your mother and the baby.
words.meaning: 我先得打个电话回家，问问你母亲和孩子的情况。

words.word: Honey, if there were any problems, she would call us.
words.meaning: 亲爱的，假如有事的话，她会打电话过来的。

words.word: She doesn't know we've changed hotels.
words.meaning: 她不知道我们换了旅馆呀。

words.word: I'd like to call Riverdale, New York.
This food is heavenly, isn't it?

words.meaning: 这整个地方都太美好了。

words.word: Do you remember that old desk?
Mrs. Montefiore told me that George Washington sat at that desk and wrote to his wife Martha.
words.meaning: Montefiore 太太告诉我，George Washington 曾坐在那张桌子旁给妻子 Martha 写信。

words.word: What do you want to do after breakfast?
take a walk down to the river
Why don't we take a walk down to the river?
words.meaning: 我们何不一路散步到河边去呢？

words.word: No. Look out the window. The sun is shining!
words.meaning: 不。你看看窗外。太阳出来了！

words.word: Now this is my idea of a good time!

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第16集 · 01 收到老朋友来信
decks.section: 第16集 · 老友邀请、问路与重聚惊喜

words.word: dropped some mail in our box
words.meaning: 往我们信箱里投了一些邮件

words.word: The mailman just dropped some mail in our box, Grandpa.
words.meaning: 邮差刚刚塞进一些信件在我们的信箱里，爷爷。

words.word: Probably a lot of advertising and bills.
words.meaning: 大概是一大堆广告和帐单。

words.word: Why don't you write to me, Robbie, so I can get some interesting mail?
words.meaning: 你为什么不给我写信呢，Robbie？那样我就可以收到一些有趣的信件了。

words.word: Yes. It's just like I said, Robbie.
You won't believe it, Grandpa, but there's a letter here addressed to you, Mr. Malcolm Stewart, and it looks like a personal letter.
words.meaning: 你绝不会相信，爷爷，这里确实有一封信是寄给你的。Malcolm Stewart先生收，而且看来是一封私人信件。

words.word: Oh, it must be a bill.
The return name and address is Pete Waters, RFD Number 1, Chesterton.
words.meaning: 发信人姓名和地址是：Pete Waters，Chesterton，乡村免费邮递路线一号。
Pete Waters，乡村免费邮递路线一号，Chesterton。

words.word: He was my roommate in college.
He visited with Grandma and me in Florida about five years ago.
words.meaning: 他大约五年前到佛罗里达州看望过祖母和我。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第16集 · 02 了解周末聚会
decks.section: 第16集 · 老友邀请、问路与重聚惊喜

words.meaning: 和他一起度过一个周末

words.word: He's writing to invite me to spend a weekend with him at his farm.
words.meaning: 他来信邀请我到他的农场和他一起过个周末。

words.word: two or three other college friends
He's planning a get-together with two or three other college friends.
words.meaning: 他打算和另外两三个大学朋友聚一聚。

words.word: A kind of a fifty-year anniversary reunion.
words.meaning: 等于是五十周年重逢聚会。

words.word: It sounds like fun to me, too, Robbie.
words.meaning: 对我来说也像是蛮好玩的，Robbie。

words.word: What kind of farm does he have?
I've never been there, Robbie, but he has chickens and cows and all.
words.meaning: 我从来没有去过那儿，Robbie，但他有鸡、牛等等。

words.word: That means fresh eggs and fresh milk.
words.meaning: 也就是说会有新鲜的鸡蛋和牛奶。

words.word: not as lucky as I am
He's not as lucky as I am to have a family and grandchildren.
words.meaning: 他不像我这样幸运地拥有一个家庭和孙子们。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第16集 · 03 谈旧日感情
decks.section: 第16集 · 老友邀请、问路与重聚惊喜

words.word: How come he never got married?
He never married because the girl he was in love with in college married someone else.
words.meaning: 他不结婚是因为他大学时代所爱的女孩跟别人结婚了。

words.word: must have loved her very much
He must have loved her very much.
words.meaning: 他一定非常非常地爱她。

words.word: the quarterback on our football team
words.meaning: 我们橄榄球队的四分卫

words.word: She was in love with Donald McGrath, the quarterback on our football team.
words.meaning: 她爱上了我们橄榄球队的四分卫 Donald McGrath。

words.word: Football players are always popular with the ladies.
words.meaning: 橄榄球运动员总是很受女士们欢迎。

words.word: She liked Pete, and they went to dances together.
words.meaning: 她喜欢Pete，他们也一起去跳舞。

words.word: But her heart was with Donald.
Did he ever get over it?
Maybe Lillian will be at the reunion.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第16集 · 04 准备出行与回电
decks.section: 第16集 · 老友邀请、问路与重聚惊喜

words.word: I wish I could go there with you
words.meaning: 真希望我能和你一起去

words.word: I wish I could go there with you, Grandpa.
words.meaning: 我真希望我能够跟你一起去，爷爷。

words.word: What do you think the surprise will be?
words.meaning: 你想会是什么样的意外惊喜？

words.word: With Pete, you never know, Robbie.
words.meaning: 你不可能猜到Pete会耍什么花样，Robbie。
见到你所有的大学朋友

words.word: Won't it be exciting to see all your college friends there again?
words.meaning: 在那里又要见到你的大学朋友，难道不兴奋吗？

words.word: I'm kind of excited about going now.
Next weekend ... sleep over Friday and Saturday night and come back Sunday.
words.meaning: 下周末……星期五和星期六晚上在那儿过夜，然后在星期天回来。
应该给 Pete 打电话

words.word: Don't you think you ought to call Pete and tell him you're coming?
words.meaning: 你不觉得应该打个电话给Pete，告诉他你要去吗？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第16集 · 05 加油与询问近路
decks.section: 第16集 · 老友邀请、问路与重聚惊喜

words.word: Hello. What can I do for you?
words.meaning: 你好。我能为你做点什么吗？
要检查一下引擎盖下面的机件吗？

words.word: almost as long as I have
Pete Waters's lived around here almost as long as I have.
words.meaning: Pete Waters住在这里差不多跟我一样久了。

words.word: How long is it going to take
How long is it going to take for me to get there?
words.meaning: 到那里还需要多久时间？

words.word: There's a shortcut--if you know it.
words.meaning: 假如你识路的话，有一条近路可走。

words.word: Could you tell me how to use the shortcut?
words.meaning: 你能告诉我怎么走这条近路吗？

words.word: Sure. You take the next left turn.
words.meaning: 当然。你在下一个路口左转，
会看到有个停车再开标志。

words.word: Make a right at the stop sign.
words.meaning: 就在停车再开标志那里向右拐。

words.word: Stay on that road, and you'll cross a blue bridge.
words.meaning: 沿着路开下去，你会经过一座蓝色的桥。
一座又大又旧的红色谷仓

words.word: Then you'll see a big old red barn.
words.meaning: 然后你就会看到一座旧的红色大谷仓。

words.word: That's the back of Pete Waters's place.
words.meaning: 那就是Pete Waters住处的后面。

words.word: the directions that Pete sent me
words.meaning: Pete 寄给我的路线指示

words.word: That's quite a difference from the directions that Pete sent me.
words.meaning: 这和Pete寄给我的路线指示完全不同。

words.word: Now, if you take that route, it's probably a lot simpler, but it'll take you ten minutes longer.
words.meaning: 如果走 Pete 给你的那条路线，可能简单得多，不过会多花十分钟。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第16集 · 06 复述路线和付款
decks.section: 第16集 · 老友邀请、问路与重聚惊喜

words.word: I take the next left turn to the stop sign.
words.meaning: 我在下个路口左转弯，到一个停车再开标志处，

words.word: Then a right across a blue bridge, and then a big red barn.
words.meaning: 然后右转，经过一座蓝色的桥。然后就是一座大的红色谷仓。

words.word: How much do I owe you?
Well, that'll be eighteen dollars and seventy cents.
words.meaning: 一共十八美元七十美分。

words.word: a dollar and thirty cents change
words.meaning: 一美元三十美分的找零

words.word: Ah. OK. That's a dollar and thirty cents change.
words.meaning: 好的，找你一美元三十美分。

words.word: There we go ... will make twenty. Thanks.
words.meaning: 你看……加起来正好二十美元。谢谢了。
向右拐就到他的房子了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第16集 · 07 找到农场与阅读便条
decks.section: 第16集 · 老友邀请、问路与重聚惊喜

words.word: Hi. What can I do for you?
Is this the Pete Waters farm?
get to the end of the fence
Keep along this road till you get to the end of the fence.
words.meaning: 沿着这条路到栅栏的尽头。

words.word: His house is on the left.

words.meaning: 别拘束，就像在自己家一样

words.word: "Have gone to the railroad station. Back soon with a surprise. Make yourself at home. Have a look around. Pete."
words.meaning: “去火车站。接一个惊喜即回。勿客气。到处看看。Pete”

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第16集 · 08 老友辨认与寒暄
decks.section: 第16集 · 老友邀请、问路与重聚惊喜

words.word: Except for the beard, he hasn't changed in fifty years.
words.meaning: 除了有胡须，他五十年来没有变。

words.word: You haven't changed much in fifty years.
words.meaning: 你五十年来没有什么变。

words.word: Who am I, you old rascal?
You don't recognize me, do you?
left a note on the door
No. He left a note on the door saying he was going to the railroad station to pick up a surprise.
words.meaning: 不在。他在门上留了一张便条，说去火车站接一个惊喜回来。

words.word: Always full of surprises, even fifty years later.
words.meaning: 总是出人意表，五十年之后还是这样。

words.word: The two of you look unbelievable!
words.meaning: 你们俩看起来简直让人难以置信！

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第16集 · 09 交流家人近况
decks.section: 第16集 · 老友邀请、问路与重聚惊喜

words.word: Oh, I was sorry to hear about your wife having passed away.
words.meaning: 听说你太太去世了，我很难过。

words.word: And you're living with your children now? In New York?
words.meaning: 你现在跟你的孩子们一起住在New York对吗？

words.word: Pete wrote us and told us.
live with my son and his family
words.meaning: 和我儿子一家住在一起

words.word: Retired and moved to New York to live with my son and his family.
words.meaning: 我退休了，搬到纽约和我儿子和他的家人住在一起。

words.word: By the way, what do you think this big surprise is?
words.meaning: 顺便问一声，你认为这一件大惊喜会是什么？

words.word: It could be most anything, knowing Pete.
words.meaning: 任何事情都可能，你是知道Pete的。

words.word: Now we'll find out about the surprise.
words.meaning: 现在我们可以知道是什么样的惊喜了。

words.word: So good to see you all!
Oh, it's so good to see you!
We were together in the Thursday night drama society.
words.meaning: 我们过去总在星期四晚上的话剧社里聚会。
噢，你还像以前一样漂亮，Lillian。

words.word: passed away a couple of years ago
Donald passed away a couple of years ago.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第16集 · 10 揭晓相聚的惊喜
decks.section: 第16集 · 老友邀请、问路与重聚惊喜

words.word: would not have missed this get-together for the world
words.meaning: 无论如何都不会错过这次聚会

words.word: I would not have missed this get-together for the world!
words.meaning: 世界上任何事情都阻止不了我来参加这次聚会！

words.word: You really surprised me by having us all come together.
words.meaning: 你把我们大家聚到一起，已经让我很惊喜了。

words.word: You don't know what the surprise is yet?
words.meaning: 你们还不知道这个惊喜是什么？

words.word: We'll tell you the big surprise.
words.meaning: 我来告诉你们这个大惊喜。

words.word: I've invited you here for the weekend to help celebrate.
words.meaning: 我请大家来农场过周末，一起庆祝。

words.word: No. Pete wants to tell you ...
Now, let me have the honor, Lillian.
words.meaning: 现在，容我享有这个荣幸，Lillian。

words.word: For goodness' sake, Pete, tell us!

words.meaning: 向 Lillian 和我举杯致意

words.word: Well, I am pouring this iced tea so that we can toast Lillian--and me.
words.meaning: 我正在倒冰茶，这样大家就能向 Lillian 和我举杯致意。

words.word: You don't mean to tell me that you and ...
words.meaning: 你不会是告诉我们你和……

words.word: asked her to be Mrs. Pete Waters
I have loved Lillian all these years, so I asked her to be Mrs. Pete Waters.
words.meaning: 这些年来我一直爱着Lillian，所以我请求她成为Pete Waters夫人。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第16集 · 11 祝贺与庆祝安排
decks.section: 第16集 · 老友邀请、问路与重聚惊喜

words.word: I knew it! I knew it!
words.meaning: 我就知道是这样！我就知道是这样！

words.word: Oh, Lillian, I am so happy for you both.
words.meaning: 噢，Lillian，我真为你们俩感到高兴。

words.word: Lillian will make me a happy man--finally.
words.meaning: Lillian会使我终于成为一个快乐的男人。

words.word: You are full of surprises, Pete.
We are going to spend the entire weekend having a good time together here on the farm.
words.meaning: 我们要在这个农场一起开心地度过整个周末。

words.word: We are going to celebrate all weekend.
words.meaning: 我们整个周末都要进行庆祝。

words.word: Lillian and I were married two weeks ago in Detroit.
words.meaning: Lillian和我已经在两周前在Detroit结婚了。

words.word: Wait till I tell my family
words.meaning: 等我把这消息告诉家人！

words.word: Wait till I tell my family about this!
words.meaning: 等我把这个消息告诉家人，他们一定会大吃一惊！

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第17集 · 01 检查作品是否齐备
decks.section: 第17集 · 摄影集投稿、接受反馈与出版

words.meaning: 你想你已经拍齐了什么？
表演艺术——表演艺术中心。

words.word: I think I've got them all, but I'm not sure.
words.meaning: 我想我都已经拍齐了，但我不能肯定。

words.word: I think you have got it, Richard.
Lincoln Center, home of the Metropolitan Opera, the New York City Ballet, the New York Philharmonic.
words.meaning: 林肯中心，大都会歌剧团、纽约市芭蕾舞团和纽约爱乐乐团的所在地。

words.word: Shubert Alley, center of the theater on Broadway.
And the Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts in Washington.
words.meaning: 还有位于华盛顿的甘乃迪表演艺术中心。

words.word: And the Music Center in Los Angeles.
words.meaning: 还有位于洛杉矶的音乐中心。

words.word: And the others. I do have it all.
words.meaning: 还有其他的。我确实拍齐了。

words.word: working on this for some time
words.meaning: 为这件事忙了一段时间

words.word: You have been working on this for some time, Richard.
words.meaning: 你从事这工作已有一段时间了，Richard。
终于把它全部汇集好了

words.word: I'm glad you feel you've finally put it all together.
words.meaning: 我很高兴你终于就绪了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第17集 · 02 讨论投稿与约见
decks.section: 第17集 · 摄影集投稿、接受反馈与出版

words.word: going to have a hard time
Oh, you think you're going to have a hard time getting the album published?
words.meaning: 哦，你觉得要让这本摄影集出版会很困难吗？

words.word: So, what do you think you're going to do?

words.meaning: 听起来熟悉，让人有印象

words.word: Does the name Harvey Carlson ring a bell?
words.meaning: 你对Harvey Carlson这个名字有印象吗？

words.word: Oh, yes! Harvey Carlson! I remember.
He said I should call him.
words.meaning: 他说我可以打电话给他。

words.word: He's the publisher of the Carlson Publishing Company.
He said they need a new book of photographs, and he really liked my concept.
words.meaning: 他说他公司需要一本新的摄影集，而且他真的喜欢我的想法。

words.word: So, why don't you call him in the morning?
words.meaning: 那么你为何不明天早上打个电话给他？

words.word: Do you think I have enough to show him?
words.meaning: 你觉得我有足够的照片给他看吗？

words.word: been through every section with you
words.meaning: 和你一起检查过每个部分

words.word: I've been through every section with you, Richard.
words.meaning: 我和你一起检视过每个部分，Richard。

words.word: satisfied with the performing arts section
words.meaning: 对表演艺术部分感到满意

words.word: And now that you're satisfied with the performing arts section, I think you should show it to Mr. Carlson.
words.meaning: 而且既然你对表演艺术这部分很满意，我觉得你应该给Carlson先生看看。

words.word: You're right. My Family Album, U.S.A. feels right.
words.meaning: 你说的对。我的「美国写真集」不赖。

words.word: I'll call in the morning and set up an appointment to see him.
words.meaning: 我明天早上就打电话给他，跟他约个时间去看他。

words.word: He's going to love your work.
words.meaning: 他一定会欣赏你的作品的。

words.word: Come on. Let's get some sleep.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第17集 · 03 电话预约
decks.section: 第17集 · 摄影集投稿、接受反馈与出版

words.word: Is it too early to call Mr. Carlson?
words.meaning: 现在打电话给Carlson先生会不会太早了？

words.word: Seven after nine? No. I'm sure he's in his office.
words.meaning: 九点零七分？不会太早的。我肯定他到办公室了。

words.word: His number is five, five, five, seven, five, three, two.
Five, five, five, seven, five, three, two.
Mr. Carlson is busy at the moment. May I help you?
words.meaning: Carlson先生现在正忙着呢。我可以为你效劳吗？

words.word: I'd like to make an appointment with him.
words.meaning: 我想跟他约个晤谈时间。

words.word: He told me to call him about my project, Family Album, U.S.A.
words.meaning: 他叫我打电话给他，跟他谈我的作品计划——「美国写真集」。

words.word: I guess they're trying to set up an appointment for me.
words.meaning: 我猜他们正设法给我安排晤谈。

words.word: Mr. Stewart, I just spoke to Mr. Carlson.
words.meaning: Stewart先生，我刚刚与Carlson先生通了话。

words.word: He would like to see you.
But the only time he's available this week is tomorrow morning at ten o'clock.
words.meaning: 但这星期他有空的时间只有明天早上十点。

words.word: Well, it's done. Tomorrow morning at a publisher's office.
words.meaning: 好了，事情办成了。明天早晨要到出版社老板的办公室。

words.word: Oh, it's so exciting, isn't it, Richard?
words.meaning: 噢，这太令人兴奋了，是不是，Richard？

words.word: Well, finally a publisher will see my work.
words.meaning: 好了，终于有一个出版商要看我的作品了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第17集 · 04 到访与开始会面
decks.section: 第17集 · 摄影集投稿、接受反馈与出版

words.word: Good morning. My name is Richard Stewart.
I'm here to see Mr. Carlson.
Mr. Carlson will be with you shortly.
Excuse me, Mr. Carlson, but Richard Stewart is here for his ten o'clock appointment with you.
words.meaning: 对不起，Carlson先生，但Richard Stewart正在这儿等着十点钟与你的晤谈。

words.word: Like I said, he'll be with you shortly.
words.meaning: 正像我所说，他不久就可以与你会面。

words.word: He's ready for you, Mr. Stewart.

words.meaning: 是的，在那里面。祝你好运。

words.word: This is a crazy morning. Hello, Richard.
words.meaning: 这是一个忙得头昏的早晨。哈罗，Richard。
在这样临时通知的情况下

words.word: seeing me on such short notice
Thank you for seeing me on such short notice.
words.meaning: 谢谢您这样快就安排见我。

words.word: I hope you've brought your pictures along.
words.meaning: 我希望你带了你的照片一起来。

words.word: I see that you have. Let's get right to it.
words.meaning: 我看到你带来了。我们就直接谈正事了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第17集 · 05 介绍摄影集
decks.section: 第17集 · 摄影集投稿、接受反馈与出版

words.word: We need a new coffee-table book, and a book of photos about the United States still feels right.
words.meaning: 我们需要一本新的精装图册，而一本呈现美国的摄影集仍然很合适。

words.word: Good. Very good. Family Album, U.S.A.
words.meaning: 不错，很不错。「美国写真集」。

words.word: describe the book in one sentence
If you had to describe the book
If you had to describe the book in one sentence, how would you do it?
words.meaning: 假如要你用一句话来描述这本书，你怎么说？

words.word: a portrait of the United States
Well, I'd describe it as a book which is a ... a portrait of the United States-- the places, the people--mostly the people.
words.meaning: 我会把它形容为一本展现美国面貌的书，记录各地和人们，主要是人们。

words.word: The things they do, the ways they live, the places they visit, and the landmarks.
words.meaning: 他们所做的事情、他们的生活方式、他们所去的地方，以及地标等等。

words.word: These are wonderful-- these photos in your performing arts section.
words.meaning: 这些很棒——你表演艺术部分的这些照片。
卡奈基音乐厅、林肯中心。

words.word: There's something missing. You've got a good eye, Richard.
words.meaning: 少了些东西。你有艺术眼光，Richard。
你是一名出色的摄影师。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第17集 · 06 听取补充建议
decks.section: 第17集 · 摄影集投稿、接受反馈与出版

words.word: But before I can publish your work, I need to meet with my marketing department, and you've got to do one more thing.
words.meaning: 但在我出版你的书之前，我需要跟我的行销部门商量一下，而且你还要做一件事。

words.word: in the parks and on the streets
In the section on culture, you've included performing arts centers, but you've left out street performance. The mimes. The musicians. The dancers--in the parks and on the streets.
words.meaning: 在文化这一部分，你收录了表演艺术中心，却漏了街头表演，比如哑剧演员、音乐人，以及在公园和街头跳舞的人。

words.word: go out and photograph street performances
Richard, if you go out and photograph street performances in the city, you'll have it.
words.meaning: Richard，假如你去拍摄城市里的街头表演，那你就大功告成了。

words.word: The performing arts centers and the street performances.
words.meaning: 表演艺术中心及街头表演。

words.word: If you do it, I'll publish your work.
words.meaning: 假如你拍好了，我就出版你的作品。
从来没有比现在更认真
我从来没有比现在更认真了。
带着街头表演照片回来

words.word: When do you think you can return with street performances?
words.meaning: 你觉得何时可以带来街头表演艺术的摄影？

words.word: If they're as good as the rest of these pictures, it's a deal.
words.meaning: 假如它们跟这里其馀的照片一样好的话，我们的交易就成了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第17集 · 07 确认承诺与完成补拍
decks.section: 第17集 · 摄影集投稿、接受反馈与出版

words.word: You won't be disappointed, Mr. Carlson. Thanks.
words.meaning: 我不会让你失望的，Carlson先生。谢谢 。

words.word: Good-bye, Richard, and good luck. See you in two weeks.
words.meaning: 再见，Richard，祝你好运。两周后见。

words.word: So if you like the street-performance photos, you'll really publish Family Album, U.S.A.?
words.meaning: 这么说，假如你喜欢街头表演的照片，你真的会出版「美国写真集」啦？

words.word: When I say something, I mean it.
I said I could do it
I could do it in two weeks
Two weeks. I said I could do it in two weeks, and I did it.
words.meaning: 两周。我说过我两周就能完成，现在我做到了。

words.word: The pictures you've taken are fabulous, Richard.
I'm going to show him the photos on Monday morning.
words.meaning: 我要在星期一早晨给他看这些照片。

words.word: I'm very proud of you. You really did a beautiful job.
words.meaning: 我真以你为傲。你真的拍得很漂亮。

words.word: I know he will love the new photographs for your book.
words.meaning: 我相信他会喜欢你为你的书所拍的这些新照片。

words.word: Yeah. I really did do a good job, didn't I?
words.meaning: 是的，我确实拍得不错，对不对？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第17集 · 08 为家人拍照
decks.section: 第17集 · 摄影集投稿、接受反馈与出版

words.word: some film left on this roll
one person I haven't photographed in a long time
words.meaning: 一位我很久没拍过照的人

words.word: Hey, you know? There's still some film left on this roll, and there's one person I haven't photographed in a long time.
words.meaning: 嘿，你知道吗？这一卷还有一些底片，而有一个人我已经很久没为她拍照了。

words.word: Richard! I haven't brushed my hair.
It's not fair, Richard. I'm not even ready.
words.meaning: 这样不公平，Richard。我甚至一点准备都没有。
噢，真是美极了！真是美极了！

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第17集 · 09 展示新照片
decks.section: 第17集 · 摄影集投稿、接受反馈与出版

words.word: What a job! Good work, Richard!
I'm so glad you like them so much.
words.meaning: 你这样喜欢它们，我真是太高兴了。

words.word: Like them? They represent your best work.
words.meaning: 何止喜欢？它们代表了你最佳的作品。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第17集 · 10 出版安排与认识团队
decks.section: 第17集 · 摄影集投稿、接受反馈与出版

words.word: Well ... what do you think? Do I have my book?
words.meaning: 那么——你看怎么样？我的书可以出版吗？

words.word: You do. You do. There's a book here.
a contract and an advance payment
words.meaning: 一份合同和一笔预付款

words.word: I'll have a contract and an advance payment waiting for you first thing in the morning.
words.meaning: 我会准备好合同和预付稿酬，明天一早等你来。

words.word: And while you're here, I would like to introduce you to your editor.
words.meaning: 趁你现在在这里，我来介绍你认识这本书的编辑。

words.word: And I want you to meet the people in the art department.
words.meaning: 我也希望你与美编部的人见见面。

words.word: I'll set up an appointment with the marketing people.
words.meaning: 我会与行销部的人安排一次会谈。

words.word: When do you think we'll be through?
words.meaning: 你认为我们什么时候能完毕？

words.word: In about half an hour. Why?
words.meaning: 大约半个小时。为什么问这个？

words.word: I can't wait to tell Marilyn!

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第18集 · 01 讨论学校预算
decks.section: 第18集 · 学校文化、表达立场与面对结果

words.meaning: 竞选学区教育委员会职位

words.word: He's running for the school board.
words.meaning: 他正在竞选学区教育委员会的职位。

words.word: wanting to be on the school board
words.meaning: 想进入学区教育委员会

words.word: What's wrong with wanting to be on the school board?
words.meaning: 想成为学区教育委员会的一员有什么不对？

words.word: But he wants to cut the school budget!
words.meaning: 但他想削减学校的预算！

words.word: by cutting all the cultural programs
words.meaning: 通过削减所有文化项目

words.word: Cutting the budget is fine, but he wants to do it by cutting all the cultural programs.
words.meaning: 削减预算是好的，但他要削减，是透过取消所有的文化活动。

words.word: No music, no dance, no concert, no stage presentations.
words.meaning: 没有音乐、没有舞蹈、没有音乐会 、没有舞台表演。

words.word: Why does he want to do that?
spends less on the cultural programs
He says it's to save the taxpayers' money, and I think he believes that the taxpayers will vote for him if he spends less on the cultural programs.
words.meaning: 他说这是为了要节省纳税人的钱，而我认为他相信纳税人会投他一票，假如他在这文化活动上减少开支的话。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第18集 · 02 表达不同看法
decks.section: 第18集 · 学校文化、表达立场与面对结果

words.word: their taxes used for new books
words.meaning: 他们缴的税用于买新书

words.word: Lots of people want their taxes used for new books and a new paint job in the schoolrooms.
words.meaning: 许多人希望他们缴的税金被用来购买新书和重新油漆教室。

words.word: Maybe some of us would like to pay a little bit more and keep the cultural programs for our kids.
words.meaning: 也许我们之中有一些人愿意多付一点钱，以便为我们的孩子保存文化活动。

words.word: I hear it from my patients.
words.meaning: 我是从我的病人那儿听到这些的。

words.word: Lots of people are tired of higher taxes.
words.meaning: 许多人对于增税很厌烦。

words.word: I know, but if Boswell wins he'll be an important decision-maker on the school board, and he doesn't know anything about our children's education.
words.meaning: 我知道，可要是 Boswell 赢了，他就会成为学区教育委员会的重要决策者，而他对我们孩子的教育一无所知。
没有人。这就是问题所在。

words.word: win this seat on the board
words.meaning: 赢得委员会中的这个席位

words.word: Well, it sounds to me like Carter Boswell is going to win this seat on the board.
words.meaning: 嗯，听你这么说，Carter Boswell 好像要赢得委员会的这个席位了。

words.word: Oh, not if I can stop him!
words.meaning: 噢，要是我能阻止他，他就甭想！

words.word: And how are you going to stop him?

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第18集 · 03 争取家人支持
decks.section: 第18集 · 学校文化、表达立场与面对结果

words.word: Why shouldn't you run for what, Mom?
words.meaning: 为什么你不该竞选什么，妈妈？

words.word: Your mother is thinking of running for the school board.
words.meaning: 你妈妈正在考虑竞选学区教育委员会的职位。

words.word: Well, if I run for office, the voters will have a clear choice.
words.meaning: 嗯，假如我出来竞选公职，投票人可以有明确的选择。

words.word: I stand for everything Boswell doesn't.
words.meaning: 我代表Boswell所不赞成的那些立场。

words.word: I think a lot of people will vote for you against Boswell, Ellen.
words.meaning: 我想很多人会投票支持你和Boswell对抗，Ellen。

words.word: help me if I do run
words.meaning: 如果我真的参选就帮助我

words.word: Will you help me if I do run?
words.meaning: 假如我真的竞选，你会帮我忙吗？

words.word: takes a little bit of money
The trouble is it takes a little bit of money to run a campaign.
words.meaning: 问题是竞选活动需要花一些钱。

words.word: I think you can make a difference, Ellen.
words.meaning: 我觉得你可以发挥影响力，Ellen。

words.word: And in a short campaign you wouldn't need as much money.
words.meaning: 而且这一场短暂的竞选不需要花多少钱。

words.word: Why not give the people of Riverdale a clear choice?
words.meaning: 为什么不让Riverdale的人民有一个明确的选择呢？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第18集 · 04 向报社说明来意
decks.section: 第18集 · 学校文化、表达立场与面对结果

words.word: What would you like to see me about?
editor of the most influential newspaper
words.meaning: 最有影响力报纸的编辑

words.word: Well, I'm editor of the most influential newspaper in Riverdale.
words.meaning: 噢，我是Riverdale最有影响力的报纸的编辑。
事实上，它是唯一的报纸。

words.word: A lot of people would like my help.
I'm planning to run for the school board.
words.meaning: 我打算竞选学区教育委员会的职位。

words.word: Will you announce that I'm running?
words.meaning: 你会发布我参加竞选的消息吗？

words.word: Why will the voters vote for you against Boswell, Mrs. Stewart?
words.meaning: 为什么选民会投票支持你和Boswell对抗呢，Stewart太太？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第18集 · 05 解释关心与计划
decks.section: 第18集 · 学校文化、表达立场与面对结果

words.word: But what do you care about?
Well, I care about the children of our town.
words.meaning: 噢，我关心我们镇上的孩子们。
在没有文化活动的环境中长大

words.word: I don't want them to grow up without cultural programs in our school.
words.meaning: 我不希望在他们成长期间，我们的学校里没有文化活动。

words.word: more than reading, writing, and arithmetic
I want our children to learn more than reading, writing, and arithmetic.
words.meaning: 我要孩子们学习到比阅读、写作及算术更多的东西。

words.word: I want to keep the after-school programs-- the music, the concerts.
words.meaning: 我想保留课后活动，比如音乐课、音乐会。

words.word: But who's going to pay for all of this?
The citizens of Riverdale, of course.
I plan to get help from the businessmen and the corporations of Riverdale.
words.meaning: 我打算争取Riverdale的商人和企业界的支持。

words.word: Exactly what do you want from me, Mrs. Stewart?
words.meaning: 你究竟对我有什么要求，Stewart太太？

words.word: I can't expect you to take my side against Boswell.
words.meaning: 我不敢期望你站在我这一边来对抗Boswell。

words.word: know that I'm running for office
But I do need some publicity so that the people of our town know that I'm running for office and that I care about our children.
words.meaning: 但我需要一些宣传，好让我们镇里的人知道我正在竞选公职，并且知道我关心我们的孩子。

words.word: I certainly can print the news.
words.meaning: 我当然可以刊出这则新闻。

words.word: And you are now making news.
words.meaning: 而你现在就是在创造新闻。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第18集 · 06 分工与电话联系
decks.section: 第18集 · 学校文化、表达立场与面对结果

words.word: Here are the fliers, hot off the press!
words.meaning: 传单来了，刚刚印出来的！

words.word: Richard and I will put them into the envelopes.
We finished addressing over three hundred envelopes.
words.meaning: 我们已经在三百多个信封上写好了地址。

words.word: Can I speak with Mr. or Mrs. Anderson?
words.meaning: 我可以跟Anderson先生或太太说话吗？

words.word: my mother is running for the school board
words.meaning: 我母亲正在竞选教育委员会职位

words.word: Did you know my mother is running
words.meaning: 你知道我妈妈正在参选吗

words.word: Did you know my mother is running for the school board?
words.meaning: 你知道我妈妈正在竞选学区教育委员会的职位吗？

words.word: Oh, see you at the polls.
I'll give her your best wishes, Mr. Nelson.
words.meaning: 我会转告她你的祝福，Nelson先生。

words.word: Can I speak with Mr. or Mrs. Burns?
words.meaning: 我可以跟Burns先生或太太通话吗？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第18集 · 07 汇报进展与继续帮忙
decks.section: 第18集 · 学校文化、表达立场与面对结果

words.word: in such a short amount of time
We have done so much in such a short amount of time.
words.meaning: 我们在这么短的时间里做了这么多事。

words.word: Wait till Philip comes home and sees our progress.
words.meaning: 等着瞧Philip回来看到我们进展时的反应吧！

words.word: Everyone saw the story in the Riverdale newspaper.
words.meaning: 每个人都已看到Riverdale报纸上的新闻。
刊登我宣布参选的消息

words.word: Mr. Maxwell was very kind to print my announcement.
words.meaning: Maxwell先生很好心，刊登了我宣布竞选的消息。

words.word: Everybody in Riverdale reads his paper.
words.meaning: Riverdale的每个人都看他的报纸。

words.word: Your photo in it helped, too.
words.meaning: 你在报纸上的照片也有帮助。

words.word: Thanks to you, Richard, it's a good picture.
words.meaning: 谢谢你，Richard，那是一张好照片。

words.word: Hey, everybody, Mrs. Greenberg is on the phone.
words.meaning: 嗨，大家听着，Greenberg太太打电话来。

words.word: She says Carter Boswell is on the TV right now-- doing a commercial.
words.meaning: 她说 Carter Boswell 此刻正在电视上做广告。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第18集 · 08 观看广告与回应顾虑
decks.section: 第18集 · 学校文化、表达立场与面对结果

words.word: ... and if you ask what I care about, I'll tell you.
words.meaning: ……假如你们问我关心什么，我可以告诉你们。

words.word: I care about the school buildings in need of paint.
words.meaning: 我关心学校的建筑物需要粉刷。

words.word: I care about more lockers for the teachers.
words.meaning: 我关心教师要有更多的储物柜。

words.word: I care about new fixtures in the hallways-- not music or dancing or entertainment.
words.meaning: 我关心走廊里的新固定设施，而不是音乐、舞蹈和娱乐。

words.word: I care about the practical things.
If you do, vote for me, Carter Boswell.
words.meaning: 假如你有同感，请投我一票，Carter Boswell。

words.word: A lot of people will agree with him.
It's our school, but we can't vote.
words.meaning: 那是我们的学校，可是我们却不能投票。

words.word: in favor of the cultural programs
There are people in favor of the cultural programs, Mom.
words.meaning: 会有许多人赞成文化活动的，妈妈。
因 Boswell 的广告而担心

words.word: Don't be upset by Boswell's commercial.
words.meaning: 不要为了Boswell的广告而忧心。

words.word: You have to go on television, too.

words.meaning: 一位很有感染力的演说者

words.word: I'm not sure I'm up to it.
words.meaning: 我不确定自己能不能胜任。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第18集 · 09 练习镜头表达
decks.section: 第18集 · 学校文化、表达立场与面对结果

words.word: I care about people, not things.
the open seat on the school board
words.meaning: 教育委员会中空出的席位

words.word: Hello. My name is Ellen Stewart, and I'm running for the open seat on the school board.
words.meaning: 大家好，我叫 Ellen Stewart，正在竞选学区教育委员会的一个空缺席位。

words.word: What does the word care mean?
... I care about people, not things.
I like it, but now what?
words.meaning: 我觉得不错。但下一步怎么办？

words.word: How can we possibly get it on so Riverdale will see it and hear it?
words.meaning: 我们怎样才能让Riverdale的人看到和听到它呢？

words.word: ... I mean that when I say "I care", I care about people, not things.
words.meaning: ……我的意思是当我说『我关心』时，我关心的是人而不是东西。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第18集 · 10 获得关注与保持冷静
decks.section: 第18集 · 学校文化、表达立场与面对结果

words.word: Mom is now on television in every appliance store in Riverdale, except Hamlin's.
words.meaning: 除了 Hamlin 那家店，Riverdale 每一家家电商店的电视上都在播放妈妈的画面。
你继承了你父亲的好头脑。

words.word: We got our brains from you, Dad.
words.meaning: 我们从你那儿继承了好头脑，爸爸。
我打电话给了第五频道。

words.word: Their TV news is going to cover it.
words.meaning: 他们的电视新闻将报导这一消息。
『家庭主妇在电器行里进行竞选活动』。

words.word: And I'll bet some magazine will pick up the story, too.
words.meaning: 我敢打赌一些杂志也将刊登这项消息。

words.word: the voters will have to decide
I know we're getting some attention now, but in the end the voters will have to decide.
words.meaning: 我认为我们现在固然渐渐引起一些注意，但最后却要由选民来决定。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第18集 · 11 等待结果
decks.section: 第18集 · 学校文化、表达立场与面对结果

words.word: In the hotly contested race for the one seat on the Riverdale School Board, Mrs. Ellen Stewart has taken an early lead.
words.meaning: 在争夺 Riverdale 学区教育委员会一个席位的激烈选举中，Ellen Stewart 太太在初步计票时领先。

words.word: Now returning to other local news ...
words.meaning: 现在再报导其它地方新闻。

words.word: Riverdale High School beat its rival Horace Mann in baseball today ...
words.meaning: Riverdale高中在今天的棒球赛中打败了对手Horace Mann队。

words.word: too soon to know for certain
It's too soon to know for certain.
words.meaning: 现在还太早，不知道确切情况。
广告后还有许多运动消息。

words.word: Let's just all calm down, and wait for the final results.
words.meaning: 让我们全都冷静下来，等待最后的结果。

words.word: Ellen, why don't you go out to the backyard and get some fresh air?
words.meaning: Ellen，你何不去院子里呼吸一些新鲜空气呢？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第18集 · 12 面对落选
decks.section: 第18集 · 学校文化、表达立场与面对结果

words.word: lost by only a hundred and twenty-one votes
words.meaning: 仅以一百二十一票之差落败

words.word: You lost by only a hundred and twenty-one votes.
words.meaning: 你仅仅以一百二十一票的些微差距输了。

words.word: a very small number of votes
You lost by a very small number of votes.
words.meaning: 你只差很少的票数就赢了。

words.word: Only one hundred and twenty-one votes!

words.meaning: 实在是没有足够的时间。
留下了非常深刻的印象

words.word: Look, you've made a very strong impression on our community.
words.meaning: 你已经给我们社区留下了很深的印象。
下次选举中的另一次机会

words.word: You'll have another chance next election.
words.meaning: 下次选举时你还有机会。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第18集 · 13 接受新机会
decks.section: 第18集 · 学校文化、表达立场与面对结果

words.word: I just called to tell you that you are very impressive.
words.meaning: 我打电话是想告诉你，你给人们留下了深刻的印象。

words.word: won the attention of the residents
You lost the election, but you won the attention of the residents of Riverdale, of Boswell, and of me.
words.meaning: 你虽然输了选举，却赢得了 Riverdale 居民、Boswell 和我的关注。
我很感谢你好心的安慰。
一个专门的艺术委员会

words.word: appoint you to a special arts committee
words.meaning: 任命你加入专门艺术委员会

words.word: I hear Boswell wants to appoint you to a special arts committee.
words.meaning: 我听说 Boswell 想任命你加入一个专门的艺术委员会。

words.word: I'm sending over a reporter in the morning to interview you.
words.meaning: 我将派一位记者在明天早晨来采访你。

words.word: I'm gonna do an article on "Ellen Stewart--she cares."
words.meaning: 我准备写一篇文章，叫做『Ellen Stewart——她关心』。
也许我们大家现在都关心起来了。

words.word: I did make a difference in town.
words.meaning: 我确实在镇上发挥了影响力。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第19集 · 01 系领结与担心出错
decks.section: 第19集 · 婚礼筹备、缓解紧张与仪式表达

words.word: Are they always that difficult to make?
At this rate, the wedding will take place tomorrow.
words.meaning: 照这种速度，婚礼只有明天举行了。

words.word: What if we can't tie the tie?
words.meaning: 如果我们系不好领结怎么办？

words.word: If we can't tie the tie, then there can't be a wedding.
words.meaning: 假如我们系不好领结，婚礼就不能举行了。

words.word: You'd better not make Harry any more nervous than he is.
words.meaning: 你最好别让Harry更加紧张了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第19集 · 02 找到简便的替代办法
decks.section: 第19集 · 婚礼筹备、缓解紧张与仪式表达

words.word: We can't get this bow tie tied.
Nobody knows how to do it.
Well, you have your own tuxedo.
words.meaning: 可是，你有自己的晚礼服。

words.word: How do you tie your bow tie?
Yeah, Grandpa, I've seen you in it.
words.meaning: 对呀，爷爷。我曾见过你那身打扮。

words.word: I never could tie one of those ... things ... bow ties.
words.meaning: 我从来就不会打那一类的……玩意儿……领结。

words.word: I have always worn a clip-on bow tie.
words.meaning: 我都是用夹上去的领结。

words.word: All you do is clip it around under your collar.
words.meaning: 你所要做的就是将它夹在领子下方。

words.word: We all need one of those.
words.meaning: 我们都需要一个这样的领结。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第19集 · 03 联系商店与准备礼服
decks.section: 第19集 · 婚礼筹备、缓解紧张与仪式表达

words.meaning: 星期天可是他们生意最忙的时候。

words.word: Well, if they're not, I'll lend you mine, Harry.
words.meaning: 噢，假如店不开的话，我把我的借给你，Harry。

words.word: You're the only one who really needs to be wearing a tuxedo, anyway.
words.meaning: 不管怎么说，真正需要穿晚礼服的只有你一个。

words.word: I'm the father of the bride.
the man that's marrying my daughter
I'm supposed to be worried about my daughter, and here I am with the man that's marrying my daughter-- worrying about him.
words.meaning: 我原该为我的女儿担心才是。如今我却和将要娶我女儿的人在一起－－为他操心。

words.word: And they have lots of clip-on bow ties.
words.meaning: 而且他们有许多夹上去的领结。

words.word: I'll bicycle down to the village and get them.
a true member of the Stewart family
words.meaning: 真正成为 Stewart 家的一员

words.word: In two hours and fifteen minutes
In two hours and fifteen minutes I'll be married to Susan. And be a true member of the Stewart family.
words.meaning: 再过两小时十五分钟我就要和Susan结婚了。也真正成了Stewart家庭中的一员。

words.word: Oh, you're a lucky guy, Harry.
words.meaning: 噢，你是一个幸运的家伙，Harry。

words.word: Susan is one of the best women you'll ever find.
words.meaning: Susan是你能找到最好的女人之一。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第19集 · 04 寻找婚戒
decks.section: 第19集 · 婚礼筹备、缓解紧张与仪式表达

words.word: put the ring on Susan's finger
words.meaning: 把戒指戴在 Susan 的手指上

words.word: once you put the ring on Susan's finger
words.meaning: 一旦你给 Susan 戴上戒指

words.word: Now, once you put the ring on Susan's finger, you are one of us, Harry.
words.meaning: 现在，你一旦将戒指戴上Susan的手指，你就是我们家中的一员了，Harry。

words.word: What did I do with the rings?
in the pocket of my sports jacket
words.meaning: 在我休闲夹克的口袋里

words.word: the pocket of my sports jacket
I put them in the pocket of my sports jacket.
words.meaning: 我把它们放在休闲夹克的口袋里了。

words.word: No, I think you put them in your tuxedo jacket pocket.
words.meaning: 不对，我想你放在晚礼服上衣的口袋里了。

words.word: What did I do with the rings?
Didn't you give them to Richard?
words.meaning: 你不是把它们交给Richard了吗？

words.word: What did I do with them?

words.meaning: 这样我就不会把它们弄丢

words.word: gave them to Robbie to hold
I gave them to Robbie to hold so I wouldn't lose them.
words.meaning: 我把它们交给Robbie拿，免得我弄丢了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第19集 · 05 找到戒指与交人保管
decks.section: 第19集 · 婚礼筹备、缓解紧张与仪式表达

words.word: pick up the clip-on bow ties
Robbie went to pick up the clip-on bow ties.
It's still a little over two hours, Harry.
No, no, Robbie doesn't have them.
He gave them to me to hold on to them because he didn't want the responsibility of holding them.
words.meaning: 他给我戒指，要我自己保管，因为他不想承担保管它们的责任。

words.word: I put them in my tuxedo-- but in the lapel pocket.
words.meaning: 我把戒指放在晚礼服里了，不过是在翻领处的那个口袋。

words.word: hold on to them for you
I'll hold on to them for you.
The best man always keeps the rings.
there won't be a problem later
You hold on to them so there won't be a problem later.
words.meaning: 你来保管，免得等一下又出问题了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第19集 · 06 整理衣着与等待
decks.section: 第19集 · 婚礼筹备、缓解紧张与仪式表达

words.word: Well, now, I think we'd better get dressed, fellas.
words.meaning: 好了，现在我们最好去穿好衣服，各位。

words.word: Robbie will bring the ties back.
It'll all be over in two hours.
The wedding ceremony will be over.

words.meaning: 从现在起还有两个小时。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第19集 · 07 准备婚礼传统物品
decks.section: 第19集 · 婚礼筹备、缓解紧张与仪式表达

words.word: And now for ... something old, something new, something borrowed, and something blue.
words.meaning: 现在，接着是－－一些旧的、一些新的、一些借来的、一些蓝色的。
从 Marilyn 那里借来的

words.word: That's this dress. Borrowed from Marilyn.
words.meaning: 那就是这件礼服。跟Marilyn借的。

words.word: I wore it when I married your father.
words.meaning: 我和你父亲结婚时戴着它。

words.word: Oh, Mother. I forgot you still had it.
words.meaning: 噢，妈妈。我忘了你仍然保留着它。

words.word: I bought it in an antique shop when I was about eighteen years old.
words.meaning: 我在一家古董店买的，那时我差不多十八岁。

words.word: I saved it for my wedding day.
words.meaning: 我留着等我的结婚日才用。

words.word: And you saved it for me, didn't you, Mother?
words.meaning: 你也留着要给我，对吗，妈妈？

words.word: Are we ever going to finish?
The wedding dress. And something blue.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第19集 · 08 旧珍珠与新面纱
decks.section: 第19集 · 婚礼筹备、缓解紧张与仪式表达

words.word: I had planned to wear them.
Oh, Grandpa will be so pleased that you're wearing them.
words.meaning: 噢，你戴了它，祖父一定会非常高兴。

words.word: misses Grandma on a day like this
words.meaning: 在这样的日子思念祖母

words.word: I'm sure he misses Grandma on a day like this.
words.meaning: 我想在这样的日子祖父一定会思念祖母。

words.word: I've been saving them for today.
words.meaning: 我一直留着等今天才戴。
噢，你是一个真正Stewart家的人！

words.word: Something borrowed, something blue. Something old ... and now for something new.
words.meaning: 借的东西、蓝色的东西、旧的东西……现在轮到新的东西了。

words.word: You really are a fabulous designer, Marilyn.
words.meaning: 你真是一个绝佳的设计师，Marilyn。
戴在 Susan 身上正合适

words.word: Doesn't it look just right on Susan?

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第19集 · 09 临近仪式的紧张
decks.section: 第19集 · 婚礼筹备、缓解紧张与仪式表达

words.word: lift this veil over your head
words.meaning: 把这块面纱掀过你的头顶

words.word: And when you both say, "I do," Harry will lift this veil over your head and kiss the bride.
words.meaning: 当你们都说完“我愿意”时，Harry 会把面纱掀过你的头顶，亲吻新娘。

words.word: When you said, "I do," Marilyn, it suddenly became real.
words.meaning: Marilyn，你刚才一说我愿意，这件事突然显得真实起来了。
你这是婚礼当天太紧张了！

words.word: In less than two hours, you will be Mrs. Harry Bennett.
words.meaning: 在不到两个小时之后，你将成为Harry Bennett太太。

words.word: If we don't get dressed, we won't be there to see Susan become Mrs. Harry Bennett.
words.meaning: 假如我们不去打扮的话，我们将无法目睹Susan成为Harry Bennett太太。

words.word: Before you leave--do I look all right?
words.meaning: 在你们离开之前，告诉我－－我这样子可以吗？

words.word: Got to go and feed him.
What am I supposed to do?
Take off the veil, kick off your shoes, and sit down.
words.meaning: 拿掉面纱，脱掉你的鞋子，坐下来。

words.word: We'll come upstairs and get you in a little while.
words.meaning: 我们待会儿就上楼来带你下去。

words.word: Richard's going to take some wedding pictures before the ceremony.
words.meaning: Richard准备拍一些结婚照片在婚礼前。

words.word: Susan Stewart ... you are about to become Susan Bennett-- Mrs. Harry Bennett.
words.meaning: Susan Stewart……你即将成为Susan Bennett－－Harry Bennett太太。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第19集 · 10 婚礼仪式
decks.section: 第19集 · 婚礼筹备、缓解紧张与仪式表达

words.word: I think it's time for the wedding to begin.
words.meaning: 我想是婚礼可以开始的时候了。

words.word: The wedding ceremony is about to begin.
Dearly beloved, we are gathered here today to join this man and this woman in holy matrimony.
words.meaning: 敬爱的人们，我们今天聚集在这里见证这位男士和这位女士的神圣婚盟。

words.word: Do either of you have any reason why you should not legally be joined in marriage?
words.meaning: 两位之中可有哪位因为某项原因不能合法结婚的？

words.word: Is there anyone present who can show any just cause why these two people should not be legally joined in marriage?
words.meaning: 在座可有人能提出任何正当理由说明这两位不该合法结婚的？

words.word: Then, Harry Bennett, do you take Susan Stewart to be your lawful, wedded wife?
words.meaning: 那么，Harry Bennett，你愿意接受Susan Stewart做你合法的妻子吗？

words.word: And you, Susan Stewart, do you take Harry Bennett to be your lawful, wedded husband?
words.meaning: 那么，Susan Stewart，你愿意接受 Harry Bennett 为你合法的丈夫吗？

words.word: By the power vested in me
By the power vested in me by the laws of the State of New York, I now pronounce you husband and wife.
words.meaning: 凭着纽约州法律赋予我的权力，我现在宣布你们成为夫妻。

words.word: You may kiss the bride now, Harry.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第20集 · 01 忙碌的一天
decks.section: 第20集 · 家庭相处、倾听与共同阅读

words.word: She went to a school-board meeting.
words.meaning: 她去参加学区教育委员会会议了。

words.word: I don't know how she does it.
words.meaning: 我不知道她怎么办到的。

words.word: There are lots of places to go, lots of things to do.
words.meaning: 有很多地方要去，许多事情要做。

words.word: She can't sit around and do nothing.
words.meaning: 她总不能闲坐着无所事事呀。

words.word: I wish I had her energy.
words.meaning: 我希望我有她那样的精力。

words.word: She went to a school-board meeting.
words.meaning: 她去参加学区教育委员会会议了。

words.word: There's a note for you on the refrigerator.
words.meaning: 冰箱上有她留给你的字条。

words.word: Mike and I had a hamburger at the diner.
words.meaning: Mike 和我在小餐馆吃了汉堡。

words.word: I came home a little while ago.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第20集 · 02 向父亲表达担心
