decks.section: 第20集 · 家庭相处、倾听与共同阅读

words.meaning: 这个星期几乎每天晚上

words.word: You've been working late almost every night this week, Dad.
words.meaning: 你一直工作到很晚，几乎这个星期的每天晚上都如此，爸爸。

words.word: I don't have time to be exhausted.
words.meaning: 我没有时间去精疲力尽。

words.word: You and Mom haven't had dinner together with us in almost a full week.
words.meaning: 你和妈妈没有和我们一起吃晚餐，差不多有一整个星期了。
我们的时间安排差别这么大

words.word: Yeah, I feel bad about us not having dinner with the family, but our schedules are so different.
words.meaning: 是啊。我觉得很不安，对于我们无法与全家人共进晚餐一事，但我们的工作时间实在差太多了。

words.word: Either I'm at the hospital doing paperwork, or Mom is at a committee meeting.
words.meaning: 不是我在医院处理文书工作，就是妈妈在参加委员会会议。

words.word: I frankly don't know what to do about it.
words.meaning: 我真不知道该怎么解决。

words.word: I'm worried about you and Mom.
You really have been working too hard.
I think I've had enough of that sandwich.
words.meaning: 好了，我想三明治我已经吃够了。

words.word: It's not good to eat before going to bed.
Well, I'm heading off for bed and a good night's sleep.
words.meaning: 好啦，我先去睡觉了，睡一个好觉。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第20集 · 03 与祖父商量
decks.section: 第20集 · 家庭相处、倾听与共同阅读

words.meaning: 核对那本支票簿的账目

words.word: Haven't you finished balancing that checkbook?
words.meaning: 你还没核对完支票簿的账目吗？

words.word: I'll be off to bed myself in a minute.
words.meaning: 我再过一会也要上床睡觉了。

words.word: I'm really concerned about them, Grandpa.
words.meaning: 我真的为他们担心，爷爷。

words.word: They hardly ever see each other.
Dad often works late, and Mom has all these committees she's on.
words.meaning: 爸爸老是工作到很晚，妈妈又有那么多的小组会议要开。

words.word: What do you propose to do about it?
You have that look in your eye.
words.meaning: 你看起来好像有了主意似的。

words.word: getting them to spend more time together
I don't know, but there must be a way of getting them to spend more time together.
words.meaning: 我不知道，但总该有一个办法能让他们有更多时间相处。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第20集 · 04 与母亲谈心
decks.section: 第20集 · 家庭相处、倾听与共同阅读

words.word: What are you doing up this late?
words.meaning: 这么晚了你还没睡在做什么？

words.word: What are you doing up this late?
words.meaning: 这么晚你不睡在干什么？

words.word: Do you care to talk about them?
Sure, if you don't mind listening.
words.meaning: 当然，假如你不介意听的话。

words.word: something you want to talk about
If you have something you want to talk about, I'm always prepared to listen.
words.meaning: 假如你有什么事情要谈，我总是准备听的。

words.word: You haven't been around much lately.
words.meaning: 最近你在家的时候不多。

words.word: ships that pass in the night
words.meaning: 夜里擦身而过的船，指难有交集

words.word: You and Dad are like ships that pass in the night.
words.meaning: 你和爸爸像夜里擦身而过的两艘船，几乎没有交集。

words.word: Dad works hard, and he works late.
words.meaning: 爸爸工作忙，而且忙到很晚。

words.word: You work hard on all your committees, and you work late.
words.meaning: 而你总是在各种委员会里忙，也工作到很晚。

words.word: proud of the work I do
I thought you were proud of the work I do.
words.meaning: 我还以为你为我所做的工作感到骄傲。
有质量的相处时间有多么少

words.word: You are one fantastic mom, but ... but I've been noticing how little quality time you spend with Dad and me ... and the family.
words.meaning: 你是个特别好的妈妈，但我一直注意到，你和爸爸、我及全家人有质量的相处时间实在太少。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第20集 · 05 提出共同活动
decks.section: 第20集 · 家庭相处、倾听与共同阅读

words.word: There must be a way that Dad and you can spend more time together.
words.meaning: 总该有个办法能使你和爸爸有更多的时间在一起。

words.word: Well, we always talk about taking a vacation together--with the family.
words.meaning: 说的也是，我们常在谈论要一起渡个假，全家一起。

words.word: I think you ought to take a vacation away from the family--alone.
words.meaning: 我觉得你们应该离开家人而单独在一起渡个假。

words.word: It would be wonderful, but our schedules won't allow it.
words.meaning: 那倒是很美妙，但我们的工作时间表不允许这样。

words.word: I think I have an idea.
I think I have an idea that will bring Dad and you together in a more scheduled way.
words.meaning: 我想到了一个办法，可以让你和爸爸更有规律地一起做事。

words.word: Well, you know how Dad is always talking about the kids in the ward and how important it is for them to be paid attention to?
words.meaning: 噢，你知道爸爸时常谈起住院的孩子们以及他们何等需要受人关怀吧？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第20集 · 06 设计阅读计划
decks.section: 第20集 · 家庭相处、倾听与共同阅读

words.word: the doctors and nurses are so busy
Well ... and how hard it is because the doctors and nurses are so busy?
words.meaning: 好……他还说这件事很难，因为医生和护士们都非常忙？
朝着解决那个问题努力

words.word: Well, how would it be if you took some time to work with Dad towards solving that problem?
words.meaning: 好，那你花些时间和爸爸一起来解决这个问题怎么样？
一个固定的每周阅读活动

words.word: setting up a regular weekly reading program
words.meaning: 建立定期每周阅读活动

words.word: Like setting up a regular weekly reading program.
words.meaning: 譬如说开办一项每周一次的定期阅读计划。

words.word: You and Dr. Philip Stewart-- going to the children's ward once or twice a week and reading to them.
words.meaning: 你和Philip Stewart医生每星期就去小儿科病房一、两次，为他们朗读。

words.word: As a matter of fact, it fits right in with something I'm working on right now with the school-board committee.
words.meaning: 其实，这正好和我现在正与学区教育委员会研究的计划相吻合。
让家长与教师聚在一起
让家长和老师聚在一起

words.word: I've been trying to work out a program in the public school that will bring parents and teachers together once a week to read to the students--their own children, really.
words.meaning: 我一直努力，想研拟一项计划，在公立学校中让家长们及教师每星期一次共同为学生们——其实就是他们自己的孩子——朗读。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第20集 · 07 选择沟通时机
decks.section: 第20集 · 家庭相处、倾听与共同阅读

words.word: By doing that, it will encourage reading.
So it might fit in with a program for reading to the kids in the hospital.
words.meaning: 所以它或许也可以和给住院孩子朗读的活动结合起来。

words.word: I'm going to talk to Daddy about it right now.
words.meaning: 我现在就去跟爸爸谈谈这件事。

words.word: exhausted when he came home from work
But Dad was so exhausted when he came home from work.
words.meaning: 但爸爸工作回来时已经累得不得了了。

words.word: talk to him about it tomorrow
Why don't you talk to him about it tomorrow?
You are a very smart young man, Robbie.
words.meaning: 你是个绝顶聪明的年轻人，Robbie。

words.word: I think I'll wait until tomorrow.
I promise you I won't forget
It is a great idea, and I promise you I won't forget.
words.meaning: 这是个极好的主意。我向你保证，我不会忘的。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第20集 · 08 早晨交流计划
decks.section: 第20集 · 家庭相处、倾听与共同阅读

words.meaning: 花儿闻起来好香，不是吗？

words.word: That's why I'm reading my paper and having my coffee on the patio this morning.
words.meaning: 所以今天早上我才在露台上看报、喝咖啡。

words.word: How was your school-board meeting last night?
words.meaning: 你昨晚的学区教育委员会会议开得怎么样？

words.word: You must've come home very late.
Did you find the sandwich I made for you?
words.meaning: 你找到我给你做的三明治了吗？

words.word: I was so tired I didn't even finish it.
words.meaning: 我太累了，没有能吃完它。

words.word: Philip, I've been working on this special project with the school board, and I'd like your opinion about it.
words.meaning: Philip，我一直在和学区教育委员会研究一项特别计划，想听听你的意见。

words.word: I've been trying to find a way to encourage reading.
words.meaning: 我一直在寻求鼓励阅读的办法。

words.word: Well, I think I may have found a way to do it.
words.meaning: 噢，我想我也许已找到一种办法。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第20集 · 09 说明活动的目的与时间
decks.section: 第20集 · 家庭相处、倾听与共同阅读
decks.shortName: 09 说明活动的目的与时间

words.word: I work with families every day, Ellen.
words.meaning: 我每天的工作就是接触一些家庭，Ellen。

words.word: I see how people spend their leisure time-- young and old.
words.meaning: 我看到人们怎样利用闲暇时间－不管是年轻的，还是年老的。

words.word: Well, that would be OK if, and I repeat, if people took the time to read.
words.meaning: 那倒没有什么关系，只要，我重复一遍，只要人们肯花时间去阅读。

words.word: I couldn't agree with you more.
The question is, how do we get them to read more?
words.meaning: 问题是，我们怎样才能使他们多阅读？

words.word: I think you're going to give me the answer to that question.
words.meaning: 我想你是要给我这个问题的答案。

words.word: You have that look in your eye.
words.meaning: 你的眼睛里显示出你已有了答案。

words.word: I do have an answer, Philip.
Or at least I think I do.
The plan is a simple one.
Involve the entire family in a reading project.
words.meaning: 让整个家庭都参与阅读计划。

words.word: But how do you plan to do that?
By arranging with the public schools to schedule one hour a week--to start with.
words.meaning: 先和公立学校商量，一开始每周安排一小时。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第20集 · 10 一起尝试与增进相处
decks.section: 第20集 · 家庭相处、倾听与共同阅读

words.word: During that time parents are invited to attend-- and to read along with the children--their children.
words.meaning: 在那段时间里，我们邀请家长来，和孩子们一起阅读——就是他们自己的孩子。

words.word: It can go beyond the school system, Ellen.
words.meaning: 这可以推广到学校体制以外，Ellen。

words.word: I guarantee you it would go very well in the hospitals.
words.meaning: 我保证在医院这种计划会推行得很好。
自己阅读以及听别人朗读

words.word: My patients--mostly kids-- would love to read and be read to.
words.meaning: 我的病人，大多是孩子，会喜欢自己读，也喜欢听别人读给他们听。
看看这个计划实施得怎么样
在你的病人中试一试这个活动

words.word: Maybe we can experiment with your patients and see how the plan works.
words.meaning: 也许我们可以在你的病人中试试，看看这项计划实施得如何。

words.word: Would you work with me on it?
words.meaning: 你愿意和我一起来做吗？

words.word: And that way, we'll spend more time together, Ellen.
words.meaning: 而且那样的话，我们会有更多的时间在一起，Ellen。

words.word: We just don't see each other anymore.
words.meaning: 我们彼此差不多见不到面了。

words.word: You and I are very busy these days.
words.meaning: 这些天来我们俩都很忙。

words.word: find time to be together more
We need to find time to be together more, to do things together more--you and I.
words.meaning: 我们得找时间多相处，多一起做些事情——你和我。

words.word: a wonderful way to accomplish that
This would be a wonderful way to accomplish that.
words.meaning: 这倒是达到这个目的的绝佳办法。

words.word: To the patients in the ward?

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第20集 · 11 共同朗读诗歌
decks.section: 第20集 · 家庭相处、倾听与共同阅读

words.word: What would you like to read to them?
words.meaning: 你想读些什么给他们听？

words.word: Mrs. Stewart and I will read a poem by Robert Frost.
words.meaning: Stewart太太和我要朗读Robert Frost作的一首诗。

words.word: It's called "Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening."
words.meaning: 它的题目是：『雪夜林边小驻』。

words.word: "Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening" by Robert Frost.
Whose woods these are I think I know. His house is in the village though; He will not see me stopping here To watch his woods fill up with snow.
words.meaning: 这是谁的林子，我想我知道，虽然他的屋子是在村子里；他不会看到我驻足此地注视他落满雪花的林子。

words.word: My little horse must think it queer To stop without a farmhouse near Between the woods and frozen lake The darkest evening of the year.
words.meaning: 我的小马一定感到奇怪，为何停在没有农舍的地方就在林子和冰湖之间在这一年中最漆黑的夜晚里。

words.word: He gives his harness bells a shake To ask if there is some mistake.
words.meaning: 它摇响挽具上的铃铛，好像在问是不是哪里搞错了。

words.word: The only other sound's the sweep Of easy wind and downy flake.
words.meaning: 此外唯一的声响，是轻风拂过、细雪飘落。

words.word: miles to go before I sleep
words.meaning: 睡前还有很远的路要走

words.word: The woods are lovely, dark and deep, But I have promises to keep, And miles to go before I sleep, And miles to go before I sleep.
words.meaning: 林子美丽，幽暗而深邃，但我还有承诺要履行，睡前还有很远的路要走，睡前还有很远的路要走。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第20集 · 12 分享朗读感受
decks.section: 第20集 · 家庭相处、倾听与共同阅读

words.word: You two belong on stage! That was wonderful!
words.meaning: 你们俩真该登台表演！太精彩了！

words.word: Dad ... Robbie. When did you come?
words.meaning: 爸爸……Robbie。你们什么时候来的？

words.word: We've been listening to you both.
words.meaning: 我们一直在听你们朗诵。
你们喜欢在一起朗诵吗？

words.word: Well, we may read together aloud at home.
words.meaning: 嗯，我们或许可以在家里一起大声朗诵。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第21集 · 01 试穿与分享家庭幸福
decks.section: 第21集 · 工作机会、搬迁与共同决定

words.word: I really like this one Susan. Do you?
words.meaning: Susan，我真的很喜欢这一件，你呢？

words.word: Turn around, Michelle. Let me see the back of it.
words.meaning: 转过去一下，Michelle。让我看看它的背面。

words.word: I like it a lot. It fits well.
It doesn't need any alterations. We must've bought the right size.
words.meaning: 不需作任何修改。我们一定是买对了尺寸。

words.word: I like the color. She looks good in blue.
words.meaning: 我喜欢这颜色。她穿蓝色的很好看。

words.word: Try on the skirt and blouse outfit
words.meaning: 试穿裙子和衬衫那套衣服

words.word: Try on the skirt and blouse outfit, Michelle-- the one that Daddy wanted you to wear.
words.meaning: 试试上衣和裙子的那一套吧，Michelle。爸爸要你穿的那一套。

words.word: Michelle has been a different kid since we've been married.
words.meaning: 自从我们结婚之后，Michelle变成另一个人了。
她从来没有像现在这样快乐过。

words.word: And I've never been happier, Harry.
words.meaning: 我也从来没有这样快乐过，Harry。
她一直给我们带来快乐

words.word: I love her very much. She's been a joy.
words.meaning: 我很爱她。她是个讨人喜欢的孩子。

words.word: We're very lucky, the three of us ... and becoming part of the Stewart family, too.
words.meaning: 我们三个真幸运……还成为了 Stewart 家的一部分。

words.word: We couldn't ask for anything more, could we?
words.meaning: 我们再没什么可求的了，对吗？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第21集 · 02 发现衣物不合身
decks.section: 第21集 · 工作机会、搬迁与共同决定

words.word: Well ...? Could we ask for anything more?
words.meaning: 嗯……？我们还有什么可求的吗？

words.word: How do you like it, Daddy?
It's good for every day. It will be good for school, Michelle.
words.meaning: 这套适合日常穿，也适合上学穿，Michelle。

words.word: I like it, too. I always like skirts that go like this.
words.meaning: 我也喜欢它。我一直喜欢能像这样飘动的裙子。

words.word: Do you want to see the winter jacket on me, Susan?
words.meaning: 你想看看我穿上冬季的夹克怎样吗，Susan？

words.word: put on the new winter jacket
Yes, I do. Change back into your jeans, and put on the new winter jacket we bought today.
words.meaning: 是的，我想看看。换回你的牛仔裤，也把我们今天买的冬季夹克穿上。

words.word: You had something on your mind when I said we couldn't ask for anything more.
words.meaning: 你显然有话要说，在我说我们再没什么可求的了的时候。

words.word: Let's take a look at the winter jacket. Come on over here, honey.
words.meaning: 让我们看看冬季夹克。到这儿来，亲爱的。

words.word: That's why we bought it for you
words.meaning: 那就是我们给你买它的原因

words.word: It is. That's why we bought it for you.
words.meaning: 是的。这就是我们买给你的原因。

words.word: This will be a perfect jacket for the wintertime when it's very cold out.
words.meaning: 这一件夹克就很受用，冬天外面很冷的时候。

words.word: But it's kind of small also. We must've bought the wrong size.
words.meaning: 但它也有点小了。我们一定买错了尺寸。
本应该买一件大一些的

words.word: Looks like we should've bought a bigger one.
words.meaning: 看来我们应该买一件大些的。

words.word: I guess we'll have to exchange it, too.
words.meaning: 我想我们还得去换一件。

words.word: I'm sure the store has others.
words.meaning: 我相信那家店一定还有其它的尺寸。

words.word: I look silly! It is too small!
words.meaning: 我看来很滑稽！它太小了！

words.word: Can I take it off? I'm hot!
Sure. Put it back in your room, and we'll hang everything up later.
words.meaning: 当然。将它放回你的房间，过一会儿我们来一件件挂起来。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第21集 · 03 讨论异地工作机会
decks.section: 第21集 · 工作机会、搬迁与共同决定

words.word: Well, are you going to tell me what's on your mind, Harry?
words.meaning: 好了，你要不要告诉我你在想什么，Harry？
一家大型会计师事务所

words.word: a job with a major accounting company
words.meaning: 在大型会计师事务所的一份工作

words.word: I have been offered a job with a major accounting company in Los Angeles.
words.meaning: 洛杉矶一家大型会计师事务所向我发出了工作邀约。

words.word: I have been offered a job with a major accounting company in Los Angeles.
words.meaning: 洛杉矶一家大型会计师事务所向我发出了工作邀约。

words.word: Los Angeles? That's a big decision.
I know. It will also affect you and your job, if we decide to go.
words.meaning: 我知道。假如我们决定去的话，也会影响到你和你的工作。

words.word: Wow! It sure will. But first tell me about the job, Harry.
words.meaning: 喔！当然会。但首先告诉我是什么样的工作，Harry。
设法让这件事适合我们一家

words.word: If it's a good one, then we'll make it work for us.
words.meaning: 如果是份好工作，我们会想办法让它适合我们一家。

words.word: a client in the garment business
I have a client in the garment business, on Seventh Avenue.
words.meaning: 我有个客户在Seventh Avenue从事成衣生意。

words.word: I do his taxes every year.

words.meaning: 承办他主要的会计业务

words.word: He has a big sales office in Los Angeles, and the company in Los Angeles that does his major accounting work is looking for an executive. And he recommended me.
words.meaning: 他在Los Angeles有一个大的销售办事处，而在Los Angeles承办他主要会计工作的那家公司正在物色一位主管。他推荐了我。

words.word: Yes, but it would mean that we'd have to move to L.A.
words.meaning: 是的。但这意味着我们必须搬到Los Angeles。

words.word: a chance to talk with you
Susan, I don't plan to make any decisions until I have a chance to talk with you about it.
words.meaning: Susan，我不打算做决定，除非我有机会跟你谈过。

words.word: And I don't have to make a quick decision.
words.meaning: 而且我也不需很快下决定。

words.word: They know that I'm married and that I have a family.
words.meaning: 他们知道我结婚了，有一个家。

words.word: Well, there's a lot to think about.
If it's a good job, then I've got to do some thinking about my career opportunities in Los Angeles.
words.meaning: 假如它是个好工作，那么我就必须考虑考虑我在Los Angeles的事业机会。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第21集 · 04 向祖父请教
decks.section: 第21集 · 工作机会、搬迁与共同决定

words.word: Hello. Hello there. Are you ready for lunch with your grandpa?
words.meaning: 哈罗。哈罗。你准备好跟你的祖父一起吃午饭吗？

words.word: Oh! Hi, Grandpa. Yes, of course, I am, but my mind isn't.
words.meaning: 噢，嗨，爷爷。是的，当然，我准备好了，但是有点心事。

words.word: Does it have anything to do with you and Harry?
Yes, but I don't know where to start.
words.meaning: 是的，但我不知道从何说起。

words.word: Maybe I can help. Tell me what it is, Susan.
words.meaning: 也许我能帮忙。说给我听听，Susan。

words.meaning: 噢！有人聘请Harry到Los Angeles工作。

words.meaning: 噢，这种事确实需要想一想。

words.word: There are so many things to consider. There's Michelle.
words.meaning: 要考虑的事太多了。首先是Michelle。

words.word: a move would be a bad thing for her
words.meaning: 搬家对她可能不是好事

words.word: I wonder if a move would be a bad thing for her. And my job.
words.meaning: 我不知道搬家对她来说是否是件坏事。还有我的工作。

words.word: I don't know if I can get a good job in Los Angeles.
words.meaning: 我不知道我能否在Los Angeles找到好工作。
另外就是我们家的人怎么办？

words.word: Can I tell you what I think?
words.meaning: 让我来告诉你我的想法好吗？

words.word: a fantastic reputation in the toy industry
words.meaning: 在玩具行业极好的声誉

words.meaning: 我认为你事业有成而且在玩具界有很好的声誉。

words.word: help you find a real good job
words.meaning: 帮你找到一份很好的工作

words.word: I think you could talk to Mr. Marchetta, and I think he could help you find a real good job in Los Angeles.
words.meaning: 我想你可以跟Marchetta先生谈谈，我觉得他能够帮你在Los Angeles找个很好的工作。

words.word: He was very helpful to me, remember?

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第21集 · 05 衡量支持与个人选择
decks.section: 第21集 · 工作机会、搬迁与共同决定

words.word: I suppose I could call him.
words.meaning: 我想我可以打电话给他，

words.word: But I'm not so sure that I want to leave New York, you, and the rest of our family.
words.meaning: 但我不能确定我真想离开纽约、你和我们家的其他人。

words.word: Well, I'm not going to kid you, Susan.
You know we'd all miss you.
words.meaning: 你知道我们都会思念你。

words.word: But this should be your decision.
you and Harry can work out
words.meaning: 你和 Harry 能一起商量解决

words.word: only you and Harry can work out
words.meaning: 只有你和 Harry 能一起商量决定

words.word: It's something that only you and Harry can work out.
words.meaning: 这件事只有你和Harry才能定夺。

words.meaning: 假如搬到L.A.对Harry最有利的话，我就应该尽我的力量来支持他。

words.word: In every marriage, sacrifices have to be made by one partner from time to time.
words.meaning: 婚姻中，总要有一方必须不时做些牺牲。

words.word: better off staying where she is
I think Michelle is better off staying where she is.
words.meaning: 我觉得Michelle待在原地比较好。

words.word: Well, you'll have to ask her.
get his feelings about my leaving
words.meaning: 了解他对我离职的看法

words.word: I think I'm going to have a talk with Mr. Marchetta and get his feelings about my leaving. And about helping me find a job in Los Angeles.
words.meaning: 我想我要跟Marchetta先生谈谈，徵求他关于我离开的意见。并请他帮我在Los Angeles找一份工作。

words.word: I'll call him right now. No point in delaying.
words.meaning: 我现在就打给他。没有道理要拖拉。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第21集 · 06 了解聘用条件
decks.section: 第21集 · 工作机会、搬迁与共同决定

words.word: Harry, it's the perfect job for you. You'll love it.
words.meaning: Harry，那是份最适合你的工作。你会喜欢的。

words.word: It's a big decision for me, Bill.
words.meaning: 对我来说这是个大决定，Bill。

words.word: And I have to discuss it with my wife.
words.meaning: 我必须跟我的太太讨论。

words.word: I don't know if it's right for her.
words.meaning: 我不知道这事对她是否恰当。

words.word: She'll love it. It's a once-in-a-lifetime offer, Harry.
words.meaning: 她也会喜欢的。这是个千载难逢的机会，Harry。

words.word: OK. Tell it to me again.
the biggest accounting company in the country
words.meaning: 全国最大的会计师事务所

words.meaning: 这家公司叫 Craft and Craft，是全国最大的会计师事务所。

words.word: I know the company well. It's big.
words.meaning: 这家公司我很清楚。是大公司。

words.word: Yeah, yeah. The biggest. When do I have to let you know?
words.meaning: 是的，是的，最大的。我什么时候该给你回音？

words.word: by the end of the week
Talk it over. Think it over. Let me know by the end of the week.
words.meaning: 好好地谈一谈。好好地想一想。这个周末以前让我知道你的决定。

words.word: When would we have to move?

words.meaning: 需要考虑我女儿的情况

words.word: I also have my daughter to consider.

words.meaning: 打断她这个学年的学习

words.word: I don't want to interrupt her school year.
words.meaning: 我不愿意打断她这个学年。

words.word: Let me know by the end of the week.
It's a great opportunity for you, Harry.
Craft and Craft is the biggest in the country.
words.meaning: Craft and Craft是全国最大的。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第21集 · 07 交流各自的机会
decks.section: 第21集 · 工作机会、搬迁与共同决定

words.word: I think Michelle is asleep now. Let's talk.
words.meaning: 我想Michelle现在睡着了。让我们谈谈吧。

words.word: I met with Bill York today.
And I talked with Mr. Marchetta. Did York make the offer?
words.meaning: 我也和 Marchetta 先生谈了。York 向你提出聘用邀约了吗？

words.word: asked me if I want the job
words.meaning: 问我想不想要这份工作

words.word: Yup. He asked me if I want the job.
words.meaning: 是的。他问我要不要接受那份工作。

words.word: That's exciting, Harry. What was it?
words.meaning: 太令人兴奋了，Harry。是什么样的工作？

words.word: A vice-presidency with the biggest accounting company in the country-- Craft and Craft.
words.meaning: 全国最大的会计师事务所 Craft and Craft 的副总裁职位。
还有这么多要考虑的事

words.word: Sure I am. But there's so much more to consider.
words.meaning: 我当然兴奋。但是还有那么多问题需要考虑。

words.word: What did he say? Did you tell him about me?
words.meaning: 他怎么说？你跟他谈到我吗？
通过 Marchetta 先生的帮助

words.word: Of course, Harry. I want what's best for you, and I think I can get a good job through Mr. Marchetta in Los Angeles also.
words.meaning: 当然，Harry。我要的是对你最有利的事，而且我想我也可以找到一份好工作，透过Marchetta先生的帮助在Los Angeles。

words.word: I talked with him, and he understands completely.
words.meaning: 我与他谈了，他完全了解。

words.word: He has a major toy buyer in Los Angeles, and he's pretty sure that I can get a good job there.
words.meaning: 他在Los Angeles有一个玩具大买主，他相当肯定我可以在那儿弄到一份好工作。

words.word: talk to Michelle about all of this
words.meaning: 与 Michelle 讨论整件事

words.word: But I think we should talk to Michelle about all of this.
words.meaning: 不过，我觉得我们应该和 Michelle 谈谈整件事。

words.word: You're right. We'll talk to her about it.
words.meaning: 你说得对。我们要跟她谈谈。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第21集 · 08 听孩子的想法
decks.section: 第21集 · 工作机会、搬迁与共同决定

words.word: And how do you feel about taking the job in Los Angeles?
words.meaning: 你对于到Los Angeles接受这份工作有何感想？

words.word: It's the biggest company in the country.
Well, then you feel good about taking it?
words.meaning: 嗯，那你觉得接受它很对了？

words.word: Well ... I feel fine about it. Why shouldn't I?
words.meaning: 嗯……我觉得不错。为什么不呢？

words.word: I love my school. I have so many good friends there now.
words.meaning: 我喜欢我的学校。我现在有那么多好朋友在那里。

words.word: even if I were really sick
I wouldn't miss a day even if I were really sick.
words.meaning: 即使我真的病了也不想错过一天。

words.word: Come and sit down for a minute, Michelle.
I'd like to talk to you about something.
But your daddy and I are talking about something that I'd like your opinion about.
words.meaning: 但你爸爸和我正在讨论一件事，我需要你的意见。

words.word: I know. I heard you talking about it the other night when I was trying on my new clothes.
words.meaning: 我知道。我听到你们谈论的那件事了，也就是我试新衣服的那天晚上。

words.word: It's about moving to Los Angeles.
words.meaning: 是关于搬家到Los Angeles的事。

words.word: You're right. How do you feel about it?
words.meaning: 你说对了。你觉得怎么样？

words.word: Well, I really wouldn't want to move, but ...
words.meaning: 噢，我实在不愿意搬家，但是……

words.word: But if you and Daddy wanted to, I guess you know what's best for the family and for me.
words.meaning: 但是假如你和爸爸想搬的话，我猜想你们一定知道怎样做对整个家庭和我是最有利的。

words.word: That's very considerate of you, Michelle.
what it feels like to miss someone
words.meaning: 想念一个人是什么感受

words.word: I'd miss them a lot, but I know what it feels like to miss someone.
words.meaning: 我会非常想念他们的，但我知道想念一个人是什么样的滋味。

words.word: Honey, we don't have to move if you're not going to be happy about it.
words.meaning: 亲爱的，如果这会让你不开心，我们就不必搬家。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第21集 · 09 全家表达支持
decks.section: 第21集 · 工作机会、搬迁与共同决定

words.word: I think so. He's going to tell us tonight about the job offer.
words.meaning: 我想是这样。他今天晚上会告诉我们关于那份工作的事。

words.word: Well, how was everybody's day today?
words.meaning: 喂，今天各位过得怎么样？

words.word: the school poster for the play
Michelle was chosen to do the school poster for the play this year.
words.meaning: Michelle被挑选去制作今年学校话剧的海报。

words.word: And how was your day, Susan?
I see you're in a good mood.
Why don't you tell us about your day.
words.meaning: 何不告诉我们你这一天过得如何？

words.word: It's OK to talk about it, Harry.
Michelle and I have all kinds of feelings about leaving New York, the family, and friends.
words.meaning: Michelle和我感觉很复杂，对于离开纽约、家人、朋友。

words.word: But if you think you should take the job, we're behind you.
words.meaning: 但如果你认为你应该接受这份工作，我们支持你。

words.word: We'll move after the school term.
words.meaning: 我们等这学期结束后再搬。

words.word: I'll make new friends wherever we are as long as we're together.
words.meaning: 只要我们能在一起，无论在哪儿我都能交到新朋友。

words.word: Whatever you think is right for you is right for us.
words.meaning: 你认为对你是好的对我们来说也是好的。

words.word: I am so touched. The two of you are really something.
words.meaning: 我太感动了。你们俩真了不起。

decks.section: 第21集 · 工作机会、搬迁与共同决定

words.meaning: 好啦，现在告诉我们你跟York先生的谈话吧。

words.meaning: 对，我没有接受那份工作。

words.word: Harry, you didn't turn it down because of me ...
words.meaning: Harry，你拒绝它该不是因为我……

words.meaning: 为我自己的缘故拒绝了它

words.meaning: 不，不。我因为我自己而拒绝了它。

words.meaning: 噢，我开始想到你和Michelle，然后我问自己，我真的想替全国最大的公司工作吗？

words.word: I went into business for myself because I like being my own boss.
words.meaning: 我当初自己开业，就是因为我喜欢自己当老板。

words.meaning: 我经营自己的公司，是小池里的大鱼。

words.word: a little fish in a big pond
words.meaning: 大池里的小鱼，大环境中的普通一员

words.word: I'm not really sure I want to be a little fish in a big pond.
words.meaning: 我不是真的很确定我想成为一条大池里的小鱼。

words.word: Oh, Daddy, does that mean we don't have to move?
words.meaning: 噢，爸爸，你的意思是我们不必搬家了？

words.word: I couldn't be more sure, Susan.

words.meaning: 假如你很确定，我就高兴，Harry。

words.meaning: 更何况我怎么能住在Los Angeles，而所有我喜欢的人都在这里？

words.meaning: 我一直为是否回去工作这个问题反复思量。

words.word: pursue my career in fashion design
words.meaning: 发展我的时装设计事业

words.word: like we always thought I would

words.meaning: 我真的想回去工作，发挥我的才智，追求我在时装设计方面的事业，就像我们一向认定的那样。

words.meaning: 我又想和Max在一起，做个全职的母亲，特别是，他还是个婴儿的时候。

words.meaning: 而且我也能随时安排我的摄影工作配合你的时间表，假如那样有所帮助的话。

words.meaning: 你已跟你的老板讨论过回去工作的事吗？

words.meaning: 噢！就是那通电话使你开始思量起来的，是吗？

words.meaning: 她想知道我打算什么时候回去时装店工作。

words.meaning: 我说这几天给她回答……我说我不能确定。

words.word: I'm sure Rita Mae will understand and wait until you're ready to go back to work.
words.meaning: 我相信Rita Mae会理解的，而且会等你准备好了才回去工作。

words.word: Well, maybe she will, and maybe she won't.
words.meaning: 嗯，也许她会，也许她不会。

words.meaning: 假如我不接受她这个工作机会，她也许会在这段时间找别的人。而当我准备好要回去时，已经没有空缺了。

But I am thinking about myself.
words.meaning: 但我就是在为自己着想呀。
我作为 Max 母亲的事业

words.word: It's also my career as Max's mother.
words.meaning: 当Max的母亲也是我的事业。

words.word: the way I look at it
That's the way I look at it.
words.meaning: 我就是这么看这件事的。

words.word: I have two career opportunities at the same time.
words.meaning: 我同时有两个事业机会。

words.word: My career as a fashion designer and my career as a mother.
words.meaning: 时装设计事业和担任Max母亲的事业。

words.word: being a mother as a career
I never really thought about being a mother as a career.
words.meaning: 我真的从来没有想到做母亲还是一种事业。

words.word: I guess you do have two career opportunities and a decision to make.
words.meaning: 我想你的确是有两个事业机会，而且必须做一个抉择。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第22集 · 04 聊孩子的日常
decks.section: 第22集 · 育儿、职业选择与在家工作

words.word: He just loves that teddy bear that Grandpa Philip bought for him.
words.meaning: 他特别喜欢 Philip 爷爷给他买的那个玩具熊。
带他去 Philip 的诊所

words.meaning: 我昨天带他到Philip的办公室去做检查。

words.meaning: Molly 给他打针时，你真该看看他脸上的表情。

words.meaning: 我亲爱的小男孩只是仰头看着我，好像在说：“妈妈，他们在对我做什么？救命呀！”
你当时没有觉得难受吗？

words.word: the top of his dear little head
words.meaning: 他可爱的小脑袋的头顶

words.word: I kissed the top of his dear little head.
words.meaning: 我吻着他可爱的小头顶。

words.word: Being a mother is not easy
Being a mother is not easy, if that's what you mean.
words.meaning: 当一个母亲真不容易，你是这个意思吧。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第22集 · 05 请教前辈经验
decks.section: 第22集 · 育儿、职业选择与在家工作

words.word: I've been meaning to ask you

words.meaning: 说到做母亲，我一直想问，你对回去工作这件事考虑得怎么样了。
我知道Rita Mae打电话给你了。

words.word: I can imagine what is going through your head.
words.meaning: 我能想像你的头脑里正在考虑什么事。

words.word: There are so many things to consider.

words.meaning: 有我们在你身边支持你

words.meaning: 有一件事可以使你作起决定来比较容易些，就是有我们帮你。

words.word: Max will always have a family member to watch over him while you're at work.
words.meaning: 家里总会有一个人照顾Max，在你工作的时候。

words.word: when Richard and Susan were born
words.meaning: Richard 和 Susan 出生时

words.word: I didn't have that when Richard and Susan were born.
words.meaning: 在Richard和Susan出生时我可没有人帮忙。

words.word: I chose to continue with my career as a music teacher.
words.meaning: 我选择继续我的音乐教师的事业。

words.meaning: 我们雇用一名女士来照顾Richard，后来又照顾Susan，而我则继续我的事业。

words.word: Do you think you made the right decision?
words.meaning: 你认为你的决定正确吗？

words.meaning: 但是 Robbie 出生时，我决定把全部精力放在抚养他上。

words.word: I felt differently at that time.
words.meaning: 那时我的感觉又不一样了。

words.word: And you gave up your career as a music teacher?
words.meaning: 那么你就放弃了音乐教师的事业？

words.word: I continued to teach piano lessons at home.
when Susan and Richard were babies
words.meaning: Susan 和 Richard 还是婴儿时

words.meaning: 你对出外工作作何感觉，当Richard和Susan还很小时？

words.word: I think I did the right thing for them and for myself and for Philip.
words.meaning: 我觉得我做了一件对的事为他们、为我自己和Philip。

words.word: getting that house we want and need

words.word: Everything I earn helps us towards getting that house we want and need.
words.meaning: 我挣的每一笔钱都能帮助我们买到那栋既想要又需要的房子。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第22集 · 06 向忙碌的亲人求助
decks.section: 第22集 · 育儿、职业选择与在家工作
