words.meaning: 我迫不及待地希望他长大些。

words.word: Our toy company makes the most wonderful toys for kids.
words.meaning: 我们玩具公司为小孩子们制造最棒的玩具。

words.word: Now may I please say hello?
words.meaning: 现在我可以说声哈罗了吗？

words.word: I miss Max and think about him all week long.
words.meaning: 我想念Max，一整个星期都在想他。

words.word: We talk about him at dinnertime.
words.meaning: 我们吃晚餐时总谈起他。

words.word: Will you please try to relax?
I've never seen you so wound up.
words.meaning: 我从来没见你这么紧绷过。

words.word: You seem to be enjoying the pressure.
words.meaning: 你看起来好像很乐于承受压力。

words.word: My job is not an easy one, but I really enjoy it.
words.meaning: 我的工作并不轻松，但我确实乐在工作。

words.word: exactly what I wanted to talk to you about
That is exactly what I wanted to talk to you about, Susan.
words.meaning: 这正是我想要跟你谈的，Susan。
是的，我的事业抉择问题。

words.word: My career as a fashion designer
My career as a fashion designer versus my career as a mother.
words.meaning: 我以时装设计为事业，或是以当个母亲为事业。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第22集 · 07 寻找兼顾的方案
decks.section: 第22集 · 育儿、职业选择与在家工作

words.word: Why does it have to be one or the other?

words.meaning: 你为什么不能两样一起做？

words.word: I have a job, and I have Michelle.
to the best of my ability
I take care of both to the best of my ability.
words.meaning: 我尽我最大的能力照顾好这两方面。

words.word: It's not easy, but what is?
words.meaning: 这不容易，但什么事又容易了？

words.word: I did both with Richard and Susan, and I did both with Robbie.
words.meaning: 有Richard和Susan时我这样做，有Robbie时我也这样做的。

words.word: I thought you stayed home with Robbie?
words.meaning: 我还以为你是跟Robbie待在家里的？

words.word: But I was lucky enough to have a career as a music teacher which I could continue at home.
words.meaning: 但我很幸运，有一个音乐教师的事业可以在家中继续从事。

words.word: Why can't you work at home, Marilyn?
words.meaning: 你为什么不能在家中工作呢，Marilyn？

words.word: Designing dresses is a career you could establish out of your home, couldn't you?
words.meaning: 服装设计是可以在家里开创的一项事业，不是吗？

words.word: why I didn't think of it
words.meaning: 为什么我没想到这一点

words.word: I don't know why I didn't think of it.
words.meaning: 我不知道为什么我没有想到这一点。
现在事情显得很简单了。

words.word: For a year or two I could stay at home with Max and do my dress designs.
words.meaning: 在一两年内，我可以和Max待在家里并从事我的服装设计。

words.word: And you could make your dresses at home.
Sounds like a great way to solve the problem.
words.meaning: 听起来好像是个解决问题的好办法。

words.word: That could solve your problem, Marilyn.
words.meaning: 这样可以解决你的问题，Marilyn。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第22集 · 08 安排进一步商谈
decks.section: 第22集 · 育儿、职业选择与在家工作

words.word: come by and talk about it
I'm going to call Rita Mae at home and ask her to come by and talk about it.
words.meaning: 我会打电话到Rita Mae家里，请她过来谈谈这件事。

words.word: She wants to see Max, anyway.
I think that really answers your questions, Marilyn.
words.meaning: 我觉得这确实解决了你的问题，Marilyn。

words.word: And let Rita Mae do the selling at the boutique.
words.meaning: 而让Rita Mae在时装店里负责销售。

words.word: And you can both benefit financially.
words.meaning: 你们俩都获得金钱上的利益。

words.word: I'm going to call Rita Mae right now.
words.meaning: 我现在就打电话给Rita Mae。

words.word: coming all this way from the city
Oh, Susan, thank you so much for coming all this way from the city to talk to me about it.
words.meaning: Susan，真谢谢你从城里大老远来和我谈这件事。

words.word: taken so much time away from your busy schedule
words.meaning: 从你繁忙的日程中抽出这么多时间

words.word: I hope you don't mind having taken so much time away from your busy schedule.
words.meaning: 希望你不介意从繁忙的日程中抽了这么多时间出来。

words.word: spend some time with my favorite nephew
words.meaning: 花些时间陪我心爱的侄子

words.word: As a matter of fact, I came to spend some time with my favorite nephew.
words.meaning: 事实上，我来是为了和我心爱的侄儿相聚一些时间。

words.word: I think you should call Rita Mae right now.
words.meaning: 我想你现在就打电话给Rita Mae。

words.word: your idea of working at home
I think your idea of working at home is perfect.
words.meaning: 我觉得你在家里工作的主意太好了。

words.word: what I would do without you
I don't know what I would do without you.
words.meaning: 我真不知道没有你们我怎么办。

words.word: I'm lucky to have you all.
words.meaning: 我真的觉得拥有你们很幸运。

words.word: We are lucky to have you, Marilyn.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第22集 · 09 接待来访伙伴
decks.section: 第22集 · 育儿、职业选择与在家工作

words.word: She must like you and your work, Marilyn.
words.meaning: 她一定是喜欢你和你的工作，Marilyn。

words.word: I think she's just anxious to see Max.
words.meaning: 我觉得她只是急着想看Max。

words.word: It's so nice of you to come.
Oh, I just wanted to see your baby, Max.
words.meaning: 噢，我只是想看看你的宝贝，Max。

words.word: I haven't seen you since the hospital.
words.meaning: 自从医院相遇之后再也没有见到你。

words.word: It's just a little present for Max.
words.meaning: 这仅仅是给Max的一件小礼物。

words.word: some coffee or tea or a cold drink
Can I get you some coffee or tea or a cold drink, Rita Mae?
words.meaning: 你要咖啡、茶或者冷饮吗，Rita Mae？

words.word: Well, I will leave you two to talk.
Let me know if you need anything.
words.meaning: 假如你需要什么就通知我。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第22集 · 10 说明决定的两部分
decks.section: 第22集 · 育儿、职业选择与在家工作

words.word: You sounded like you've made a decision when you called me.
words.meaning: 你打电话给我时，听起来像是已经作出了决定。

words.word: I have made a decision, Rita Mae.
I've decided to stay at home and be a full-time mother.
words.meaning: 我决定留在家里做一个专职母亲。

words.word: I'm disappointed, but I respect your decision.
words.meaning: 我很失望，但我尊重你的决定。

words.word: I might do the same thing
If I had a child as cute as Max, I might do the same thing.
words.meaning: 假如我有一个像Max这样可爱的孩子，我也可能会做同样的决定。

words.word: the other half of my decision
But I haven't finished telling you the other half of my decision.
words.meaning: 但我还没有对你说完我这个决定的另一半。

words.word: I think I can stay at home and take care of Max and continue my career.
words.meaning: 我觉得我可以待在家里，一面照顾孩子，同时继续我的事业。
我们关于定制服装的讨论

words.word: Do you remember our talks about custom-designed dresses for the boutique?
words.meaning: 你记得我们以前谈过，为店里设计定制服装的事吗？

words.word: Why can't I design dresses for you here at home?
words.meaning: 为什么我不能在家里为你设计服装呢？
在这里试衣和调整尺寸
试衣和调整尺寸也可以在这里做。

words.word: And I could do the selling and the pricing at the boutique.
words.meaning: 而我可以在店里负责销售和定价。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第22集 · 11 讨论产品与首位顾客
decks.section: 第22集 · 育儿、职业选择与在家工作

words.word: What kind of dresses would you design?
I've thought about that for some time.
There's a big market today in wedding dresses.
words.meaning: 结婚礼服在目前有很大的市场。

words.word: I like the idea very much.
expand to all kinds of dresses
And if it's successful, we can expand to all kinds of dresses.
words.meaning: 假如成功的话，我们可以扩展到所有种类的服装。

words.word: a customer for your first wedding dress
As a matter of fact, I have a customer for your first wedding dress.
words.meaning: 事实上，我已经有了你的第一套结婚礼服的顾客。

words.word: just the right thing for her
trying to find just the right thing
words.meaning: 一直想找到正合适的东西

words.word: My niece is getting married, and I've been trying to find just the right thing for her.
words.meaning: 我侄女即将结婚，而我一直在为她找件合适的东西。

words.word: Marilyn, you're going to design my niece's dress.
words.meaning: Marilyn，我侄女的婚纱就由你来设计。
用它来带动其他款式的销售

words.word: That'll be our first one, and then we'll use it to sell others.
words.meaning: 这将成为我们的第一件，然后我们再利用它来销售其他的。

words.word: It's a simple idea, and it will work.
words.meaning: 这主意很简单，而且一定可行。

words.word: And there's no reason why you can't do it from your home.
words.meaning: 而且也没有理由你不可以在家里做。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第22集 · 12 分享兴奋与展示设计
decks.section: 第22集 · 育儿、职业选择与在家工作

words.word: I can't wait to tell Richard!
words.meaning: 我简直迫不及待想告诉Richard！

words.word: be near him all the time
If I had a baby like Max, I'd want to stay home and be near him all the time, too.
words.meaning: 如果我有个像 Max 这样的宝宝，我也会想待在家里，时时陪在他身边。

words.word: for Max and for yourself too
You're making the right decision for Max and for yourself too, Marilyn.
words.meaning: 你做了一个正确的决定为Max，也为你自己，Marilyn。
一切听起来竟是如此简单。
艰苦的工作现在开始了。

words.word: Would you like to see some of my designs that I've been working on?
words.meaning: 你想不想看我正在设计的一些服装呢？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第23集 · 01 理解社区中心困境
decks.section: 第23集 · 社区中心、志愿协作与共同计划

words.word: has my friend Nat Baker real upset
words.meaning: 让我的朋友 Nat Baker 很难过

words.word: The editorial in this paper has my friend Nat Baker real upset.
words.meaning: 这张报纸上的社论着实令我的朋友Nat Baker不高兴。

words.word: Ah! I'll read it to you.
was supposed to be made into
as well as the younger people

"The old library building on Chestnut Street, which has been vacant for over a year now, was supposed to be made into a community center to serve the senior citizens as well as the younger people of Riverdale.
words.meaning: 栗树街的旧图书馆已空置一年多，本来计划改成社区中心，为 Riverdale 的老年居民和年轻人共同服务。

words.word: Due to lack of funds for the repainting of the interior of the building and for the furniture needed, the plans for the community center have been postponed indefinitely."
words.meaning: 由于缺乏经费用来重新粉刷内部和购买必需家俱，这项修建社区中心的计划被迫无限期延缓。”

words.word: He's coming over to talk about it.
words.meaning: 他就是要来谈这个问题。

words.word: Is it that serious a problem, Grandpa?
words.meaning: 这个问题有那么重要吗，爷爷？

words.word: Nat's not as lucky as I am, Robbie.
doesn't have any family with him
He doesn't have any family with him.
words.meaning: 他没有家人和他在一起。

words.word: depends on places like a community center
words.meaning: 依靠社区中心这样的地方

words.word: He lives alone and depends on places like a community center to be with people--people his own age.
words.meaning: 他独自生活，依靠社区中心这样的地方与人交往，尤其是同龄人。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第23集 · 02 比较不同群体需求
decks.section: 第23集 · 社区中心、志愿协作与共同计划

words.word: But there's the old community center on Elm Street.
words.meaning: 但是在Elm街有一个旧的社区中心。

words.word: set up primarily for kids to play
words.meaning: 主要设置来供孩子们玩耍

words.word: It's small, and the problem is that it's set up primarily for kids to play.
words.meaning: 它小小的，而问题是它主要是让孩子们去玩的。

words.word: Ping-Pong tables, soda machines, and lots of music.
words.meaning: 乒乓球台，汽水贩卖机，热闹的音乐。

words.word: It's too noisy for some older people like Nat.
words.meaning: 它对于像Nat这样的老人来说太吵了。
我从来没有意识到这点。

words.word: It's hard for some older people to take all that noise.
words.meaning: 一些老年人没办法忍受那些噪音。

words.word: That's why the new community center is a good idea.
words.meaning: 这就是为什么说新的社区中心是个好主意。

words.word: Part of the building for older people, part of the building for younger people.
words.meaning: 建筑物中的一部分给老年人用，另一部分给年轻人用。

words.word: She's coming over this morning to help me with my math.
words.meaning: 她今天早晨要过来帮我补习数学。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第23集 · 03 招待与学习安排
decks.section: 第23集 · 社区中心、志愿协作与共同计划

words.word: Do you want something cold to drink?
words.meaning: 你想喝点什么冰凉的东西吗？

words.word: I really appreciate you coming over to help me with my math.
words.meaning: 我真的很感谢你过来帮我补习数学。

words.word: My final exam is next Tuesday.
You're so good in all your other subjects.
I just can't understand why you have so many problems with math.
words.meaning: 我就不懂为什么你在数学方面有那么多问题。

words.word: I thought that was Nat Baker who rang the front doorbell.
words.meaning: 我还以为是Nat Baker 按大门门铃呢。

words.word: We're just having some cola before getting to the tough stuff--math.
words.meaning: 我们只是先喝点可乐，在对付难缠的东西——数学——之前。

words.word: avoid getting down to math lessons
He'll do anything to avoid getting down to math lessons, Mr. Stewart.
words.meaning: 他老是设法想逃避数学，Stewart 先生。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第23集 · 04 回忆学习经历
decks.section: 第23集 · 社区中心、志愿协作与共同计划

words.word: I wasn't good at it, and I didn't like studying it.
words.meaning: 我不精于此道，也不爱去学它。

words.word: had to be good at math
But you had to be good at math.
I was. But not in high school.
For some reason, I couldn't get a handle on it.
words.meaning: 出于某些原因，那时我就是掌握不了。

words.word: Then, in college, I became good at it.
words.meaning: 然后，在大学里我变得很精于数学。

words.word: You think I can just skip it now and get to it at college?
words.meaning: 你想我现在略过数学，等到上了大学再学，可以吗？

words.word: You'll never get to college to find out, Robbie, if you skip it now.
words.meaning: 你根本就进不了大学去探究这个问题的答案， Robbie，假如你现在略过它的话。
我们开始学习或工作吧

words.word: Sit down, Robbie. Let's get to work.
words.meaning: 坐下来，Robbie，让我们开始做功课吧。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第23集 · 05 介绍来客与讨论问题
decks.section: 第23集 · 社区中心、志愿协作与共同计划

words.word: I'd like you to meet my friend Nat Baker.
words.meaning: 我来向你们介绍我的朋友Nat  Baker。

words.word: you've met once or twice before
This is Alexandra Pappas, and this is my grandson Robbie, whom I think you've met once or twice before.
words.meaning: 这是Alexandra  Pappas，这是我孙子Robbie，我想你以前见过他一两次面。

words.word: Nice to meet you, Mr. Baker.
Hi, Mr. Baker. We met before.
words.meaning: 嗨，Baker先生，我们以前见过面。

words.word: In town. At the hardware store.

words.meaning: 我现在想起来了。对了。嗨。

words.word: keep you from your math tutoring
Don't let us keep you from your math tutoring, Robbie.
words.meaning: 别让我们妨碍你的数学家教，Robbie。

words.word: I know you want to get to it.
I told you. He'll use any excuse to avoid math.
words.meaning: 我说嘛，他就是要找各种藉口来逃避数学。

words.word: Did you read the story in the paper, Malcolm?
words.meaning: 你看到报纸上的新闻了吗，Malcolm？

words.word: It's a serious matter for a lot of us.
words.meaning: 对我们许多人来说这可是个严重的问题。

words.word: It is. Come on out to the patio.
We'll talk about it out there.
Thanks. Nice to meet you ... again.
Come on! You'll hear about it.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第23集 · 06 提出修复计划
decks.section: 第23集 · 社区中心、志愿协作与共同计划

words.word: We get our friends to roll their sleeves up and get to work.
words.meaning: 我们把朋友召集起来，一起卷起袖子干。

words.word: what it requires to fix it up
take a look at the place
If I could take a look at the place, I could probably tell what it requires to fix it up.
words.meaning: 假如我能看看那个地方的话，我大致能说出修复它需要些什么。

words.word: How much paint, how many hours of work ...
words.meaning: 多少油漆，多少小时的工作量……

words.word: That's what I came to ask you to do, Malcolm.
If you would supervise the refurbishing, I'll find the people to help do it.
words.meaning: 假如你能监督整修过程，我可以找人来帮忙。

words.word: get some of my friends to
I can get some of my friends to go around the neighborhood and collect the furniture we need.
words.meaning: 我可以叫我的朋友们在这社区募集我们需要的家具 。

words.word: Tomorrow. Yes. We'll meet tomorrow morning, right here.
words.meaning: 明天。对，我们明天早晨会面，就在这儿。
带着朋友们来出力相助

words.word: We might need you to come through with your friends, Robbie.
words.meaning: Robbie，我们可能需要你和朋友们真正来出力。

words.word: Not just to go around the neighborhood asking for furniture, but to help with the paint job.
words.meaning: 不仅在这社区募家具，还要帮忙粉刷。

words.word: That's backbreaking work and may be too much for us.
words.meaning: 这可是累人的工作，我们可能负荷不了。

words.word: I'll do it. I'll talk to them.
words.meaning: 我来做，我去跟他们谈一谈。

words.word: meet here to discuss the plan
And tomorrow morning we'll all meet here to discuss the plan?
words.meaning: 是不是明天早晨我们都聚到这里来讨论整修计划？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第23集 · 07 开会与等待同伴
decks.section: 第23集 · 社区中心、志愿协作与共同计划

words.word: Come in, come in. Please, come in.
I'd like you to meet my friend Malcolm Stewart.
words.meaning: 我来为你介绍我的朋友Malcolm  Stewart。

words.word: Hello, Joanne. Nice to meet you.
And this is Abe Lucas. You must remember Abe.
play drums with the jazz band
He ran the drugstore and used to play drums with the jazz band on weekends.
words.meaning: 他以前经营药店，周末还常在爵士乐队里打鼓。

words.word: Oh, sure I do. Hi, Abe.
Sit down, sit down. Have some coffee.
And I've got some delicious Danish pastry for you.
words.meaning: 我为你们准备了一些可口的丹麦点心。

words.word: Where's your grandson Robbie and his friend Alexandra?
words.meaning: 你的孙子Robbie和他的朋友Alexandra呢？

words.word: Weren't they going to be here this morning?
words.meaning: 他们不是今天早上要来这儿吗？

words.word: Robbie left early this morning to meet Alexandra.
Frankly, I thought they'd be here, but ...
words.meaning: 老实说，我原以为他们会在这儿，但……

words.word: It's OK. I'm sure they meant well, but they probably had other things on their minds.
words.meaning: 没有关系。我敢说他们有心帮忙，但他们也许还有其他的事想要做。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第23集 · 08 确认建筑状况
decks.section: 第23集 · 社区中心、志愿协作与共同计划

words.word: used to be in the construction business
I understand you used to be in the construction business, Malcolm.
words.meaning: 听说你过去从事营造业，Malcolm。

words.word: make sure that it is in good condition
I wonder if you would take a look at the old library and make sure that it is in good condition so that we don't have to worry about any structural problems.
words.meaning: 我不知道你是否可以看一看旧图书馆，确定它状况良好，我们就可以不用担心任何结构上的问题。

words.word: When can I do that? I'd be happy to.
words.meaning: 我什么时候可以去看？我很乐意做这项工作。

words.word: We've got permission to go inside the old building during the week-- Tuesday or Wednesday.
words.meaning: 我们已获准在本周二或周三进入那座旧建筑。

words.word: That's fine with me. I can do it either day.
words.meaning: 对我来说时间很适合。两天中哪一天我都可以。

words.word: I think the building just needs a good cleaning.
words.meaning: 我想那座建筑只需要好好地打扫一下。

words.word: Then we have to furnish it.
words.meaning: 然后还得给它配上家具。

words.word: I wish Robbie and Alexandra had come to this meeting.
words.meaning: 我真希望Robbie和Alexandra已经来参加开会。

words.word: They had some ideas about getting the place fixed up.
words.meaning: 他们对于怎么样修复这个地方有些构想。
一些补充的思考与想法

words.word: Perhaps they'll show up. In the meantime, let me give you some additional thoughts and ideas I have.
words.meaning: 也许他们会露面。在这等待期间，让我提出一些另外的想法。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第23集 · 09 跨代活动与同伴去向
decks.section: 第23集 · 社区中心、志愿协作与共同计划

words.word: As I said, mostly the building just needs a good cleaning.
words.meaning: 就像我先前所说的，这栋建筑物大部份仅需要好好打扫一下。
一个真正跨代际的活动项目

words.word: This place can be developed with one real intergenerational program.
words.meaning: 我们可以在这里开展一个真正跨代际的活动项目。

words.word: A community center with the kinds of programs that fit everyone.
words.meaning: 一个社区中心，拥有适合任何人的各式活动。

words.word: And programs that don't leave anyone out.
words.meaning: 而且这些活动不把任何人排除在外。

words.word: without talking to the young people
But we can't do it without talking to the young people.
words.meaning: 但我们不能在没有跟年轻人谈谈的情况下就去做。

words.word: If only Robbie and Alexandra were here.
a chance to talk to them
We'll have a chance to talk to them later.
words.meaning: 我们以后还有机会跟他们谈。

words.word: If he says he's going to be here
If he says he's going to be here, he's here.
words.meaning: 假如他说他要来这儿，他就一定会来。

words.word: I wonder what the problem is.
words.meaning: 我不知道发生了什么问题。
嗨，各位好。很抱歉我迟到了。
今天早上一直忙于工作

words.word: But Alexandra and I have been busy at work this morning on the community-center project.
words.meaning: 但Alexandra和我一早上都在忙着为社区中心的事。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第23集 · 10 争取报道支持
decks.section: 第23集 · 社区中心、志愿协作与共同计划

words.word: And we brought someone along who can help.
words.meaning: 而且我们带来了能帮助我们的人。

words.word: He's the editor of the Riverdale paper.

words.meaning: 竞选学区教育委员会职位

words.word: He wrote some nice articles on Mom when she was running for the school board.
words.meaning: 妈妈竞选学区教育委员会席位时，他写过几篇很好的报道。

words.word: Yes, I remember. You were a great help.
words.meaning: 是的，我记得。你帮了个大忙。

words.word: Hope to be a bigger help on the new community-center project.
words.meaning: 希望能在新社区中心这件事上提供更大的帮助。

words.word: From what Robbie and Alexandra have told me
words.meaning: 根据 Robbie 和 Alexandra 告诉我的情况

words.word: From what Robbie and Alexandra have told me, you people are making one big story.
words.meaning: 从Robbie和Alexandra告诉我的情况看来，你们正在制造一件大新闻。

words.word: Let me introduce you, Mr. Maxwell.
words.meaning: 让我给你介绍一下，Maxwell先生。

words.word: This is Nat Baker, who's responsible for this meeting, and this is Joanne Thompson--and Abe Lucas, who used to run the drugstore in town.
words.meaning: 这是Nat  Baker，他是这个会议的负责人，这是Joanne Thompson——还有Abe Lucas，他过去在镇上经营药房。

words.word: Robbie and Alexandra told me what you need to fix up the old library.
words.meaning: Robbie和Alexandra告诉我你们修复旧图书馆所需要的东西。

words.word: I am planning to write an editorial that I think will help you.
words.meaning: 我计划写一篇社论，我认为应该能帮助你们。

words.word: Let's go. What are your questions?
words.meaning: 那我们开始吧。你想问些什么？

words.word: OK. Now, I have ... first ... a couple of questions here.
words.meaning: 好，现在，我有……第一……几个问题。

words.word: Have you talked to the community council?
words.meaning: 你们跟社区的议会谈过了吗？

words.word: And have you had an engineer come in to do an inspection?
words.meaning: 你们可有一个工程师来做过检查吗？

words.word: OK, what do you need most of all?
words.meaning: 好，你们最需要的是什么？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第23集 · 11 人力、物料与报到
decks.section: 第23集 · 社区中心、志愿协作与共同计划

words.word: Men and women, young and old, to give us their time.
words.meaning: 不管男女老幼，请他们贡献时间。

words.word: To help scrub the building interior clean. So that we can repaint it.
words.meaning: 帮忙把建筑内部擦洗干净，好重新粉刷。

words.word: And you also need bodies to do repainting?
words.meaning: 你们也需要人手来重新粉刷吗？

words.word: And we'll also need some ladders and some brushes and some paint.
words.meaning: 而且我们还需要一些梯子、刷子和油漆。

words.word: When do you need the volunteers, and where do they report?
words.meaning: 你们什么时候需要义工？他们去哪儿报到？

words.word: I've got the council to agree to open the building for us on the next four weekends.
words.meaning: 我已说服议会同意在往后四个周末开放那座建筑。

words.word: Are there any special requirements that I should list in the paper?
words.meaning: 有什么特别的需求要我列在报纸上的？

words.word: a copy of all the things we need
words.meaning: 我们所需物品的一份清单

words.word: Here is a copy of all the things we need to start with.
words.meaning: 这是我们一开始就需要的所有东西的清单。

words.word: Eight straight-back chairs. Thirty folding chairs.
words.meaning: 八把直背椅，三十把折叠椅。

words.word: Six table lamps. Three end tables. One piano.
words.meaning: 六盏台灯，三张边桌，一架钢琴。

words.word: These items shouldn't be difficult to come by once I print the article in the paper.
words.meaning: 这些东西应该是不难弄到的，等我将这篇文章刊登在报纸上。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第23集 · 12 解释共同组织方式
decks.section: 第23集 · 社区中心、志愿协作与共同计划

words.word: This community has always been very generous.
words.meaning: 这个社区一向是非常慷慨的。

words.word: What you're saying is, in order for this center to succeed, we need to put together volunteers from the various generations of future users.
words.meaning: 你的意思是，要让这个中心办成功，得把未来不同年龄层使用者中的志愿者组织起来。

words.word: And without their energy and stamina, there's no way we can complete this project.
words.meaning: 没有他们的体力和耐力，我们无法完成这项计划。

words.word: I've got it. Now give me some information about how you see the building being used.
words.meaning: 我知道了。现在告诉我，你们计划如何使用这栋建筑。

words.word: Oh, here. On the ground floor we have the reception area ...
words.meaning: 噢，看这个。在楼下，我们会有一个接待区……

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第23集 · 13 阅读报道与兑现承诺
decks.section: 第23集 · 社区中心、志愿协作与共同计划

words.word: Charles Maxwell lived up to his word.
words.meaning: Charles Maxwell 兑现了他的承诺。

words.word: transform it into a new community center
words.meaning: 把它改造成一个新社区中心

words.word: a group of caring Riverdale citizens
words.meaning: 一群热心公益的 Riverdale 居民

words.word: "At the Stewart family home on Linden Street yesterday, a group of caring Riverdale citizens gathered to plan the refurbishing of the old library to transform it into a new community center.
words.meaning: “昨天在Linden街Stewart 的家中，一群热心公益的Riverdale居民聚集在一起计划重新整修老图书馆，将它转变成一个新的社区中心。

words.word: The original plan by the council was tabled because of lack of funds.
words.meaning: 议会原来的计划因缺少资金而被搁置。
这项新计划需要你的协助。

words.word: You could call it a community unity plan.
words.meaning: 你可以称它为社区团结计划。

words.word: It needs your time, and it needs your energy.
words.meaning: 它需要你的时间，需要你的力气。

words.word: And it needs your contributions of furniture, paint, brushes, ladders, lamps, et cetera.
words.meaning: 而且也需要你捐献家具、油漆、刷子、梯子、灯等等。

words.word: A list of these items and a volunteer form can be picked up at the Riverdale Press offices.
words.meaning: 这些物品的清单和义工申请表格可以到Riverdale Press各办事处索取。

words.word: By working together, this community can do anything to benefit its citizens, and we know you will all work together towards refurbishing the old library and making it a new community center.
words.meaning: 透过共同工作，这个社区可做任何造福居民的事情。我们相信各位会共同出力去重新整修老图书馆，使它成为一个新的社区中心。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第24集 · 01 学习、家务与朋友
decks.section: 第24集 · 毕业、告别派对与临时改期

words.meaning: 你今天从学校回来得早。

words.word: Yeah, they're getting the assembly hall ready for the graduation ceremony, so we all got to go home early.
words.meaning: 是的，他们正为毕业典礼布置礼堂，所以我们都可以提早回家了。

words.word: Well, now that you're here, you can help me with dinner.
words.meaning: 嗯，既然你回来了，你就来帮我准备晚餐。

words.word: I need those potatoes peeled and sliced.
words.meaning: 那些土豆需要削皮切片。

words.word: Alexandra's coming over to help me study for my math final.
words.meaning: Alexandra就要来帮我温习数学，准备期末考试。

words.word: Well, in that case, you can wash the dishes and clean up after dinner.
words.meaning: 嗯，既然这样，你就在晚餐后洗盘子，收拾桌子。

words.word: Can I invite Alexandra to stay for dinner?
words.meaning: 我可以请Alexandra留下来吃晚餐吗？

words.word: You and Alexandra have become good friends, haven't you?
words.meaning: 你和Alexandra成了好朋友，不是吗？

words.word: I'm going to miss her when she goes back to Greece.
words.meaning: 等她回希腊以后，我会想念她的。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第24集 · 02 策划派对与礼物
decks.section: 第24集 · 毕业、告别派对与临时改期

words.word: give her a little farewell party
Would you like to give her a little farewell party?
words.meaning: 你要不要为她举行一个小型欢送派对？

words.word: Maybe we could make it a surprise.
words.meaning: 也许我们可以让它变成一场惊喜。

words.word: Surprise parties don't always work out.
words.meaning: 惊喜派对并不是每次都成功的。

words.word: Well, we could tell her it's a graduation party for me.
words.meaning: 嗯，我们可以告诉她这是为我毕业所办的派对。

words.word: When Alexandra arrives, we'll surprise her.
words.meaning: 等Alexandra到达时，我们再让她惊喜一下。

words.word: Well, I suppose that might work.
words.meaning: 嗯，我想这样或许可以奏效。

words.word: give her a nice going-away present
words.meaning: 送她一件精致的临别礼物

words.word: I'd like to give her a nice going-away present.
words.meaning: 我很想送给她一件好的离别礼物。

words.word: I should have saved some money.

words.meaning: 对简单的东西也会高兴

words.word: I'm sure Alexandra would be happy with something simple, Robbie.
words.meaning: 我相信Alexandra会欣然接受简单的东西，Robbie。

words.word: something nice to remember me by
words.meaning: 一件让她想起我的美好纪念品

words.word: But, well, I'd like to give her something nice to remember me by.
words.meaning: 不过，我想送她一件精致的东西，让她看到就能想起我。

words.word: Maybe I could borrow some money from you and Dad.
words.meaning: 也许你和爸爸可以借我一点钱。

words.word: It's all right with me if it's all right with your dad.
words.meaning: 我没有问题，假如你爸爸答应的话。

words.word: Is he still in his office?

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第24集 · 03 到父亲办公室求助
decks.section: 第24集 · 毕业、告别派对与临时改期

words.meaning: 您需要的 X 光片

words.word: Here are the X-rays you wanted, Dr. Stewart.
don't see any breaks or fractures
I don't see any breaks or fractures.
words.meaning: 我没有看到骨裂或骨折。

words.word: Hi, Dad. Am I interrupting you?
Well, that's what fathers are for.
words.meaning: 嗯，做父亲的就是要帮这种忙。

words.word: Well, before I go to college, I have the whole summer ...
words.meaning: 嗯，在我进大学之前，我有一整个暑假可以利用……

words.word: get a job for the summer
And I'm planning to get a job for the summer.
I applied for a job as a lifeguard at the community pool.
words.meaning: 我申请了社区游泳池的救生员工作。

words.word: Yes. I'll be earning pretty good money if I get it.
words.meaning: 是的。假如我得到这份工作的话，我可以赚不少钱。

words.word: But right now, I'm kind of short of cash.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第24集 · 04 借款买礼物与借车
decks.section: 第24集 · 毕业、告别派对与临时改期

words.word: And my friend Alexandra is going back to Greece ...
words.meaning: 我的朋友Alexandra就要回希腊去了……

words.word: Mom says we can give her a going-away surprise party.
words.meaning: 妈妈说我们可以给她举行一个让她惊喜的欢送派对。

words.word: And I'd like to get her a nice gift ...
words.meaning: 我还想给她一份精致礼物……

words.word: when she looks at the time
Well, a wristwatch, so she'll think of me when she looks at the time.
words.meaning: 嗯，一个手表，这样当她看表的时候就会想起我。
不要太花哨，也不要太贵。

words.word: Well, I saw a nice watch.
words.meaning: 嗯，我已看中了一个好表。
从我当救生员的工资中

words.word: If you could lend me the money, I could pay you back out of my lifeguard salary.
words.meaning: 假如你能借钱给我的话，我可以从我当救生员的薪水里拿出来还你。

words.word: Well, I guess your mother and I can manage it.
words.meaning: 嗯，我想你妈和我可以设法帮这个忙。

words.word: When do you need the money?
drive her home after the party
You'll probably want the family car so you can drive her home after the party.
words.meaning: 你也许需要用家里的车，在派对结束后送她回家。
我会小心的。谢谢你，爸爸。

words.word: You're not so bad yourself, Son.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第24集 · 05 邀约与离开时间
decks.section: 第24集 · 毕业、告别派对与临时改期

words.word: You ready for the next problem?
words.meaning: 你准备好做下一道题了吗？

words.word: I can't look at another number.
words.meaning: 我简直一个数字也看不进去了。
休息一下喝点柠檬水好吗？

words.word: Oh, by the way, when is your plane reservation for your flight to Athens?
words.meaning: 噢，顺便问一下，你飞Athens订的是什么时候的班机？

words.word: Would you be able to come over Saturday night?
words.meaning: 你星期六晚上能过来吗？

words.word: I should be finished packing by then.
words.meaning: 到那时候我应该已经整理好行李了。

words.word: My folks are giving me a little graduation party.
words.meaning: 我爸妈要给我办一个小型毕业派对。

words.word: My dad's letting me borrow the car.
Oh, well, that would be very nice.
Just my friend Mike and a few kids from school.
words.meaning: 只有我的朋友Mike和学校里的几个家伙。

words.word: I'm going to miss all of you.
You've been like a second family to me.
words.meaning: 你们就像我的第二个家。

words.word: come to visit me in Greece
Maybe you could come to visit me in Greece?
words.meaning: 也许你可以到希腊来看我？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第24集 · 06 毕业与离家的感受
decks.section: 第24集 · 毕业、告别派对与临时改期

words.word: Are you excited about graduating from high school?
words.meaning: 你从高中毕业会不会感到很兴奋呢？
你不会感到有点紧张吗？

words.word: first came to the United States
I was when I first came to the United States.
words.meaning: 当我刚到美国来的时候，是感到有点紧张。

words.word: I'd never been away from home, and I didn't know what it would be like.
words.meaning: 我从来没有离开过家，而且我也不知道会是怎么一个样子。

words.word: once you get to know them
But then I found out that people are the same everywhere once you get to know them.
words.meaning: 但是后来我发现，哪里的人都是一样的，一旦认识了周围的人以后。

words.word: glad I got to know you
I'm glad I got to know you.
I'm glad I got to know you--and your family.
words.meaning: 我也很高兴能够认识你——和你的一家人。

words.word: get right to the graduation party
Wouldn't it be nice if we could skip the examinations and get right to the graduation party?
words.meaning: 要是我们可以略过考试，那岂不是很好？直接就是毕业派对。

words.word: that isn't the way it works
But that isn't the way it works.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第24集 · 07 道别与表达不舍
decks.section: 第24集 · 毕业、告别派对与临时改期

words.word: Yes. The Molinas are waiting for me.
words.meaning: 不会。Molina一家人正等着我呢。

words.word: pick you up on Saturday night
I'll pick you up on Saturday night, OK?
words.meaning: 我星期六晚上去接你，好吗？

words.word: She's really a good friend, isn't she?
words.meaning: 她真是个好朋友，不是吗？

words.word: You are going to miss her.
Am I going to miss her?
You are going to miss her!
my math teacher's going to miss her
words.meaning: 我的数学老师也会想念她

words.word: I'm going to miss her, and my math teacher's going to miss her.
words.meaning: 我会想念她，而我的数学老师也会想念她。

words.word: Well, you can write to her.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第24集 · 08 派对准备与突发电话
decks.section: 第24集 · 毕业、告别派对与临时改期

words.word: You're sure Alexandra's going to be surprised?
She has no idea that the party is in her honor.
words.meaning: 她不知道这个派对是为她办的。

words.word: Millie, did you bring the tapes for dancing?
words.meaning: Millie，你带来了跳舞的录音带吗？

words.word: I can't wait to see her face when she walks in here tonight.
words.meaning: 我迫不及待想看到她今晚走进这里时脸上的表情。

words.word: My mom's decorating it right now.
words.meaning: 妈妈现在正在装饰蛋糕。

words.word: Robbie, there's a phone call for you.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第24集 · 09 航班变化与等待
decks.section: 第24集 · 毕业、告别派对与临时改期

words.word: No, let's wait till Robbie gets back from the airport.
words.meaning: 不要。我们等Robbie从机场回来吧。

words.word: why she had to leave today
words.meaning: 她为什么必须今天离开

words.word: Did she say why she had to leave today?
words.meaning: 她说了她为什么今天非走不可吗？

words.word: had to take an earlier flight
words.meaning: 不得不搭乘更早的航班

words.word: She told Robbie that her flight tomorrow was canceled, so she had to take an earlier flight today.
words.meaning: 她告诉 Robbie，明天的航班取消了，所以只能提前搭今天的航班。

words.word: Why is he blowing his horn like that?
words.meaning: 为什么他这样子按喇叭？

words.word: Do you think we should take down the decorations?
words.meaning: 你觉得我们应当取掉这些装饰品吗？

words.word: We should have done it sooner.
Especially when Alexandra gave me a surprise ...
words.meaning: 特别是Alexandra给了我一个惊喜……

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第24集 · 10 回到派对与致谢
decks.section: 第24集 · 毕业、告别派对与临时改期

words.word: I called my parents from the airport.
words.meaning: 我从机场打电话给我父母。

words.word: When I told them my friends were giving me a party, they insisted that I stay.
words.meaning: 当我告诉他们我的朋友们为我举办了一个派对时，他们坚持要我留下来。

words.word: So now I'm taking a flight on Monday instead.
words.meaning: 所以我现在要改搭星期一的班机走。

words.word: But how did you know the party was for you?
words.meaning: 但是你怎么知道派对是为你举办的呢？

words.word: Well, Robbie told me when he gave me this.
words.meaning: 嗯，当Robbie送给我这个的时候，他告诉了我。

words.word: Now we can really start the party!
words.meaning: 现在我们可以真正开始舞会了！

words.word: I'd like to say something first.
made my stay in the United States so wonderful
words.meaning: 让我的美国之行如此美好

words.word: I would just like to thank all of you, my friends, who have made my stay in the United States so wonderful.
words.meaning: 我只是想谢谢你们大家，我的朋友们。是你们使得我在美国的生活如此多采多姿。

words.word: And to Robbie and the Stewart family for opening their home to me.
words.meaning: 并且感谢Robbie和Stewart全家为我敞开大门。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第24集 · 11 交换礼物与起舞
decks.section: 第24集 · 毕业、告别派对与临时改期

words.word: And I also have a little surprise for you, Robbie.
words.meaning: 我也有一个小小的惊喜给你，Robbie。

words.word: I think you might be amused.
words.meaning: 我想你可能会觉得有趣。

words.word: I guess we were thinking the same thought.
I knew we thought alike, but this is too much!
words.meaning: 我知道我们心意相同，但是这太令人难以置信了！
我可以请你跳这支舞吗

words.word: Mrs. Stewart, may I have this dance?
words.meaning: Stewart太太，我可以请你跳这支舞吗？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第25集 · 01 准备食物与感谢照看
decks.section: 第25集 · 露营准备、放松与自然声音

words.word: Hot dogs. I love hot dogs.
a hot dog in the country
There is nothing better than a hot dog in the country.
words.meaning: 在乡村，没有什么比吃一个热狗更好了。

words.word: Cooked outdoors over an open fire.
I wish I had one now.
words.meaning: 我真希望现在就来一个。

words.word: used to take you and Susan and Robbie
Do you remember when Daddy and I used to take you and Susan and Robbie to Jones Beach?
words.meaning: 你还记得爸爸和我常带你、Susan、Robbie去Jones海滨的事吗？

words.word: We'd wait until dark and make a fire, and we'd cook the hot dogs.
words.meaning: 我们会等到天黑再生火，然后烤热狗。

words.word: And, oh, does anybody want ketchup?
might as well take it along
I might as well take it along.
And now to make sure we've got the hamburger patties.
words.meaning: 再来，务必要带汉堡碎肉饼。

words.word: remember to put them in the bag
I have to remember to put them in the bag tomorrow morning before we leave.
words.meaning: 我必须记得将它们放进袋里在明天早上临走之前。

words.word: taking care of Max for the weekend
Mom, we really appreciate your taking care of Max for the weekend and giving up your free time.
words.meaning: 妈，我们真心感谢你在周末照顾Max，放弃你的闲暇时间。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第25集 · 02 担心孩子与互相安慰
decks.section: 第25集 · 露营准备、放松与自然声音

words.meaning: 为 Michelle 请了临时保姆

words.word: Susan and Harry have a sitter for Michelle in the city, and I'm taking care of Max.
words.meaning: Susan和Harry在城里给Michelle找到一位临时保姆，我就来照顾Max。

words.word: I am happy to do it for you.
words.meaning: 我很高兴为你们做这件事。

words.word: I guess Max is asleep by now.
I feel so bad for him.
It hurts so much when a baby gets his first teeth.
words.meaning: 小孩子长第一颗牙齿时好痛哟。

words.word: Well, he wakes up several times during the night, and the pain is so bad.
words.meaning: 噢，他一夜醒了好几次，疼得很厉害。

words.word: I'm really concerned about going away for the weekend, Ellen, and leaving you with the full responsibility of taking care of Max.
words.meaning: 我这个周末出门实在放心不下，Ellen，还要把照顾Max的全部责任留给你。
特别是他现在开始长牙。
我真希望他现在好一点。
记住你公公是小儿科医师。

words.word: We have a live-in doctor if there's a problem I can't handle.
words.meaning: 假如我遇到不能解决的问题，我们还有位驻家医生。

words.word: We really don't have to be overly concerned.
words.meaning: 我们真的不需要过分担心。

words.word: I'll go upstairs and stay with him until he falls asleep again.
words.meaning: 我上楼去陪他，直到他又睡着。

words.word: Try putting him across your lap on his stomach.
words.meaning: 试试让他肚子朝下趴在你腿上。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第25集 · 03 确认出发与回程
decks.section: 第25集 · 露营准备、放松与自然声音

words.word: When are Susan and Harry picking you up, Marilyn?
They're coming by at six tomorrow morning, so we can get an early start.
words.meaning: 他们明天早晨六点钟过来，这样我们可以早点出发。

words.word: a full day in the country
And you'll have a full day in the country.
words.meaning: 你们就可以在乡下待一整天啦。

words.word: Tomorrow night we'll be camping out in tents.
words.meaning: 明天晚上我们会在帐篷里露营。

words.word: heading back late in the afternoon
words.meaning: 下午晚些时候启程返回

words.word: We'll be heading back late in the afternoon.
words.meaning: 我们会在下午晚些时候启程返回。

words.word: You're going to have the time of your lives.
Camping out is such great fun.
words.meaning: 露营是件非常好玩的事。

words.word: have a great time camping out
We'll have a great time camping out, I'm sure.
words.meaning: 我确定我们会在露营时玩得很开心。

words.word: But I'm still a little worried about you, Ellen.
words.meaning: 但我还是有点牵挂着你，Ellen。

words.word: It will be my great pleasure, Marilyn.
I think he'll sleep through the night now.
words.meaning: 我想他现在会一觉睡到天亮。

words.word: I hope he's good when we're away.
words.meaning: 我希望我们不在时，他很乖。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第25集 · 04 核对露营清单
decks.section: 第25集 · 露营准备、放松与自然声音

words.word: the list of things we need
Now, to check the list of things we need for the camping trip.
words.meaning: 现在，让我们检查一下露营旅行所需物品的清单吧。

words.word: We need to bring a flashlight.
words.meaning: 我们需要带一个手电筒。

words.word: It's in the right-hand drawer, next to the bottle openers.
words.meaning: 在右边的抽屉里，就在开瓶器旁边。

words.word: Do we have a bottle opener on the list, Marilyn?
Is that one of the things Susan and Harry are bringing?
words.meaning: 那是不是属于Susan和Harry要带的？

words.word: And we're bringing the ketchup, mustard, relish--all that stuff.
words.meaning: 我们还要带蕃茄酱、芥末、调味酱－－诸如此类的东西。

words.word: Well, here's the bottle opener, and here's the flashlight.
words.meaning: 哦，这是开瓶器，这是手电筒。

words.word: For when we build our campfire.
rubbing two pieces of wood together
I can't build a fire by rubbing two pieces of wood together.
words.meaning: 我总不能靠着磨擦两片木柴来取火吧。

words.word: And don't forget your camera and film, Richard.
words.meaning: 别忘了你的照相机和底片，Richard。

words.word: And let's not forget our cassette player and some tapes.
words.meaning: 还别忘了带上我们的卡式录音机和一些录音带。

words.word: record our thoughts about the trip
words.meaning: 录下我们对旅行的感想

words.word: Some music tapes and some blank tapes so that we can record our thoughts about the trip.
words.meaning: 带一些音乐带和一些空白带以便我们能录下旅行中的感想。

words.word: The cassette player and the tapes.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第25集 · 05 到达营地与布置
decks.section: 第25集 · 露营准备、放松与自然声音

words.word: To be away from the city on such a beautiful day is my idea of heaven!
words.meaning: 在这样美好的一天远离都市，正是我所谓的天堂！

words.word: The grass. The trees. The fresh air.
I've been doing this for years
words.meaning: 我做这件事已经很多年了

words.word: I told you you'd like it. I've been doing this for years.
words.meaning: 我告诉过你你会喜欢的。我多年来一直从事这项活动。

words.word: You have the spirit of a teenager, Susan.
words.meaning: 你有一股青少年的朝气，Susan。
等你看到自己就知道了

words.word: Wait till you see yourself jumping around.
words.meaning: 等着看你那到处乱蹦的样子吧。

words.word: That's what I love about Susan.
get this stuff out of the car
words.meaning: 把这些东西从车里拿出来

words.word: Help me get this stuff out
words.meaning: 帮我把这些东西拿出来

words.word: Help me get this stuff out of the car.
words.meaning: 帮我将这些东西拿下车子。

words.word: Well, we'll put everything over there.
words.meaning: 嗯，我们将所有的东西都放在那边。

words.word: by the edge of the woods
over there by the edge of the woods
We'll set up our tents over there by the edge of the woods.
Then we'll be able to make our fire there where it's safe.
words.meaning: 然后我们就可以在那儿找一个安全的地方生火了。

words.word: Oh, there's our table and benches.
words.meaning: 哦，那是我们的桌子和长板凳。
吃饭用的一切都准备好了。

words.word: That's what makes this spot so good.
words.meaning: 那就是为什么这个地点这样好的道理。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第25集 · 06 准备野餐与放松
decks.section: 第25集 · 露营准备、放松与自然声音

words.word: When you're out in the fresh air like this, it makes you hungry.
words.meaning: 当你来外面呼吸这么新鲜的空气时，就很容易饿。

words.word: You guys are like three kids.
Now that you mention it, I guess I am.
words.meaning: 你们一提起来，我想我也饿了。

words.word: I mean, how could a guy not be hungry with all this talk about eating?
words.meaning: 我的意思是，当大家都在谈吃的，谁能不饿呢？

words.word: the bag with the chicken salad sandwiches
words.meaning: 装鸡肉沙拉三明治的袋子

words.word: Where's the bag with the chicken salad sandwiches?
words.meaning: 装鸡肉沙拉三明治的袋子在哪里？

words.word: Right here, next to the ice packs. Here.
words.meaning: 就在这里。在冰袋旁边。这儿。

words.word: Put the tablecloth on the picnic table
bring the cola and the plastic cups
Put the tablecloth on the picnic table, and I will bring the cola and the plastic cups.
words.meaning: 把桌布铺在野餐桌上，我来拿可乐和塑料杯。

words.word: Well, how do you like it so far?
words.meaning: 好了，到现在为止，你们感觉怎么样？
我从来没有这么放松过。

words.word: I wish we had brought Michelle
words.meaning: 真希望我们把 Michelle 也带来了

words.word: I wish we had brought Michelle, Harry.
I wish we had brought Max.
Marilyn, Susan, let's not begin to worry about Michelle and Max.

words.meaning: 他们得到了可靠的照顾

words.word: We're having a good time, and they're in good hands.
words.meaning: 我们玩得开心，而他们也有人可靠地照顾着。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第25集 · 07 享受户外时光
decks.section: 第25集 · 露营准备、放松与自然声音

words.word: Are you having a good time, Susan?

words.meaning: 你没有回答我的问题呢。

words.word: I am having a good time, Harry.
I promise not to think about the city.
words.meaning: 我保证不再去想城里的事。

words.word: Let's all just enjoy this wonderful place and this wonderful weather.
words.meaning: 让我们大家就来享受这个美妙的地方和这种美好的天气吧。

words.word: It was such a great idea to spend the weekend this way.
words.meaning: 这样过周末的主意简直太棒了。

words.word: I thought you'd all like it.
words.meaning: 我料想你们都会喜欢的。

words.word: Listen to the sounds of the summer that surround us.
words.meaning: 听听环绕在我们周围的夏天的声音。

words.word: Away from the telephones and account books.

words.meaning: 这是我提振精神的方法。

words.word: in a wonderful state of mind
I always go back to the city in a wonderful state of mind.
words.meaning: 我回到城里时总能保持特别好的心情。

words.word: forgotten about all my business problems
words.meaning: 忘记了所有生意上的烦恼

words.word: We've only been here for a day, and I've completely forgotten about all my business problems.
words.meaning: 我们到这里仅仅一天，但我已经彻底抛开了我所有的业务上的问题。

words.word: The office seems so far away.
words.meaning: 办公室好像变得那么遥远。

words.word: I'm glad you like it, Susan.
We'll spend many more weekends like this.
words.meaning: 我们以后可以多度几次这样的周末。

words.word: And next time we'll bring Michelle.
I wish she were here with us
words.meaning: 真希望她现在和我们在这里

words.word: I wish she were here with us to enjoy the country.
words.meaning: 我真希望现在她就和我们在一起享受这乡村美景。

words.word: And next time we'll bring Michelle.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第25集 · 08 把自然声音带回家
decks.section: 第25集 · 露营准备、放松与自然声音

words.word: I can hardly keep my eyes open.
If only we could bottle the fresh air.
words.meaning: 要是我们能用瓶子将新鲜空气装回去多好。
那样岂不是太美妙了吗？

words.word: We could call it "Deep Sleep Country Air."
words.meaning: 我们可以叫它助眠乡野空气。

words.word: having a hard time keeping my eyes open
I've been having a hard time keeping my eyes open just listening to it.
words.meaning: 我一直挣扎着要让双眼睁开，听着这些声音时。
它就像是一种特别的音乐。

words.word: Too bad we can't bottle the sound.
words.meaning: 不能将声音装瓶真是太可惜了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第25集 · 09 收拾返家与问候
decks.section: 第25集 · 露营准备、放松与自然声音

words.word: I'm so glad everyone is asleep.
I thought Max would be crying, and everybody would be awake.
words.meaning: 我还以为Max会哭个不停，让大家都睡不着。

words.word: all there is to know about taking care of babies
words.meaning: 照顾婴儿需要知道的一切

words.word: My mother knows all there is to know about taking care of babies, I assure you.
words.meaning: 我母亲完全懂得如何照顾小孩，我向你保证。

words.word: put some of this stuff away
Let's put some of this stuff away and then take off.
words.meaning: 我们先收拾好这些东西，然后出发。

words.word: We've got a forty-minute drive into the city.
words.meaning: 我们还要开四十分钟的车到城里去。

words.word: Welcome home-- and I do mean welcome home.
words.meaning: 欢迎归来。我真心欢迎你们回来。

words.word: But his teeth hurt, and he just can't get to sleep, poor dear.
words.meaning: 但他的牙疼，他不能入睡，可怜的小宝贝。
你们的周末过得怎么样？

words.word: We had a great time, Mom.
The weather couldn't have been better.
get a chance to get outside
Did you get a chance to get outside at all?

words.meaning: 昨天下午祖父帮我的忙。

words.word: I went to the supermarket to get a few things, and I stayed out an extra half hour.
words.meaning: 我去一趟超级市场，买了几样东西，我还特别多待了半个小时。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第25集 · 10 分享旅行经历
decks.section: 第25集 · 露营准备、放松与自然声音

words.word: The village was filled with people--the weather was so nice.
words.meaning: 镇上挤满了人，天气好的缘故。

words.word: He knows all there is to know, and he made the weekend very easy for us to enjoy.
words.meaning: 他无所不知，使得我们的周末过得非常轻松愉快。
别这样说。你们都帮了忙。

words.word: Why don't you go to your room, Mom, and get some sleep.
words.meaning: 为什么不到你的房间去，妈妈，去睡一会儿。

words.word: Tell me more about your weekend.
words.meaning: 多告诉我一点你们的周末。
你们做了什么特别的事情吗？
有许多特别的乡村趣事。

words.word: And we brought some home for you.
words.meaning: 而且带了一些回来给你。

words.word: It was so nice to be out in the country.
words.meaning: 出去置身乡下真是太好了。
所有的东西都有一股特别的味道。

words.word: been able to bottle the smells
It would have been great if we had been able to bottle the smells.
words.meaning: 假如我们能将气味装瓶该有多好！

words.word: It would be a great business if you could do that.
words.meaning: 假如你能办到那样的话，可是一笔大生意。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第25集 · 11 用录音安静收尾
decks.section: 第25集 · 露营准备、放松与自然声音

words.meaning: 让我们看看是不是有效果。
特别的乡野音乐，指自然的声音

words.word: I think we'd better head home.
words.meaning: 我想我们最好上路回家啦。

words.word: It's getting late, and we have a bit of a drive.
words.meaning: 已经晚了，而我们还要开好一段路呢。

words.word: Well, all your things are inside.
words.meaning: 嗯，所有你们的东西都拿进来了。

words.word: We'll call you all tomorrow night.
words.meaning: 我们明天晚上打电话给你们。

words.word: I'm so tired I think I'm overtired.
words.meaning: 我好累！我想我是累过头了。

words.word: I don't know if I can get to sleep.
words.meaning: 我不知道我能否睡得着。

words.word: Oh. Oh, where did you get that?
words.meaning: 噢。噢，你们从哪儿弄来的？

words.word: The soothing sounds of the country.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第26集 · 01 布置展览与担心评价
decks.section: 第26集 · 摄影展开幕、公开致谢与职业取舍

words.word: A little further to the right, Tom.
Good. What do you think, Richard?
the first thing people will see
words.meaning: 人们首先会看到的东西

words.word: It's the first thing people will see when they come in.
words.meaning: 这是人们走进来所看到的第一 件东西。

words.word: It sets the tone for the whole show.
words.meaning: 它决定了整个展览的气氛。

words.word: The next thing they'll see is this enlargement with the words Family Album, U.S.A.
words.meaning: 他们接着看到的，是这幅写着《美国写真集》字样的放大照片。

words.word: I can't believe this is really happening!
words.meaning: 我不敢相信这一切真的发生了！

words.word: Years of work went into these pictures.
words.meaning: 这些照片凝聚了多年的心血。

words.word: I know, but it's still a dream come true.
words.meaning: 我知道，可这仍然像梦想成真一样。

words.word: what the critics are going to write
Well, remember, we're not sure what the critics are going to write about your show yet.
words.meaning: 嗯，记住，我们还不能肯定评论家们会对你的展览写些什么。

words.word: And you never know what the man from the New York Times is going to say about it.
words.meaning: 而你永远也猜不到纽约时报的那个人会说些什么。

words.word: The reviews of this show are important for the sales of your book.
words.meaning: 与这次展览有关的评论对于你这本书的销售很重要。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第26集 · 02 谈预展与签名
decks.section: 第26集 · 摄影展开幕、公开致谢与职业取舍

words.word: When do we see the reviews?
words.meaning: 什么时候我们可以看到评论？

words.word: One of the critics is coming over this morning for a preview.
words.meaning: 一位评论家今天早上要来看预展。

words.word: I hope he's in a good mood.
Marilyn and I hope to use money from the sales of this book to buy a new house.
words.meaning: Marilyn和我希望用这本书销售的钱来买一栋新房子。

words.word: The book will be a success.
And the show will help promote it.
words.meaning: 而这次展览会有利于促销它。

words.word: Speaking of promoting the book, do I really have to autograph copies for the guests at the opening?
words.meaning: 说起促销书的事，我是不是真的有必要在展览开幕时为客人在书上亲笔签名呢？
我觉得这样挺不自在的。

words.word: A lot of people come to openings just so they can get the autograph of somebody who may be famous someday.
words.meaning: 许多人参加开幕仪式，就是为了得到将来有可能成名的人的亲笔签名。

words.word: Couldn't we wait until I'm famous?
words.meaning: 难道不能等到我成名了再说吗？

words.word: That might be sooner than you think.
words.meaning: 那也许比你想像的要快。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第26集 · 03 安排照片与邀请家人
decks.section: 第26集 · 摄影展开幕、公开致谢与职业取舍

words.word: This one over here, Mr. Carlson?
It's too close to the refreshments.
No, I think this one belongs in the "people-at-work" section.
words.meaning: 不，我认为它属于「工作中的人们」那一区。
对今晚开幕感到紧张吗？

words.word: How many people will you be bringing?
My wife Marilyn, my father and mother, my brother Robbie, my sister and her husband and their daughter. And my grandfather.
words.meaning: 我太太Marilyn、我父亲和母亲、我弟弟Robbie、我妹妹Susan和她丈夫以及他们的女儿。还有我祖父。

words.word: No such thing as "too many" at an opening.
words.meaning: 展览开幕怎么会嫌人太多呢。

words.word: They've stood by me through all this.
words.meaning: 他们一直支持我做这件事。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第26集 · 04 评论家来访
decks.section: 第26集 · 摄影展开幕、公开致谢与职业取舍

words.word: Mitchell, so nice of you to come.

words.meaning: 向多家报刊供稿的评论家

words.word: one of the most important syndicated reviewers
words.meaning: 最重要的联供评论家之一

words.word: Mitchell is one of the most important syndicated reviewers in the country.
words.meaning: Mitchell 是国内最重要的联供报刊评论家之一。

words.word: Well, you're the young man who did all this.
words.meaning: 嗯，你就是那位拍这些照片的年轻人。

words.word: Nice to meet you, Mr. Johnson.
words.meaning: 很高兴见到你， Johnson先生。

words.word: Mitchell has always encouraged new talent.
see what it says to me
Well ... you mind if I look around and see what it says to me?
words.meaning: 嗯……你们不介意我到处瞧瞧，看它给我什么样的感受吧？

words.word: What does that mean when he goes, "Mm-hmm, mm-hmm, mm-hmm"?
words.meaning: 他发出的声音代表什么意思，"Mm-hmm,mm-hmm,mm-hmm"？

words.word: It probably means he's clearing his throat.
words.meaning: 也许表示他正在清喉咙。

words.word: I don't care what the critics say, Mr. Stewart.
words.meaning: 我不管评论家怎么说，Stewart先生，

words.word: Tom is studying photography at NYU.
He's working with me during the summer months as an intern.
words.meaning: 在夏天的这几个月到我这里来当实习生。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第26集 · 05 鼓励新人和等待评论
decks.section: 第26集 · 摄影展开幕、公开致谢与职业取舍

words.word: I'd like to see your work.
words.meaning: 我希望能看到你的作品。

words.word: It's not good enough to show.
Oh, I'd still like to see your work.
words.meaning: 噢，我仍然希望看到你的作品。

words.word: You may be the next Ansel Adams and not even know it.
words.meaning: 你或许是第二个Ansel Adams而不自知呢。
如果你真的是这个意思

words.word: If you really mean it, I'll bring some of my pictures into the gallery.
words.meaning: 假如你是说真的，我就带一些我的摄影到艺廊来。
你的照片很有意思，Stewart先生。

words.word: You have a most unusual eye.
Are you going to be reviewing the show, Mitchell?
Oh, yes. It's definitely worth reviewing.
words.meaning: 噢，是的 。它着实值得评论。

words.word: Oh, you know I never answer that question, Harvey.
words.meaning: 噢，你知道我从不回答这类的问题，Harvey。

words.word: an advance copy of the book
I'd like an advance copy of the book, though, so I can study it.
words.meaning: 但我想要一本新书的试印本，以便我好好研究。

words.word: I have an autographed one in my office.
words.meaning: 在我办公室里有一本签了名的。

words.word: the copy of Richard's book on my desk
words.meaning: 我桌上那本 Richard 的书

words.word: Tom, would you give Mr. Johnson the copy of Richard's book on my desk?
words.meaning: Tom，请把我桌上那本 Richard 的书拿给 Johnson 先生，好吗？

words.word: Do you think he liked my photographs?
words.meaning: 你觉得他喜欢我的摄影吗？

words.word: We'll know when tonight's papers come out.
words.meaning: 今晚的报纸出来的时候，我们就知道了。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第26集 · 06 出门前缓解紧张
decks.section: 第26集 · 摄影展开幕、公开致谢与职业取舍

words.word: We're supposed to be there before the guests arrive.
words.meaning: 我们应该在客人到达之前先到那里。

words.word: Help me with this tie, will you?

words.meaning: 这么多年一直努力追求
你一直努力争取的东西

words.word: But this is what you've been working for all these years.
words.meaning: 但你多年来的工作，为的就是这个呀。

words.word: put together a book of photographs
I worked to put together a book of photographs.
words.meaning: 我的工作是创作出一本摄影书。
而今天这个却是演艺事业。

words.word: Well, it's all part of the same job.
words.meaning: 嗯，它们都是同一项工作的一部份。
放轻松点，好好地享受它。

words.word: I earned this, and I'm going to enjoy it.
words.meaning: 我辛苦赢得的，我要去享受它。

words.word: As soon as I recover from my nervous breakdown.
words.meaning: 只等我从神经崩溃中恢复过来。

words.word: A critic was there this morning.
words.meaning: 一个评论家早上去过了。

words.word: I have to sign copies of my book for a lot of people I never met before.
words.meaning: 我得为许多从没见过的人在书上签名。

words.word: My new shoes hurt my feet ...
words.meaning: 我的新鞋弄痛了我的脚……

words.word: You're going to be a great success.
words.meaning: 你会获得很大的成功的。

words.word: As soon as I get these cuff links on.

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第26集 · 07 表达对家人的感谢
decks.section: 第26集 · 摄影展开幕、公开致谢与职业取舍

words.word: on their way down to the gallery
Mom and Dad are already on their way down to the gallery.
words.meaning: 妈妈和爸爸已经出发去画廊了。

words.word: Well, I suppose I've run out of excuses.
words.meaning: 嗯，我想再也找不出借口了。

words.word: without your help and your love
never could have done this book
Before we go to the gallery, I just want to tell you that I never could have done this book without your help and your love.
words.meaning: 去画廊之前，我只想告诉你，没有你的帮助和爱，我绝不可能完成这本书。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第26集 · 08 介绍出版人与家人
decks.section: 第26集 · 摄影展开幕、公开致谢与职业取舍

words.word: Your show doesn't begin until eight thirty.
words.meaning: 你的展览八点半才开始。
Richard！欢迎！祝你今天晚上好运！

words.word: This is my publisher, Harvey Carlson.
This is my father, Dr. Philip Stewart ...
Nice to meet you, Mr. Carlson.
And this is my sister Susan and her husband Harry Bennett and his daughter Michelle.
words.meaning: 这是我妹妹Susan和她丈夫Harry Bennett以及他女儿Michelle。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第26集 · 09 接待与自由参观
decks.section: 第26集 · 摄影展开幕、公开致谢与职业取舍

words.word: And this gentleman is my grandfather, Malcolm Stewart.
words.meaning: 这位绅士是我祖父Malcolm Stewart。

words.word: There are hors d'oeuvres at the table, fruit punch at the bar.
words.meaning: 桌上有餐前小点，吧台有水果宾治饮料。

words.word: Can I get you something, Mr. Stewart?
words.meaning: Stewart 先生，要我给您拿点什么吗？

words.word: feel very proud of your grandson
words.meaning: 为你的孙子感到非常骄傲

words.word: You can feel very proud of your grandson, Mr. Stewart.
words.meaning: Stewart 先生，您完全可以为自己的孙子感到骄傲。

words.word: I'm proud of all my grandchildren, Mr. Carlson.
words.meaning: 我为我所有的孙子孙女感到骄傲，Carlson先生。

words.word: If you need anything, just ask.
words.meaning: 假如你需要什么，尽管讲。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第26集 · 10 阅读评论与分享喜悦
decks.section: 第26集 · 摄影展开幕、公开致谢与职业取舍

words.meaning: 发表；出版（此处指评论见报）

words.word: Did Mitchell Johnson's review come out yet?
words.meaning: Mitchell Johnson的评论出来了没有？

words.word: The newspapers don't come out till about ten o'clock.
words.meaning: 报纸要差不多十点钟才出来。

words.word: When they come out, we'll get it.
words.meaning: 一出来，我们就会拿到手。

words.word: Tom's about to open the doors.
"Richard Stewart's show at the Carlson Gallery is a collection of photographs from his new book entitled Family Album, U.S.A.
words.meaning: Richard Stewart 在 Carlson 画廊举办的展览，汇集了他的新书《美国写真集》中的照片。

words.word: introduces us to a remarkable new talent
words.meaning: 向我们介绍一位卓越的新秀

words.word: There is power and beauty in Mr. Stewart's work, and his book introduces us to a remarkable new talent."
words.meaning: Stewart先生的作品中展现出力与美。他的书让我们看到一位卓越的新秀。”

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第26集 · 11 公开介绍与致谢
decks.section: 第26集 · 摄影展开幕、公开致谢与职业取舍

words.word: have your attention for a moment
Ladies and gentlemen, if I may have your attention for a moment, please?
words.meaning: 各位女士，各位先生！我想占用你们一点点时间，好吗？

words.word: I hope you're all enjoying the exhibition.
words.meaning: 我希望各位都喜欢这次展览。

words.word: And I would like to introduce the young man who spent the last five years taking these remarkable pictures and writing the background for Family Album,U.S.A.-- Mr. Richard Stewart.
words.meaning: 我想向各位介绍这位年轻人，过去五年里，他拍下这些出色的照片，并为《美国写真集》撰写背景介绍——Richard Stewart 先生。

words.word: I want to thank all of you for coming here tonight.
words.meaning: 我非常感谢你们大家今天晚上的赏光。
他对我这个项目的信心

words.word: I'd like to thank Harvey Carlson for his faith in my project.
words.meaning: 我非常感谢Harvey Carlson对我工作计划的信心。

words.word: But most of all, I would like to thank my family for their love and support all through this adventure.
words.meaning: 但最重要的，我要感谢家人在这段探索过程中给予我的爱与支持。

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第26集 · 12 新机会与进一步询问
decks.section: 第26集 · 摄影展开幕、公开致谢与职业取舍

words.meaning: 噢，我真高兴终于结束了。

words.word: Hope it wins a Pulitzer Prize.

words.meaning: 我得个 A 就满足了

words.word: I'll settle for an "A" in my photography course.
words.meaning: 我只要摄影课能得"A"就满足了。

words.word: Ah, Richard, Marilyn, I want you to meet John O'Neill.
looking forward to meeting your husband
I've been looking forward to meeting your husband, Mrs. Stewart.
words.meaning: 我一直希望能见到你先生，Stewart太太。

words.word: I'm really impressed by your show.
words.meaning: 你的展览让我留下了深刻的印象。

words.word: In fact, I'd like your autograph.
words.meaning: 事实上，我想要你的签名。

words.word: Mr. O'Neill is the publisher of several magazines.
words.meaning: O'Neill先生是好几家杂志的发行人。

words.word: Of course. I've seen you on television.
words.meaning: 当然。我在电视上看见过你。

words.word: develop it into a magazine concept
words.meaning: 把它发展成杂志项目的构想
对你的作品印象如此深刻

words.word: Mr. O'Neill was so impressed with your work that he wants to develop it into a magazine concept.
words.meaning: O'Neill先生被你的作品深深打动，他想要将它加以发展，使之成为一个杂志方面的构想。
在这个计划中承担什么角色

words.word: where would I fit into the plan
words.meaning: 我在这个计划中承担什么角色

words.word: Well, that sounds very exciting, but where would I fit into the plan?
words.meaning: 嗯，听起来很令人兴奋。但是我在这项计划中怎么定位呢？

decks.name: 走遍美国 · 第26集 · 13 礼貌拒绝与坚持兴趣
decks.section: 第26集 · 摄影展开幕、公开致谢与职业取舍

words.word: I'd like you to be the photo editor of the magazine.
words.meaning: 我希望你能做杂志的摄影编辑。

words.word: Hold on. Wait a minute, please.
The problem is that I'm a photographer, not an editor.
words.meaning: 问题是我是一个摄影师，不是一个编辑。

words.word: In fact, I love what I do ... which is going out with a camera and a roll of film and seeing the wonder of humanity.
words.meaning: 事实上，我热爱自己的工作，就是带着相机和一卷胶片走出去，发现人世的奇妙。

words.word: giving some thought to a new book
Now, I appreciate your offer, but I've worked so hard on Family Album, U.S.A., and I'm giving some thought to a new book on a different subject.
words.meaning: 因此，我感激你的提议。但是我一直为Family Album, U.S.A.辛勤工作，如今我又开始在构想另一本不同题材的新书。

words.word: I'm flattered, but I enjoy taking pictures, and I want to continue doing that.
words.meaning: 你的厚爱使我受宠若惊，但我喜欢拍照片，而且我要继续做这一行。

words.word: Thank you, but I'm happy being a photographer.
words.meaning: 谢谢你，但我乐于当一名摄影师。

words.word: your next book will be a success
Richard, I know your next book will be a success.
words.meaning: Richard，我相信你的下一本书会成功。
